Unskilled Laborer
{@filter Gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set}

entries.name: Feature: Dragonscarred
entries: Durante varios meses fuiste sometido a torturas mágicas y mundanas a manos de Vorgansharaxse y sus secuaces. Estos experimentos te han dejado horriblemente desfigurado, pero te identifican como un superviviente de la «Virulencia Mutiladora». Esto te otorga cierta fama y notoriedad, ya que quienes conocen tu terrible calvario están ansiosos por escuchar la historia en persona, pero te dificulta disimular tu aspecto y esconderte de las miradas indiscretas.

Puedes aprovechar esta atención para conseguir acceso a personas y lugares a los que, de otro modo, quizá no tendrías acceso, tanto para ti como para tus compañeros. Nobles, eruditos, magos y aquellos que buscan desentrañar los secretos de la Virulencia Mutilada estarían deseosos de escuchar tu relato de supervivencia, de descubrir qué secretos (si es que hay alguno) podrías guardar y/o de estudiar tu aflicción con gran interés. Sin embargo, temes que tus aflicciones no sean del todo mundanas y que la Virulencia Mutilada pueda tener aún alguna razón nefasta para permitir tu huida, ya que tus cicatrices arden con furia ácida y parecen retorcerse bajo tu piel en ocasiones. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica Viajero Lejano.

entries.name: Disfigurement (Optional)
entries: Además de las cicatrices extensas, puedes elegir una de las siguientes opciones para representar tu desfiguración. Esta desfiguración es puramente estética, deforme y espantosa a la vista.

rows: Small non-functional wing(s).
Misshapen, wing-like membranes along one or both arms.
Elongated, claw-like hand(s).
Elongated, claw-like feet.
Painful green scales randomly embedded in skin.
Bulbous, reptilian eye(s).
Enlarged dorsal spines.
Hair replaced with small irregular spines.
I am driven to escape my past, and rarely stay in one place long.
I know secrets of the Maimed Virulence, but fear the harm that may befall me should others learn them.
Speaking of my ordeal helps sooth the still open wounds in my soul.
My former life is meaningless, and was ripped to shreds by the claws of Vorgansharax. All that matters now is what I do with the future.
I have faced the worst a dragon can deliver and survived. I am fearless, and my resolve unshakable.
I am haunted my tortured past, and wake at night screaming at half-remembered horrors.
I sleep with my back to a wall or tree, and a weapon within arm's reach.
I am slow to trust, but incredibly loyal to those who have earned it.
Survivor. No matter the cost, I will take any action necessary to survive. (Any)
Independence. When in trouble, the only person I can rely on is myself. (Chaotic)
Compassionate. I have suffered long at the hands of a Dragon, and take pity and compassion on the suffering of others. (Good)
Secretive. I am withdrawn, and hide my monstrous appearance for fear of drawing unwanted attention. (Chaotic)
Justice. I have been wronged, and will not allow the same fate to befall others. (Lawful)
Sycophant. During my ordeal, I became a willing servant of the Maimed Virulence, and spy on his behalf. (Evil)
I have sworn vengeance on the Maimed Virulence and those that follow him.
I long to reunite with friends and family who may dwell among the Phlan Refugees, and protect them.
While a prisoner of the Maimed Virulence, I overheard rumors of an item or treasure the Dragon seeks. I will have that treasure for myself!
I seek to reclaim and rebuild my former life to the best of my ability.
I have been reborn as a child of Vorgansharax. I will claim my birthright as his chosen heir and successor.
I attribute my survival to the work of the divine, and seek to prove myself worthy of the honor.
I have been touched with dragon-greed, and have a lust for wealth which can never be satisfied.
I secretly believe others are plotting to harm me.
I no longer enjoy the simple pleasures in life. Food is but ashes and bile in my throat.
Anyone who refuses to celebrate my celebrity does not deserve my company.
I am paranoid and overly suspicious of others. Anyone may be an agent of the Maimed Virulence.
Once I make up my mind, I follow my chosen course of action regardless of the consequences.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item shovel|phb} or a {@item miner's pick|phb}, a {@item block and tackle|phb}, a {@item climber's kit|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Pobre

entries.name: Overview
entries: Eres un minero de las Montañas Earthspur al que la suerte le ha dado la espalda y que está acostumbrado a las penurias. Has pasado mucho tiempo viviendo entre los enanos, los goliaths y los habitantes del Underdark que también trabajan en las minas de la zona. A estas alturas, te sientes tan cómodo trabajando bajo tierra como en la superficie. Sabes cómo interpretar un filón, regatear por suministros con los gnomos de las profundidades, divertirte con los enanos y encontrar el camino de vuelta a la superficie después. Por desgracia, aún no has hecho fortuna... todavía. Aunque has venido a Mulmaster en busca de trabajo, las altas cumbres y las profundas minas de las Earthspurs siguen llamándote.

entries.name: Feature: Deep Miner
entries: Estás acostumbrado a moverte por las profundidades de la tierra. Nunca te pierdes en cuevas o minas si has visto un mapa preciso de ellas o si ya las has recorrido antes. Además, eres capaz de conseguir agua potable y comida para ti y hasta para otras cinco personas cada día si te encuentras en una mina o en cuevas naturales. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Outlander».

rows: Nothing bothers me for long.
I hate the horrors of the Underdark with a passion. They took my friends and family and almost got me.
Anything worth doing takes time and patience. I have learned to plan and wait for the things I want and to be patient to achieve my goals.
I can party with everyone. Whether with dwarves, or goliaths, or deep gnomes, I can find a way to have a good time.
I'd rather be mining. This is okay; mining is better.
I think that I will stumble upon great riches if I just keep looking.
People who don't work with their hands and who live in houses are soft and weak.
I wish I were more educated. I look up to people who are.
Generosity. The riches of the earth are to be shared by all. (Good)
Greed. Gems and precious metals, I want them all for myself. (Evil)
Mooch. Property, schmoperty. If I need it, I take and use it. If I don't, I leave it for someone else. (Chaotic)
Boundaries. Everything and everyone has its prescribed place; I respect that and expect others to do the same. (Lawful)
Let it Be. I don't meddle in the affairs of others if I can avoid it. They're none of my business. (Neutral)
Materialist. I want riches to improve my life. (Any)
The people of the Earthspur mines are my family. I will do anything to protect them.
A deep gnome saved my life when I was injured and alone. I owe his people a great debt.
I must behold and preserve the natural beauty of places below the earth.
Gems hold a special fascination for me, more than gold, land, magic, or power.
I want to explore new depths and scale new heights.
Someday I'm going to find the mother lode, then I'll spend the rest of my life in luxury.
I'm uncomfortable spending time under the open sky. I'd rather be indoors or underground.
I'm not used to being around other people much and sometimes get grouchy about it.
Good tools are more reliable than people. In a cave in, I would save a sturdy pick before a stranger.
I jealously guard my secrets, because I think others will take advantage of me if they learn what I know.
I am obsessed with getting rich. I always have a scheme brewing for making it big.
I'm afraid of the dark.

_.special: the favor of an admirer (love letter, lock of hair, or trinket)

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@item Disguise kit|phb}, one type of {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} (one of your choice), the favor of an admirer (love letter, lock of hair, or trinket), {@item costume clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: By Popular Demand
entries: Siempre puedes encontrar un lugar donde actuar, normalmente en una posada o taberna, pero también en un circo, en un teatro o incluso en la corte de un noble. En esos lugares, recibes alojamiento y comida gratis de un nivel modesto o cómodo (dependiendo de la calidad del establecimiento), siempre y cuando actúes cada noche. Además, tus actuaciones te convierten en una especie de figura local. Cuando los desconocidos te reconocen en una ciudad donde has actuado, suelen tomarle simpatía.

entries.name: Specialty
entries: Un buen animador es versátil y da vida a cada actuación con una variedad de números diferentes. Elige entre uno y tres números o echa un vistazo a la tabla que aparece a continuación para definir tu perfil como animador.

rows: Actor
Dancer
Fire-eater
Jester
Juggler
Instrumentalist
Poet
Singer
Storyteller
Tumbler

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los artistas de éxito deben ser capaces de captar y mantener la atención del público, por lo que suelen tener personalidades extravagantes o carismáticas. Se inclinan por lo romántico y, a menudo, se aferran a ideales elevados sobre la práctica del arte y la apreciación de la belleza.

rows: I know a story relevant to almost every situation.
Whenever I come to a new place, I collect local rumors and spread gossip.
I'm a hopeless romantic, always searching for that "special someone".
Nobody stays angry at me or around me for long, since I can defuse any amount of tension.
I love a good insult, even one directed at me.
I get bitter if I'm not the center of attention.
I'll settle for nothing less than perfection.
I change my mood or my mind as quickly as I change key in a song.
Beauty. When I perform, I make the world better than it was. (Good)
Tradition. The stories, legends, and songs of the past must never be forgotten, for they teach us who we are. (Lawful)
Creativity. The world is in need of new ideas and bold action. (Chaotic)
Greed. I'm only in it for the money and fame. (Evil)
People. I like seeing the smiles on people's faces when I perform. That's all that matters. (Neutral)
Honesty. Art should reflect the soul; it should come from within and reveal who we really are. (Any)
My instrument is my most treasured possession, and it reminds me of someone I love.
Someone stole my precious instrument, and someday I'll get it back.
I want to be famous, whatever it takes.
I idolize a hero of the old tales and measure my deeds against that person's.
I will do anything to prove myself superior to my hated rival.
I would do anything for the other members of my old troupe.
I'll do anything to win fame and renown.
I'm a sucker for a pretty face.
A scandal prevents me from ever going home again. That kind of trouble seems to follow me around.
I once satirized a noble who still wants my head. It was a mistake that I will likely repeat.
I have trouble keeping my true feelings hidden. My sharp tongue lands me in trouble.
Despite my best efforts, I am unreliable to my friends.

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Costume|XPHB|2 Costumes}, {@item Mirror|XPHB}, {@item Perfume|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 11 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: {@item Disguise kit|phb}, a {@item costume clothes|phb|costume}, a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Faceless Persona
entries: Un personaje sin rostro vive sus aventuras tras la máscara de una personalidad pública. Esta personalidad le resulta tan natural como su verdadero rostro oculto, pero oculta su identidad. Tira en la tabla de «Personalidad sin rostro» para determinar tu personalidad, o consulta con el DJ para crear una personalidad única para tu personaje y que se adapte al tono de tu partida.

rows: A flamboyant spy or brigand
The incarnation of a nation or people
A scoundrel with a masked guise
A vengeful spirit
The manifestation of a deity or your faith
One whose beauty is greatly accented using makeup
An impersonation of another hero
The embodiment of a school of magic
A warrior with distinctive armor
A disguise with animalistic or monstrous characteristics, meant to inspire fear

entries.name: Feature: Dual Personalities
entries: La mayoría de tus compañeros de aventuras y el mundo te conocen por tu personaje. Aquellos que intentan saber más sobre ti —tus debilidades, tus orígenes, tu propósito— se ven frustrados por tu disfraz. Al ponerte un disfraz y comportarte como tu personaje, no se te puede identificar como tu verdadero yo. Al quitarte el disfraz y revelar tu verdadero rostro, ya no se te puede identificar como tu personaje. Esto te permite cambiar de apariencia entre tus dos personalidades tantas veces como desees, utilizando una para ocultar a la otra o como un camuflaje conveniente. Sin embargo, si alguien se da cuenta de la conexión entre tu personaje y tu verdadero yo, tu engaño podría perder su eficacia.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Un personaje sin rostro suele interpretar su papel: el de héroe o persona extraordinaria que es en su día a día. Sin embargo, todo eso es una fachada, o una parte de ellos expresada al extremo. Para definir una persona, siéntete libre de elegir características de otros antecedentes, en particular de héroe popular, ermitaño o noble. Para la persona detrás de la persona, aquella que realmente se esfuerza por ser sin rostro, considera un conjunto distinto de características sin rostro. Como resultado, aquellos con este antecedente tienen dos conjuntos de características, uno para su persona y otro para su yo sin rostro.

rows: I'm earnest and uncommonly direct.
I strive to have no personality—it's easier to forget what's hardly there.
I treasure a memento of the person or instance that set me upon my path.
I sleep just as much as I need to and on an unusual schedule.
I think far ahead, a detachedness often mistaken for daydreaming.
I cultivate a single obscure hobby or study and eagerly discuss it at length.
I am ever learning how to be among others—when to stay quiet, when to laugh.
I behave like an extreme opposite of my persona.
Justice. Place in society shouldn't determine one's access to what is right. (Good)
Security. Doing what must be done can't bring the innocent to harm. (Lawful)
Confusion. Deception is a weapon. Strike from where your foes won't expect. (Chaotic)
Infamy. My name will be a malediction, a curse that fulfills my will. (Evil)
Incorruptibility. Be a symbol, and leave your flawed being behind. (Any)
Anonymity. It's my deeds that should be remembered, not their instrument. (Any)
I do everything for my family. My first thought is keeping them safe.
What I do, I do for the world. The people don't realize how much they need me.
I've seen too many in need. I must not fail them as everyone else has.
I stand in opposition, lest the wicked go unopposed.
I am exceptional. I do this because no one else can, and no one can stop me.
I do everything for those who were taken from me.
I am callous about death. It comes to us all eventually.
I never make eye contact or hold it unflinchingly.
I have no sense of humor. Laughing is uncomfortable and embarrassing.
I overexert myself, sometimes needing to recuperate for a day or more.
I think far ahead, a detachedness often mistaken for daydreaming.
I see morality entirely in black and white.

_.special: Badge or emblem of your faction
copy of a seminal faction text (or code-book for a covert faction)

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Insight} and one Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skill of your choice, as appropriate to your faction

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Badge or emblem of your faction, a copy of a seminal faction text (or code-book for a covert faction), a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Safe Haven
entries: Como agente de una facción, tienes acceso a una red secreta de simpatizantes y agentes que pueden prestarte ayuda en tus aventuras. Conoces una serie de señales y contraseñas secretas que puedes utilizar para identificar a dichos agentes, quienes pueden proporcionarte acceso a un refugio oculto, alojamiento y manutención gratuitos, o ayuda para recabar información. Estos agentes nunca arriesgan la vida por ti ni corren el riesgo de revelar su verdadera identidad.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Utiliza las tablas del trasfondo {@background acolyte} del Manual del jugador como base para tus rasgos y motivaciones, modificando las entradas cuando sea necesario para adaptarlas a tu identidad como agente de la facción. (Por ejemplo, considera que los términos «fe» y «facción» son intercambiables).

Tu vínculo puede estar relacionado con otros miembros de tu facción, o con un lugar o un objeto que sea importante para tu facción. El ideal por el que luchas probablemente esté en consonancia con los principios y valores de tu facción, aunque puede tener un carácter más personal.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, {@item merchant's scale|phb}, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Supply Chain
entries: De tu época como comerciante, conservas contactos con mayoristas, proveedores y otros comerciantes y empresarios. Puedes recurrir a estos contactos cuando busques artículos o información.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Ser comerciante requería tener cabeza para los números, una personalidad firme, la capacidad de negociar con adversarios hostiles, un brazo fuerte para defenderse de los bandidos y la intuición necesaria para saber lo que la gente quiere y necesita. El arte de los negocios consiste en encontrar el mejor camino hacia el beneficio, y ese camino puede variar en cada transacción. Se necesita una mente fuerte y un estómago aún más fuerte para triunfar. Entonces, ¿por qué fracasaste?

rows: I didn't have the cutthroat attitude necessary to succeed. I won't make that mistake again.
Even my competitors said I was affable and talented. Those traits should serve me well.
To prosper, you have to be in control.
The customer is always right.
I was cutting corners and breaking deals to maximize profit. That's why I failed.
When I get an idea, I am single-minded in its execution—even if it's a terrible idea.
If I can be everyone's friend, I'll always have support.
My heart wasn't in being a merchant, so I failed. I'm not all that keen on adventuring either, but I need the money.
Survival. Where there's life, there's hope. If I remain alive and flexible, I can succeed. (Any)
Generosity. People helped me when I was down. Now that I'm back on my feet, I'll pay it forward. (Good)
Excitement. Caution got me nowhere in my previous business. I'm not going to let it hold me back now. (Chaotic)
Wealth. With enough coin, I can buy comfort, power, knowledge, and even eternal life. Nothing will stand between me and money. (Evil)
Stability. The mercantile trade was too chaotic for me. I need a nice stable profession, like adventuring. (Lawful)
Redemption. Too many people consider me a failure. So I need to prove them wrong. (Any)
My family means everything to me. I failed them before, and I must not do so again.
My church provides a connection to my god, so I must ensure that it is protected and funded.
My former business partner fell ill, and then our business failed. Part of my new venture involves earning enough to take care of their family.
If I take care of my possessions, they'll take care of me. People come and go, but a weapon or a wand is something you can always rely on.
Although my business failed, the people of my community were kind to me. I'll do everything in my power to protect them.
I owe a dangerous person a lot of money. As long as they're happy, they let my debt rest unpaid.
Why spend gold here when you can buy the same thing for copper in the next town?
I must have the best of everything. Like, right now.
You haven't heard of me? I'm sure that's because of your ignorance and low breeding.
I failed, but I'm awesome. So when anyone else is successful, it must be because of nepotism, dishonesty, or dumb luck.
I find that most people are trustworthy. Hey, where's my belt pouch?
Nothing gets between me and danger except my fellow adventurers. So I'll be sure to put them there.

_.special: poorly wrought maps from your homeland that depict where you are in Faerûn
small piece of jewelry in the style of your homeland's craftsmanship

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Any one {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} or {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} of your choice, likely something native to your homeland

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, any one {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} or {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} you are proficient with, poorly wrought maps from your homeland that depict where you are in Faerûn, a small piece of jewelry worth 10 gp in the style of your homeland's craftsmanship, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Feature: All Eyes on You
entries: Tu acento, tus gestos, tus expresiones idiomáticas y quizá incluso tu aspecto te delatan como extranjero. Dondequiera que vayas, las miradas curiosas se dirigen hacia ti, lo cual puede resultar molesto, pero también despiertas el interés amistoso de los eruditos y otras personas intrigadas por tierras lejanas, por no hablar de la gente corriente, ansiosa por escuchar historias de tu tierra natal.

Puedes aprovechar esta atención para conseguir acceso a personas y lugares a los que, de otro modo, quizá no tendrías acceso, tanto para ti como para tus compañeros de viaje. Nobles, eruditos y magnates del comercio, por citar algunos ejemplos, podrían estar interesados en conocer tu lejana tierra natal y a su gente.

entries.name: Why Are You Here?
entries: Un viajero que se encuentra lejos de casa puede haber emprendido su viaje por diversas razones, y su partida de su tierra natal puede haber sido voluntaria o involuntaria. Para determinar por qué te encuentras tan lejos de casa, tira el dado en la tabla que aparece a continuación o elige una de las opciones que se ofrecen. La siguiente sección, en la que se analizan posibles lugares de origen, incluye algunas razones sugeridas que se ajustan a cada ubicación.

rows: Emissary
Exile
Fugitive
Pilgrim
Sightseer
Wanderer
I have different assumptions from those around me concerning personal space, blithely invading others' space in innocence, or reacting to ignorant invasion of my own.
I have my own ideas about what is and is not food, and I find the eating habits of those around me fascinating, confusing, or revolting.
I have a strong code of honor or sense of propriety that others don't comprehend.
I express affection or contempt in ways that are unfamiliar to others.
I honor my deities through practices that are foreign to this land.
I begin or end my day with small traditional rituals that are unfamiliar to those around me.
Open. I have much to learn from the kindly folk I meet along my way. (Good)
Reserved. As someone new to these strange lands, I am cautious and respectful in my dealings. (Lawful)
Adventure. I'm far from home, and everything is strange and wonderful! (Chaotic)
Cunning. Though I may not know their ways, neither do they know mine, which can be to my advantage. (Evil)
Inquisitive. Everything is new, but I have a thirst to learn. (Neutral)
Suspicious. I must be careful, for I have no way of telling friend from foe here. (Any)
So long as I have this token from my homeland, I can face any adversity in this strange land.
The gods of my people are a comfort to me so far away from home.
I hold no greater cause than my service to my people.
My freedom is my most precious possession. I'll never let anyone take it from me again.
I'm fascinated by the beauty and wonder of this new land.
Though I had no choice, I lament having to leave my loved one(s) behind. I hope to see them again one day.
I am secretly (or not so secretly) convinced of the superiority of my own culture over that of this foreign land.
I pretend not to understand the local language in order to avoid interactions I would rather not have.
I have a weakness for the new intoxicants and other pleasures of this land.
I don't take kindly to some of the actions and motivations of the people of this land, because these folks are different from me.
I consider the adherents of other gods to be deluded innocents at best, or ignorant fools at worst.
I have a weakness for the exotic beauty of the people of these lands.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Sickle|XPHB}, {@item Carpenter's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB}, {@item Iron Pot|XPHB}, {@item Shovel|XPHB}, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: One of your choice of {@language Elvish}, {@language Gnomish}, {@language Goblin}, or {@language Sylvan}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} (one of your choice), a {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB|set of traveler's clothes}, three trinkets (each determined by rolling on the {@item Feywild Trinket|WBtW|Feywild Trinkets} table), and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 8 gp

entries.name: Feature: Feywild Connection
entries: Los nativos del Feywild reconocen tus gestos y tu conocimiento de las costumbres feéricas, y te consideran uno de los suyos. Por eso, las criaturas feéricas amistosas suelen acudir en tu ayuda si te pierdes o necesitas ayuda en el Feywild.

entries.name: Fey Mark
entries: Tu estancia en el Feywild te ha transformado ligeramente y has obtenido una marca feérica, que se determina tirando los dados en la tabla de marcas feéricas.

entries.caption: Fey Mark
rows: Your eyes swirl with iridescent colors.
You have a sweet scent, like that of nectar or honey.
You have long whiskers like those of a cat.
Your ears are covered with soft tufts of fur.
Your skin sparkles in moonlight.
Flowers either bloom or wilt (your choice) in your presence.
Your hair is made of vines or brambles and grows back to normal length within 1 hour of being cut.
You have a tail like that of a dog or another animal.

entries.name: Feywild Visitor
entries: Siempre que estés profundamente dormido o en un trance profundo durante un descanso largo, un espíritu del Feywild podría visitarte, si así lo desea el DJ. Determina la forma del espíritu tirando en la tabla de Visitantes del Feywild. Estas visitas, que pueden durar desde unos minutos hasta varias horas, nunca te causan ningún daño, y recuerdas cada una de ellas al despertar. Las conversaciones con el visitante pueden versar sobre cualquier tema, desde mensajes y revelaciones hasta tonterías y pistas falsas, a discreción del DM. Dichas conversaciones siempre se desarrollan en un idioma que tú entiendes, incluso si el visitante del Feywild no habla ese idioma normalmente.

entries.caption: Feywild Visitor
rows: Awakened creature (a Beast or an ordinary plant that has had the {@spell awaken} spell cast on it)
{@creature Centaur}
{@creature Dryad}
{@creature Faerie Dragon (Violet)||Faerie dragon}
{@creature Pixie}
{@creature Satyr}
{@creature Sprite}
{@creature Unicorn}

entries.name: Character Traits
entries: As the players choose backgrounds for their characters, they can use the following tables to help determine their characters' personality traits, ideals, bonds, and flaws. Players can use these tables instead of the ones that appear in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, or they can mix and match them. If a rolled result doesn't make sense for a character, the player can roll again or choose a more appropriate entry on the table.
These tables, while optional, are well suited to Feywild-themed adventures and are ideal for any character who has the feylost or Witchlight hand background.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I'm haunted by fey laughter that only I can hear, though I know it's just my mind playing tricks on me.
Like a nomad, I can't settle down in one place for very long.
Good music makes me weep like a baby.
Wherever I go, I try to bring a little of the warmth and tranquility of home with me.
I have never lost my childlike sense of wonder.
When I have a new idea, I get wildly excited about it until I come up with another, better idea.
I live by my own set of weird and wonderful rules.
I can't bring myself to trust most adults.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: Friendship. I never leave a friend behind. (Good)
Empathy. No creature should be made to suffer. (Good)
Wanderlust. I prefer to take the less traveled path. (Chaotic)
Changeability. Change is good, which is why I live by an ever-changing set of rules. (Chaotic)
Honor. A deal is a deal, and I would never break one. (Lawful)
Rule of Three. Everything in the multiverse happens in threes. I see the "rule of three" everywhere. (Lawful)
Obsession. I won't let go of a grudge. (Evil)
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to get what I want, regardless of the harm it might cause. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I would never break my word.
I find magic in all its forms to be compelling. The more magical a place, the more I am drawn to it.
I do what I can to protect the natural world.
A trusted friend is the most important thing in the multiverse to me.
I can't bring myself to harm a Fey creature, either because I consider myself one or because I fear the repercussions.
The Witchlight Carnival feels like home to me.
I'm drawn to the Feywild and long to return there, if only for a short while.
I feel indebted to {@creature Mister Witch|WBtW} and {@creature Mister Light|WBtW} for giving me a home and a purpose.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I easily lose track of time. My poor sense of time means I'm always late.
I think the whole multiverse is out to get me.
I'm always operating under a tight timeline, and I'm obsessed with keeping everything on schedule.
I'm a kleptomaniac who covets shiny, sparkling treasure.
I'm forgetful. Sometimes I can't remember even the simplest things.
I never give away anything for free and always expect something in return.
I have many vices and tend to indulge them.
I'm always changing my mind—well, almost always.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: {@item Fishing tackle|phb}, a {@item net|phb}, a favorite fishing lure or oiled leather wading boots, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Harvest the Water
entries: You gain advantage on ability checks made using fishing tackle. If you have access to a body of water that sustains marine life, you can maintain a moderate lifestyle while working as a fisher, and you can catch enough food to feed yourself and up to ten other people each day.

entries.name: Fishing Tale
entries:
Puedes contar una historia fascinante, ya sea inventada o real, para impresionar y entretener a los demás. Una vez al día, puedes contar tu historia a quienes quieran escucharla. A criterio del DJ, algunos de esos oyentes se mostrarán amables contigo; esto no es un efecto mágico, y que sigan mostrándose amables dependerá de tus acciones. Puedes tirar en la siguiente tabla para ayudarte a determinar el tema de tu historia o elegir el que mejor se adapte a tu personaje. También puedes colaborar con tu DM para crear tu propia historia de pescadores.

Traducción realizada con la versión gratuita del traductor DeepL.com

rows: Lobster Wrestling. You fought in hand-to-hand combat with an immense lobster.
It Dragged the Boat. You nearly caught a fish of monstrous size that pulled your boat for miles.
Fins of Pure Gold. You caught a sea animal whose fins were made of pure gold, but another fisher stole it.
Ghost Fish. You are haunted by a ghostly fish that only you can see.
Nemesis Clam. A large clam containing a pearl the size of your head claimed one of your fingers before jetting away; one day, you'll find that clam.
It Swallowed the Sun. You once saw a fish leap from the water and turn day into night.
Dive into the Abyss. You found yourself in an underwater cave leading to the Abyss, and your luck has been sour ever since.
Love Story. You fell in love with a creature of pure water, but your brief romance ended tragically.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries:
Los pescadores solo tienen éxito si dedican tiempo a su trabajo. Por ello, la mayoría de ellos tiene una sólida ética laboral y admira a quienes se ganan la vida honradamente. Los pescadores suelen ser supersticiosos y se encariñan con determinados señuelos o lugares especiales para pescar. Sienten un vínculo con las aguas en las que pescan y tienen mala opinión de quienes, con sus acciones, perjudican su medio de vida.

Traducción realizada con la versión gratuita del traductor DeepL.com

entries.caption: Fisher Personality Traits
rows: I am unmoved by the wrath of nature.
My friends are my crew; we sink or float together.
I need long stretches of quiet to clear my head.
Rich folk don't know the satisfaction of hard work.
I laugh heartily, feel deeply, and fear nothing.
I work hard; nature offers no handouts.
I dislike bargaining; state your price and mean it.
Luck favors me, and I take risks others might not.

entries.caption: Fisher Ideals
rows: {@b Camaraderie.} Good people make even the longest voyage bearable. (Good)
{@b Luck.} Our luck depends on respecting its rules—now throw this salt over your shoulder. (Lawful)
{@b Daring.} The richest bounty goes to those who risk everything. (Chaotic)
{@b Plunder.} Take all that you can and leave nothing for the scavengers. (Evil)
{@b Balance.} Do not fish the same spot twice in a row; suppress your greed, and nature will reward you. (Neutral)
{@b Hard Work.} No wave can move a soul hard at work. (Any)

entries.caption: Fisher Bonds
rows: I lost something important in the deep sea, and I intend to find it.
Someone else's greed destroyed my livelihood, and I will be compensated.
I will fish the many famous waters of this land.
The gods saved me during a terrible storm, and I will honor their gift.
My destiny awaits me at the bottom of a particular pond in the Feywild.
I must repay my village's debt.

entries.caption: Fisher Flaws
rows: I am judgmental, especially of those I deem homebodies or otherwise lazy.
I become depressed and anxious if I'm away from the sea too long.
I have lived a hard life and find it difficult to empathize with others.
I am inclined to tell long-winded stories at inopportune times.
I work hard, but I play harder.
I am obsessed with catching an elusive aquatic beast, often to the detriment of other pursuits.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, {@filter vehicles (land)|items|source=phb;dmg|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (land)}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} (one of your choice), a {@item shovel|phb}, an {@item iron pot|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Rustic Hospitality
entries: Como procedes de las clases populares, te integras entre ellas con facilidad. Puedes encontrar un lugar donde esconderte, descansar o recuperarte entre otros plebeyos, a menos que hayas demostrado ser un peligro para ellos. Te protegerán de la ley o de cualquiera que te busque, aunque no arriesgarán la vida por ti.

entries.name: Specialty
entries: Anteriormente te dedicabas a un oficio sencillo entre el pueblo, tal vez como agricultor, minero, sirviente, pastor, leñador o sepulturero. Pero ocurrió algo que te llevó por un camino diferente y te destinó a cosas más grandes. Elige o determina al azar un acontecimiento decisivo que te convirtiera en un héroe del pueblo.

rows: I stood up to a tyrant's agents.
I saved people during a natural disaster.
I stood alone against a terrible monster.
I stole from a corrupt merchant to help the poor.
I led a militia to fight off an invading army.
I broke into a tyrant's castle and stole weapons to arm the people.
I trained the peasantry to use farming implements as weapons against a tyrant's soldiers.
A lord rescinded an unpopular decree after I led a symbolic act of protest against it.
A celestial, fey, or similar creature gave me a blessing or revealed my secret origin.
Recruited into a lord's army, I rose to leadership and was commended for my heroism.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Un héroe popular es una persona del pueblo, con sus luces y sus sombras. La mayoría de los héroes populares consideran sus orígenes humildes como una virtud, no como un defecto, y sus comunidades de origen siguen siendo muy importantes para ellos.

rows: I judge people by their actions, not their words.
If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.
When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.
I have a strong sense of fair play and always try to find the most equitable solution to arguments.
I'm confident in my own abilities and do what I can to instill confidence in others.
Thinking is for other people. I prefer action.
I misuse long words in an attempt to sound smarter.
I get bored easily. When am I going to get on with my destiny?
Respect. People deserve to be treated with dignity and respect. (Good)
Fairness. No one should get preferential treatment before the law, and no one is above the law. (Lawful)
Freedom. Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Chaotic)
Might. If I become strong, I can take what I want—what I deserve. (Evil)
Sincerity. There's no good in pretending to be something I'm not. (Neutral)
Destiny. Nothing and no one can steer me away from my higher calling. (Any)
I have a family, but I have no idea where they are. One day, I hope to see them again.
I worked the land, I love the land, and I will protect the land.
A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.
My tools are symbols of my past life, and I carry them so that I will never forget my roots.
I protect those who cannot protect themselves.
I wish my childhood sweetheart had come with me to pursue my destiny.
The tyrant who rules my land will stop at nothing to see me killed.
I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings and the risk of failure.
The people who knew me when I was young know my shameful secret, so I can never go home again.
I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially hard drink.
Secretly, I believe that things would be better if I were a tyrant lording over the land.
I have trouble trusting in my allies.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set}, a lucky charm, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Never Tell Me the Odds
entries: Las probabilidades y las posibilidades son tu pan de cada día. Durante las actividades de ocio que impliquen juegos de azar o calcular las probabilidades del mejor plan, podrás hacerte una idea clara de cuál es probablemente la mejor opción y qué oportunidades parecen demasiado buenas para ser verdad, según lo determine el director de juego.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Algunos juegan por necesidad. Otros lo hacen por aburrimiento. Otros, en cambio, se vuelven adictos a la emoción de ganar o perderlo todo en un giro del destino. Para algunos, el juego no es tanto una cuestión de azar como de buscar todas las ventajas posibles para asegurarse el resultado. Los mejores jugadores pueden perderlo todo, y los peores a veces ganan. Sea como sea, siempre se reconoce a los jugadores por la mirada que tienen en los ojos. La diosa Fortuna los persigue.

rows: I plan for every contingency. Leave nothing to chance!
Every copper wants to be a silver. Each bet is an opportunity.
I'm one of Lady Luck's favored. Anything I try is destined to succeed.
I've lost so much to gambling that I refuse to spend money on anything anymore.
Nothing is certain. Planning is a coward's act.
I can't be sure who I've swindled, cheated, or defeated, so I keep a low profile in public.
The perfect bet is out there somewhere. I just have to keep my eyes open.
I have beaten my addiction, but all it takes is one weak moment and I'll be back at the card table.
Knowledge. Knowledge is power, and knowing which horse to back is the key to success. (Any)
Fate. Whatever happens is fated, regardless of any planning or striving. (Lawful)
Bravery. If you want to succeed, you have to take risks. (Chaotic)
Survival. You can't win if you're dead. Live to fight another day—when the odds might be more in your favor. (Any)
Reliability. When I was in need, I was able to rely on others. Now I want to be the one others rely on. (Good)
Victory. Winning is the real measure of a person. In the end, the only thing that matters is the scoreboard. (Evil)
One person in particular owes me a lot of money, and I need to keep them alive if I want to be repaid.
I'm loyal to the friend or family member who taught me how to gamble.
The person who saved me from my gambling addiction is the only reason I'm alive today.
A patron once fronted me money in exchange for a percentage of my winnings. I owe them a debt of gratitude. And a lot of cash.
A criminal syndicate I once played for isn't happy I left the game, and its enforcers are looking for me.
Urchins once helped me find marks for my games. Now I'm driven to help them escape the streets.
I don't know when to quit. Especially when everyone else is telling me to.
I save my sympathy for my friends, and I have no friends.
You think we're in trouble now? Let me tell you how bad things are likely to get!
You can loan me a little, right? I've got a sure thing. I'll double your money, guaranteed.
I was once a terribly flawed person, like you. Let me tell you how you can save yourself.
I'm a great gambler. I'm just bad at math and logic.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@item Thieves' tools|phb}, one type of {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A battered alms box, a {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}, a cast-off military jacket, cap, or scarf, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a belt {@item pouch|phb}, and 10 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Pobre

entries.name: Overview
entries: Todo el tráfico que entra y sale de la Ciudad del Comercio pasa por la Puerta de Hillsfar, lo que la convierte en el lugar ideal para que los indigentes se reúnan a mendigar, tocar en la calle, cotillear y robar carteras. Tú creciste en las calles, a la sombra de ese gran edificio de acero, que alberga tanto a los Plumas Rojas como a los magos del gremio. Aunque hayas seguido adelante con tu vida, sigues teniendo amigos entre ellos, y esa vida ha dejado una huella imborrable en ti.

entries.name: Feature: Red Plume and Mage Guild Contacts
entries: Cuando vivías en la Puerta de Hillsfar, hiciste varios amigos entre los Plumas Rojas y el Gremio de Magos. Te recuerdan con cariño y te echan una mano cuando pueden. Puedes recurrir a su ayuda en Hillsfar y sus alrededores para conseguir comida, así como equipo básico para uso temporal. También puedes recurrir a ellos para acceder a las zonas de baja seguridad de sus guarniciones, salones y campamentos. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica Soldado.

rows: I appreciate the simple things in life. a song, a warm meal, a sunny day. I don't need any more.
My problems are always caused by others. I'm never to blame.
I am afraid I could wind up back on the streets any day.
I get along with everyone.
I see people as marks for a con and have difficulty feeling true empathy for them.
I have a real flair for matchmaking. I can find anyone a spouse!
I think money is the true measure of appreciation and affection. Everything else is talk or an act.
I don't like having a lot of stuff, just a few simple things I need. I don't like being tied down and tend to leave things behind when I don't need them anymore.
Loyal. I never rat out any of my friends, even when the Red Plumes or the Rogues Guild ask. (Lawful)
Adventurous. I don't like doing the same thing every day. I crave variety. (Chaotic)
Strong. Only the strong survive. I respect those who are strong and powerful. (Any)
Witty. Brains are better than brawn. I rely on my wits and respect others who do the same. (Any)
Honest. Others can do what they want, but I won't lie or steal, even to feed my family. (Good)
Ungrateful. Those who give, only do it to make themselves feel better. I steal from them. (Evil)
The Joydancers of Lliira gave me my instrument when I really needed food. I hate them for that.
Busking has taught me to love music above all else.
The Rogues Guild spared me when I did a job without cutting them in. I owe them a great debt.
I know people hate the Red Plumes, but some of them were really good to me. I help Red Plumes whenever I can, and I respect them. They're just doing what they have to do to get by in this world.
I will be wealthy some day. My descendants will live in comfort and style.
I know how hard life on the streets is. I do everything I can for those who have less than me.
Though I no longer live at the Gate, I am still always concerned about where I will get my next meal.
Years of thieving have become habit. I sometimes steal from strangers without thinking about it.
I am ashamed of my origins. I pretend I am higher-born and fear others will find out the truth.
I think people who grew up in houses are soft, spoiled, and ungrateful. I frequently tell them so.
I am still very uncomfortable wearing nice clothes, sleeping in a warm bed, and eating fine food.
I do not trust anyone who has not had a hard life.

_.special: ring of keys to unknown locks

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: Two of your choice (Abyssal, Celestial, or Infernal recommended)

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A ring of keys to unknown locks, a blank {@item book|PHB}, an {@item ink pen|PHB} or quill, a bottle of black ink, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Planar Infusion
entries: Vivir en una ciudad-puerta o en un lugar similar te ha impregnado de energía planar. Obtienes la dote {@feat Scion of the Outer Planes|SatO}. Además, sabes dónde encontrar alojamiento y comida gratuitos y modestos en la comunidad en la que creciste.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: La influencia de un plano exterior determina tu perspectiva. La tabla de rasgos de personalidad del guardián de la puerta te sugiere rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

rows: Strange events and otherworldly creatures don't faze me.
I think in terms of exchange: something for something, nothing for nothing.
I speak with an unusual cadence.
I pepper my speech with words or curses borrowed from planar languages.
I've seen enough to know that you can't take anyone at face value, so I scrutinize everyone.
I have a superstitious habit I picked up from my gate-town, such as touching iron when I'm nervous or arranging objects in a specific order.

entries.name: Building a Gate Warden Character
entries: Quienes permanecen durante un tiempo prolongado cerca de un portal permanente hacia otro plano absorben la esencia que emana de ese reino más allá. Quienes se ven influidos por ese mismo plano comparten similitudes en su comportamiento e incluso en su aspecto físico.

entries.name: Gate Warden Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla {@item Gate Warden Trinket|SatO|Gate Warden Trinkets}, en lugar de en la tabla {@item Trinket|PHB|Trinkets} del Manual del Jugador, para elegir tu abalorio inicial.

a.special: small stone that reminds you of home

b.special: sprig that reminds you of home

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: Giant and one other language of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item backpack|phb}, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, a small stone or sprig that reminds you of home, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Origin Stories
entries: Tú decides cómo acabaste viviendo entre criaturas colosales, pero la tabla de «Origen del huérfano» sugiere diversas posibilidades.

entries.caption: Foundling Origin
rows: You were found as a baby by a family of nomadic giants who raised you as one of their own.
A family of stone giants rescued you when you fell into a mountain chasm, and you have lived with them underground ever since.
You were lost or abandoned as a child in a jungle that teemed with ravenous dinosaurs. There, you found an equally lost frost giant; together, you survived.
Your farm was crushed and your family killed in a battle between warring groups of giants. Racked with guilt over the destruction, a sympathetic giant soldier promised to care for you.
After you had a series of strange dreams as a child, your superstitious parents sent you to study with a powerful but aloof storm giant oracle.
While playing hide-and-seek with your friends, you stumbled into the castle of a cloud giant, who immediately adopted you.

entries.name: Building a Giant Foundling Character
entries: Tu vida entre gigantes te ha proporcionado una perspectiva única. Aunque eres inusualmente grande para tu especie, no eres más grande que un niño gigante, por lo que es posible que seas muy consciente de tu tamaño.

entries.name: Feature: Strike of the Giants
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Strike of the Giants|BGG}.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: La tabla de rasgos de personalidad del «Gigante abandonado» sugiere una variedad de rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

rows: What I lack in stature compared to giants, I make up for with sheer spite.
I insist on being taken seriously as a full-grown adult. Nobody talks down to me!
Crowded spaces make me uncomfortable. I'd much rather be in an open field than a bustling tavern.
I embrace my shorter stature. It helps me stay unnoticed—and underestimated.
Every avalanche begins as a single pebble.
The world always feels too big, and I'm afraid I'll never find my place in it.

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: Choose one of Elvish, Giant, or Kraul

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A Golgari insignia, a {@item poisoner's kit|phb}, a pet beetle or spider, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp worth of mixed coins

entries.name: Feature: Undercity Paths
entries: Conoces pasadizos ocultos y subterráneos que puedes utilizar para esquivar multitudes, obstáculos y miradas curiosas mientras te desplazas por la ciudad. Cuando no estás en combate, tú y los compañeros a los que lideras podéis viajar entre cualquier par de lugares de la ciudad al doble de la velocidad a la que lo haríais normalmente. Los pasadizos de la ciudad subterránea están plagados de peligros que rara vez se atreven a salir a la luz del mundo de la superficie, por lo que no hay garantía de que vuestro viaje sea seguro.

entries.name: Golgari Guild Spells
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

En tu caso, los hechizos de la tabla de hechizos del gremio Golgari se añaden a la lista de hechizos de tu clase con capacidad para lanzar hechizos. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de hechizos, estos hechizos se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Golgari Guild Spells
rows: Cantrip
{@spell dancing lights}, {@spell spare the dying}

2nd
{@spell protection from poison}, {@spell ray of enfeeblement}, {@spell spider climb}
3rd
{@spell animate dead}, {@spell plant growth}
4th
{@spell giant insect}, {@spell grasping vine}
5th
{@spell cloudkill}, {@spell insect plague}

entries: La magia golgari suele ir acompañada de un resplandor verde enfermizo y un hedor a podrido.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los miembros del Enjambre Golgari son, sin lugar a dudas, producto de los bajos fondos, y se sienten incómodos en medio de las comodidades de la civilización. Provocan la misma inquietud en los demás al recordarles que la muerte se acerca inevitablemente.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: Remember, I could kill you in your sleep. Or put centipedes in your bedroll.
I like to remind people of their inevitable demise.
Sometimes I give voice to the whispers of the rot, which I hear but no one else does.
I do my best to discourage anyone from approaching or talking to me.
I have accepted my death. Hence, I don't fear it.
Like roots growing through stone, I am relentless and determined in my action.
I put my knowledge of anatomy to use by narrating the injuries my enemies suffer in grisly detail.
Like a wild animal, I lash out viciously when I'm provoked—and I'm easily provoked.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Guild}. My guild is all that really matters. (Any)
{@b Stoicism}. All of us are part of the cyclical march of nature, which will continue with or without us. (Neutral)
{@b Nature}. The natural world is more important than the edifices of the city and civilization. (Neutral)
{@b Interdependence}. We are all part of nature's web. (Lawful)
{@b Ambition}. The time of Golgari ascendance is at hand, and I intend to have a prominent place in the new world order. (Evil)
{@b Live and Let Live}. Meddling in the affairs of other guilds is a great way to get squashed like a bug. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I cherish the finger of a family member who was {@condition petrified} by a medusa.
I have an identical twin who is as different from me as any person could be.
I want to lead one faction of the guild to a new position of dominance.
I love spending time in the moss-covered building where I took part in my first reclamation mission.
I found something in the sewer that must never come to light.
I am forever grateful to the reclaimer who found me floating facedown in the sewer, moments from death.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: Death comes for us all, so you can't expect me to take care of someone who can't fight it off.
I assume that anyone outside the Golgari looks down on me.
I feel a need for revenge against those who enjoy the privilege of living above ground.
I don't bother to couch my opinions in flattering words.
I can't help but pocket any trinket or coin I come across, no matter how worthless.
I'm convinced that I'm better and stronger than members of other guilds, isolated as they are from the realities of life and death.

entries.name: Contacts
entries: En la medida en que el Enjambre Golgari actúa como un único organismo, estás conectado de una forma u otra con todos y cada uno de sus miembros. Convencido de que el resto del mundo está en tu contra, te resulta fácil establecer vínculos estrechos con tus compañeros de gremio, pero más difícil entablar relaciones significativas con otras personas.
Tira dos veces en la tabla de «Contactos Golgari» (para un aliado y un rival) y una vez en la tabla de «Contactos no Golgari».

entries.caption: Golgari Contacts
rows: One of my parents is an elite assassin, a member of the Ochran.
I learned combat from a kraul.
I know a medusa who is stationed in the guildhall.
I had a torrid romance with a spore druid responsible for a large rot farm.
There's a troll in a remote area of the undercity who seems to find me interesting—and who knows more than you'd think.
An elf lich is determined to see me become a lich someday, too.
A medusa decided it would be more fun to recruit me into the guild than to kill me.
I know a findbroker who can locate just about anything, for the right price.

entries.caption: Non-Golgari Contacts
rows: An Azorius arrester I literally pulled out of the gutter will do anything for me.
Someone joined the Gruul in a battle against the Boros once, and the sergeant of that Boros squad would love to prove that it was me.
I had a romance with a Dimir agent whom I still feed secrets to.
Roll an additional Golgari contact; you can decide if the contact is an ally or a rival.
I joined the Gruul in a battle against the Boros once, and the chief of that small clan thanks me for turning the tide.
An Izzet scientist resents that I sold a scrapped invention I found in the sewer.
My undercity explorations led me into an Orzhov vault, and a spirit thinks I stole something valuable.
I found a baby beast and sold it to a Rakdos wrangler who remains grateful to me.
A Selesnya druid and I share an interest in the same garden, and we have enjoyable arguments there.
I regularly pick up refuse from beneath a Simic laboratory, and sometimes I talk to the researcher who dumps it there.

entries.name: How Do I Fit In?
entries: Como parte del Enjambre Golgari, eres un instrumento especializado del conjunto. Tus órdenes, cuando las recibes, provienen del maestro del gremio a través de sus cancilleres, quienes transmiten sus mensajes por todo el gremio. El enjambre confía en ti para promover el bien común protegiendo alguna parte, por pequeña que sea, de su bulliciosa existencia. Esa responsabilidad no significa que seas indispensable; tu muerte final también forma parte de tu propósito y función, y serás sustituido incluso mientras tu cuerpo proporcione nutrientes para impulsar el crecimiento del enjambre.

Una de las misiones clásicas de un miembro de los Golgari consiste en arrastrarse por entornos similares a mazmorras —las alcantarillas y las antiguas bóvedas de la ciudad subterránea— en busca de los tesoros que han dejado atrás los muertos. A veces te pueden enviar a buscar un objeto concreto que se cree perdido en una zona peligrosa de la ciudad subterránea. En otras ocasiones, se te podría pedir que recojas muestras de un hongo concreto, que recuperes un cadáver que flota en el fango de las alcantarillas o que traigas todo el botín que puedas para ayudar a llenar las arcas del enjambre.

Podrías ganar suficiente prestigio como para convertirte en miembro de los Ochran, y te asignarían diversas tareas relacionadas con el robo, el asesinato o la protección de figuras importantes de tu gremio. Podrías robar algo porque el gremio lo necesita, o porque su pérdida perjudicaría a otro gremio, acelerando el declive de ese grupo. Podrían encargarte que mates a un enemigo declarado y activo de los Golgari, como un capitán de Boros demasiado celoso cuyas incursiones en la ciudad subterránea se han acercado peligrosamente al santuario interior del enjambre. O podrías servir como guardaespaldas de uno de los altos cancilleres del maestro de gremio Jarad, escoltando a esta figura por la ciudad subterránea y estando listo para intervenir en cualquier momento si las cosas se tuercen.

Los chamanes de los Golgari utilizan su magia para acelerar el ciclo de descomposición y regeneración. Es posible que te envíen a esparcir esporas por una zona que los Golgari desean reclamar como su territorio, o a convencer a los habitantes de dicho territorio para que lo abandonen. También es posible que tengas que enfrentarte a la amenaza constante de monstruos hostiles que invaden las regiones controladas por los Golgari.

_.special: gold-plated ring depicting a smiling face

entries.name: Feature: Ballad of the Grinning Fool
entries: Como todo Grinner, sabes cómo encontrar un escondite. En cualquier ciudad de 10 000 habitantes o más de la Costa de la Menagerie o en las tierras del Imperio Dwendaliano, puedes tocar la «Balada del tonto sonriente» en una taberna o posada importante. Un miembro de la Sonrisa Dorada te encontrará y te dará refugio a ti y a cualquier compañero por el que respondas. Este refugio podría suspenderse si resulta demasiado peligroso ocultarte, a discreción del DM.
Esta función debe utilizarse con precaución, ya que no todos los que conocen la balada son tus amigos. Algunos son traidores, contraespías o agentes de la tiranía.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los «grinners» están entrenados en el arte del secreto y la insinuación, y son expertos en pasar desapercibidos a plena vista, ya que suelen ser las personas más ruidosas y llamativas de la sala. Sus habilidades para el engaño y el combate se adaptan perfectamente a un estilo de vida aventurero, y viajar con mercenarios y cazatesoros les proporciona una excusa perfecta para recorrer tierras sometidas a la tiranía.

rows: I love the spotlight. Everyone, look at me!
Give me a drink and I'm your friend.
Talk to me about yourself. I'm a hell of a listener.
I hate to start fights, but I love to finish them.
I can't sit still.
I'm always humming an old tune from my past.
When I don't have a reason to smile, I'm miserable.
I'm lucky like you wouldn't believe.
Revolution. Tyrants must fall, no matter the cost. (Chaotic)
Compassion. The only way to make a better world is to perform small kindnesses. (Good)
Justice. A nation built upon just foundations will uphold freedom for all. (Law)
Expression. Music, joy, and laughter are the keys to freedom. (Good)
Self-Determination. People should be free to do as they please. (Chaotic)
Vigilance. A free people must be carefully taught, lest they be misled. (Neutral)
I lost someone important to an agent of the Dwendalian Empire. That regime will fall.
The first people to be hurt by this war will be the common folk. I need to protect them.
Music helped me through a dark time in my life. Now, I'll use music to change the world.
I will be known as the greatest spy who ever lived.
All life is precious to me. I know I can change the world without taking a humanoid life.
The elite in their ivory towers don't understand how we suffer. I intend to show them.
I've never lied once in my life. What? No, I'm not crossing my fingers!
I do everything big! Subtlety? I don't know the meaning of subtlety! Oh, that's a problem?
Being a spy in wartime is painful. I've seen so much suffering, I think I'm losing my mind.
I can't focus on my mission. I just want to carouse and sing and play!
Yeah, that's my name. Yeah, I'm a Grinner spy. Who cares about staying undercover?
I can't afford to trust anyone. Not. Anyone.

items.entry: Choose one of Draconic, Giant, Goblin, or Sylvan

entries.name: Feature: Rubblebelt Refuge
entries: Conoces a la perfección aquellas zonas de la ciudad que la mayoría de la gente evita: barrios en ruinas donde los gusanos han causado estragos, parques cubiertos de maleza que nadie ha cuidado en décadas y las vastas y extensas franjas de escombros y terreno accidentado que la gente civilizada abandonó hace mucho tiempo. En estas zonas puedes encontrar un lugar adecuado donde tú y tus aliados podáis esconderos o descansar. Además, cada día puedes encontrar comida y agua potable para ti y hasta otras cinco personas.

entries.name: Gruul Guild Spells
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

En tu caso, los hechizos de la tabla «Hechizos del gremio Gruul» se añaden a la lista de hechizos de tu clase con capacidad para lanzar hechizos. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de hechizos, estos hechizos se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries: Impulsada por el fuego de la ira que arde en tu corazón, tu magia casi siempre va acompañada de efectos llameantes, como llamas que arden en tus ojos o que bailan sobre tus manos.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Las costumbres de los Gruul no son las de la gente civilizada, y los Gruul tienen poca paciencia con las sutilezas sociales. Sin embargo, sí que tienen tradiciones y valores muy apreciados, tan importantes para ellos como los distintos valores que defiende la cultura urbana y cosmopolita de Rávnica.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: Unlike people, the beasts of the wild are friends who won't stab me in the back.
Go ahead and insult me—I dare you.
I scorn those who can't survive away from the comforts of the city.
Don't tell me I'm not allowed to do something.
Laws are for people who are afraid to face their inner beasts.
I smear the blood of my enemies over my skin.
I was, in fact, raised by maaka.
HarrRRAAGGHH! [I rarely form a coherent sentence and prefer to express myself by breaking things.]

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Clan}. My clan is all that really matters. (Any)
{@b Anarchy}. No person or law or custom can tell another what to do. (Chaotic)
{@b Nature}. We weren't born tame or domesticated, so we shouldn't have to live that way. (Neutral)
{@b Might}. The strongest are meant to dominate the weak. (Evil)
{@b Rage}. AAAAAARRRRggggh! [To live is to feel and express the rage burning in your belly.] (Chaotic)
{@b Tradition}. The Old Ways must be preserved and upheld. (Any)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I am determined that one day I will lead my clan—or a new one.
I would give my life for my clan chieftain.
The chieftain of another clan has a grudge against me.
I am devoted to a sacred site in the midst of the rubblebelt.
My weapon is made from the first raktusk I ever hunted.
GrrrRRAAAAGGHH! [I will do anything to prove myself greater than my siblings or ancestors.]

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: If you question my courage, I will never back down.
HrrrGGGAAAARRuuuh! [My anger in battle led to the death of a loved one.]
I'm as stubborn as a batterboar.
I'm so convinced of my superiority over soft, civilized people that I'll take great risks to prove it.
I'm easily manipulated by people I find attractive.
I'm not actually all that angry.

entries.name: Contacts
entries: Los miembros de los clanes Gruul se apoyan mutuamente, aun cuando compiten por el territorio y la gloria. Sus encuentros con miembros de otros gremios suelen ser más violentos que amistosos, pero en ocasiones se forjan vínculos.
Tira dos veces en la tabla de contactos de Gruul (para un aliado y un rival) y una vez en la tabla de contactos no Gruul.

entries.caption: Gruul Contacts
rows: One of my parents is a renowned warrior in my clan.
My sibling has the ear of the clan chief.
I have cousins in a different clan.
When we were younger, I was romantically involved with a prominent warrior in my clan.
A druid in my clan believes I have a destiny to fulfill.
The warrior who trained me remembers me for my exceptional potential.
My clan chief killed one of my parents, who had challenged the chief for leadership of the clan. Some combination of resentment and remorse stirs the clan chief to help me sometimes.
I made a strong impression on Borborygmos.

entries.caption: Non-Gruul Contacts
rows: An Azorius arrester thinks I can be reformed.
A Boros soldier gives me gifts in exchange for information about other clans' movements.
I once caught and released a Dimir spy.
I consult with a Golgari shaman for spiritual guidance at times.
Roll an additional Gruul contact; you can decide if the contact is an ally or a rival.
An Izzet scientist blames the Gruul for the destruction of his life's work in a raid, but seems to think that I'm not like other Gruul.
I foolishly borrowed money from an Orzhov syndic to indulge a shameful vice.
A close friend left our clan and joined the Cult of Rakdos.
A distant relative is trying to recruit me into the Selesnya Conclave.
I stopped a Simic biomancer from trapping wild beasts to perform vile experiments on them.

entries.name: How Do I Fit In?
entries: Con un objetivo sencillo, tu papel es muy claro: luchar. Da rienda suelta a tu ira. Derriba edificios y derrota a quienes se interpongan en tu camino. Sé Gruul, a tu manera.

Con frecuencia te convocarán para participar en una incursión que tu clan vaya a lanzar contra la ciudad o contra un grupo de sus defensores. El líder de tu clan también podría enviarte a una misión especial, aunque es casi seguro que seguiría considerándose una incursión. Podrías unirte a un pequeño grupo de guerreros Gruul en una peligrosa incursión en las calles pobladas para saquear un lugar concreto, recuperar un objeto robado a tu clan o asaltar una guarnición Boros.

A veces, tu objetivo puede ser más esotérico. Dado que las profecías sobre el regreso de Ilharg, el Jabalí Devastador, se extienden como la pólvora entre los druidas de Gruul, es posible que te pidan que lleves a cabo alguna tarea que, según ellos, acelerará su llegada. Dicha tarea podría consistir en recuperar una reliquia sagrada guardada en una cámara acorazada de Orzhov o en reunir ofrendas para una gran ceremonia en honor al Jabalí Devastador.

entries.name: Feature: Guild Membership
entries: Como miembro consolidado y respetado de un gremio, puedes contar con ciertas ventajas que te ofrece la pertenencia al mismo. Tus compañeros de gremio te proporcionarán alojamiento y comida si es necesario, y se harán cargo de tu funeral en caso de que sea preciso. En algunas ciudades y pueblos, la sede del gremio ofrece un lugar céntrico donde reunirte con otros miembros de tu profesión, lo que puede ser un buen sitio para conocer a posibles mecenas, aliados o mercenarios.

Los gremios suelen ejercer un enorme poder político. Si te acusan de un delito, tu gremio te respaldará si se pueden aportar argumentos sólidos que demuestren tu inocencia o si el delito es justificable. Además, si eres un miembro de pleno derecho, podrás acceder a figuras políticas influyentes a través del gremio. Es posible que para establecer tales contactos sea necesario realizar donaciones de dinero o de objetos mágicos a las arcas del gremio.
Debes pagar una cuota mensual de 5 po al gremio. Si te atrasas en los pagos, deberás abonar las cuotas atrasadas para seguir contando con el favor del gremio.

entries.name: Specialty
entries: Los gremios suelen encontrarse en ciudades lo suficientemente grandes como para albergar a varios artesanos que se dedican al mismo oficio. Sin embargo, tu gremio podría ser también una red informal de artesanos que trabajan cada uno en un pueblo diferente dentro de un reino más amplio. Consulta con tu DJ para determinar la naturaleza de tu gremio. Puedes elegir la actividad de tu gremio en la tabla de actividades de gremios o tirarla al azar.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los artesanos de gremio se encuentran entre las personas más corrientes del mundo... hasta que dejan a un lado sus herramientas y se lanzan a una vida de aventuras. Entienden el valor del trabajo duro y la importancia de la comunidad, pero son propensos a caer en los pecados de la codicia y la avaricia.

rows: I believe that anything worth doing is worth doing right. I can't help it—I'm a perfectionist.
I'm a snob who looks down on those who can't appreciate fine art.
I always want to know how things work and what makes people tick.
I'm full of witty aphorisms and have a proverb for every occasion.
I'm rude to people who lack my commitment to hard work and fair play.
I like to talk at length about my profession.
I don't part with my money easily and will haggle tirelessly to get the best deal possible.
I'm well known for my work, and I want to make sure everyone appreciates it. I'm always taken aback when people haven't heard of me.
Community. It is the duty of all civilized people to strengthen the bonds of community and the security of civilization. (Lawful)
Generosity. My talents were given to me so that I could use them to benefit the world. (Good)
Freedom. Everyone should be free to pursue his or her own livelihood. (Chaotic)
Greed. I'm only in it for the money. (Evil)
People. I'm committed to the people I care about, not to ideals. (Neutral)
Aspiration. I work hard to be the best there is at my craft. (Any)
The workshop where I learned my trade is the most important place in the world to me.
I created a great work for someone, and then found them unworthy to receive it. I'm still looking for someone worthy.
I owe my guild a great debt for forging me into the person I am today.
I pursue wealth to secure someone's love.
One day I will return to my guild and prove that I am the greatest artisan of them all.
I will get revenge on the evil forces that destroyed my place of business and ruined my livelihood.
I'll do anything to get my hands on something rare or priceless.
I'm quick to assume that someone is trying to cheat me.
No one must ever learn that I once stole money from guild coffers.
I'm never satisfied with what I have—I always want more.
I would kill to acquire a noble title.
I'm horribly jealous of anyone who can outshine my handiwork. Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by rivals.

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Pobre

entries.name: Overview
entries: Eres uno de los cientos de pescadores y pescadoras de a pie que cada mañana llevan los productos del puerto de agua dulce de Mulmaster a los mercados de la ciudad. Has pasado innumerables días remando por las aguas de Mulmaster y sus alrededores, y las conoces, al igual que a los demás pescadores, estibadores y habitantes del puerto, mejor que nadie. Aunque has dejado atrás esa vida, sigues visitando el lugar de vez en cuando.

entries.name: Feature: Harborfolk
entries: Creciste en los muelles y las aguas del puerto de Mulmaster. La gente del puerto te recuerda y sigue tratándote como a uno de los suyos. Te dan la bienvenida a ti y a tus compañeros. Aunque es posible que te cobren por ello, siempre te ofrecerán la comida y el refugio que tengan; incluso te esconderán si te persigue la Guardia de la Ciudad (pero no si lo hacen los Halcones). Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Héroe popular».

rows: I am curious. I want to know why things are the way they are and why people do the things that they do.
I can't sing, but that never stops me from doing it, loudly. Everyone loves a good sea chanty!
I think the High Blade is doing a terrific job, don't you?
I'm very excited that the House Built on Gold is being restored. I am a zealous worshipper of Waukeen.
I am quite superstitious. I see portents in everyday occurrences.
I resent the rich and enjoy thwarting their plans and spoiling their fun in small ways.
I have a sea story to fit every occasion.
I'm a fisher, but I secretly detest eating fish. I will do anything to avoid it.
Calm. For all things, there is a tide. I set sail when it is right, and mend my nets when it is not. (Lawful)
Windblown. I go where the winds blow. No man or woman tells me where or when to sail. (Chaotic)
Aspiring. I will gain the favor of a Zor or Zora patron, maybe even one of the Blades! (Any)
Salty. I want people to look to me as an expert on plying Mulmaster Harbor. (Any)
Selfless. We are all children of the sea. I help everyone in peril afloat and ashore. (Good)
Let them Drown. I refuse to risk my hide to help others. They wouldn't help me if roles were reversed. (Evil)
I once lost everything but my rowboat. I'll do anything to protect it.
My brother was in the Soldiery, but he was killed. I really look up to the men and women who serve.
The Cloaks killed my friend for spellcasting. I'll get them back somehow, someday.
The High House of Hurting helped me when I was hurt and asked nothing in return. I owe them my life.
I was robbed in the Zhent ghetto once. It will not happen again.
I would do anything to protect the other harborfolk. They are my family.
I drink too much, which causes me to miss the tide.
I killed a drunk member of the City Watch in a brawl. I am terrified that they might find out.
I oversell myself and make promises I can't keep when I want to impress someone.
Book learning is a waste of time. I have no patience for people who don't speak from experience.
I almost always cheat. I can't help myself.
I am a secret informant for the Hawks. I send them reports about everything I see and hear, even what my friends and allies are up to.
