entries.name: Feature: Official Inquiry
entries: Tienes experiencia a la hora de acceder a personas y lugares para obtener la información que necesitas. Gracias a una combinación de labia, determinación y documentación de aspecto oficial, puedes acceder a un lugar o a una persona relacionada con el delito que estás investigando. Quienes no están involucrados en tu investigación evitan ponerte trabas o transmiten tus peticiones. Además, las fuerzas del orden locales tienen opiniones muy marcadas sobre ti, y te ven como una molestia o como uno de los suyos.

entries.name: Path to Mystery
entries: Tu primer caso influyó en el tipo de misterios que te interesan. ¿Por qué fue ese caso tan impactante, personal o traumático? ¿A quién más afectó, además de a ti? ¿Por qué y cómo te involucraste? ¿Se resolvió? ¿Cómo te llevó a dedicarte a investigar otros misterios? Sigue leyendo o elige detalles de la tabla «Primer caso» para desarrollar el misterio que marcó el inicio de tu carrera como investigador.

entries.caption: First Case
rows: A friend was wrongfully accused of murder. You tracked down the actual killer, proving your friend's innocence and starting your career as a detective.
You're told you went missing for weeks. When you were found, you had no memory of being gone. Now you search to discover what happened to you.
You helped a spirit find peace by finding its missing corpse. Ever since, other spectral clients have sought you out to help them find rest.
You revealed that the monsters terrorizing your home were illusions created by a cruel mage. The magic-user escaped, but you've continued to uncover magical hoaxes.
You were wrongfully accused and convicted of a crime. You managed to escape and seek to help others avoid the experience you suffered, even while still being pursued by the law.

You survived the destructive use of a magic device that wiped out your home. Members of a secret organization found you. You now work with them, tracking down dangerous supernatural phenomena and preventing them from doing harm.
You found evidence of a conspiracy underpinning society. You tried to expose this mysterious cabal, but no one believed you. You're still trying to prove what you know is true.
You got a job with an agency that investigates crimes that local law enforcement can't solve. You often wonder which you value more, the truth or your pay.

entries.name: Horror Characteristics
entries: Characters in a horror-focused campaign might have distinct motivations and characteristics. Use the following tables to supplement your background's suggested characteristics or to inspire those of your own design.

entries.caption: Horror Character Personality Traits
rows: I had an encounter that I believe gives me a special affinity with a supernatural creature or event.
A signature piece of clothing or distinct weapon serves as an emblem of who I am.
I never accept that I'm out of my depth.
I must know the answer to every secret. No door remains unopened in my presence.
I let people underestimate me, revealing my full competency only to those close to me.
I compulsively seek to collect trophies of my travels and victories.
It doesn't matter if the whole world's against me. I'll always do what I think is right.
I have morbid interests and a macabre aesthetic.
I have a personal ritual, mantra, or relaxation method I use to deal with stress.
Nothing is more important than life, and I never leave anyone in danger.
I'm quick to jump to extreme solutions. Why risk a lesser option not working?
I'm easily startled, but I'm not a coward.

entries.caption: Horror Character Ideals
rows: Adrenaline. I've experienced such strangeness that now I feel alive only in extreme situations.
Balance. I strive to counter the deeds of someone for whom I feel responsible.
Bound. I've wronged someone and must work their will to avoid their curse.
Escape. I believe there is something beyond the world I know, and I need to find it.
Legacy. I must do something great so that I'm remembered, and my time is running out.
Misdirection. I work vigorously to keep others from realizing my flaws or misdeeds.
Obsession. I've lived this way for so long that I can't imagine another way.
Obligation. I owe it to my people, faith, family, or teacher to continue a vaunted legacy.
Promise. My life is no longer my own. I must fulfill the dream of someone who's gone.
Revelation. I need to know what lies beyond the mysteries of death, the world, or the Mists.
Sanctuary. I know the forces at work in the world and strive to create islands apart from them.
Truth. I care about the truth above all else, even if it doesn't benefit anyone.

entries.caption: Horror Character Bonds
rows: I desperately need to get back to someone or someplace, but I lost them in the Mists.
Everything I do is in the service of a powerful master, one I must keep a secret from everyone.
I owe much to my vanished mentor. I seek to continue their work even as I search to find them.
I've seen great darkness, and I'm committed to being a light against it—the light of all lights.
Someone I love has become a monster, murderer, or other threat. It's up to me to redeem them.
The world has been convinced of a terrible lie. It's up to me to reveal the truth.
I deeply miss someone and am quick to adopt people who remind me of them.
A great evil dwells within me. I will fight against it and the world's other evils for as long as I can.
I'm desperately seeking a cure to an affliction or a curse, either for someone close to me for myself.
Spirits are drawn to me. I do all I can to help them find peace.
I use my cunning mind to solve mysteries and find justice for those who've been wronged.
I lost someone I care about, but I still see them in guilty visions, recurring dreams, or as a spirit.

entries.caption: Horror Character Flaws
rows: I believe doom follows me and that anyone who gets close to me will face a tragic end.
I'm convinced something is after me, appearing in mirrors, dreams, and places where no one could.
I'm especially superstitious and live life seeking to avoid bad luck, wicked spirits, or the Mists.
I've done unspeakable evil and will do anything to prevent others from finding out.
I am exceptionally credulous and believe any story or legend immediately.
I'm a skeptic and don't believe in the power of rituals, religion, superstition, or spirits.
I know my future is written and that anything I do will lead to a prophesied end.
I need to find the best in everyone and everything, even when that means denying obvious malice.
I've seen the evil of a type of place—like forests, cities, or graveyards—and resist going there.
I'm exceptionally cautious, planning laboriously and devising countless contingencies.
I have a reputation for defeating a great evil, but that's a lie and the wicked force knows.
I know the ends always justify the means and am quick to make sacrifices to attain my goals.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set}, {@filter vehicles (land)|items|source=phb;dmg|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (land)}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of dark {@item common clothes|phb}, {@item pack saddle|phb}, {@item burglar's pack|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Pobre

entries.name: Overview
entries: La Ruta del Hierro, que en su día fue la principal ruta comercial entre Phlan y Zhentil Keep, solía ser un lugar donde abundaba el bandolerismo hasta la reciente ocupación de Phlan. Tu pasado como bandido te ha proporcionado mucha experiencia a lomos de un caballo y un don especial para adquirir y valorar, entre otras cosas, las monturas, mascotas y vehículos ajenos. Este conjunto de habilidades en particular te ha reportado grandes beneficios al trabajar en la clandestinidad como ladrón de caballos para un gremio local de ladrones y otras organizaciones oscuras.

entries.name: Feature: Black-Market Breeder
entries: Sabes cómo localizar a personas que siempre están buscando animales y vehículos robados, ya sea para organizar peleas de animales o para proporcionar a algunos delincuentes desesperados los medios para escapar más rápido a lomos de un animal durante un trabajo ilegal. Este contacto no solo te proporciona información sobre qué animales y vehículos tienen mayor demanda en la zona, sino que también te ofrece favores e información (a elección del DJ) si le llevas dichos animales y vehículos. Nota: Esta es una variante de la característica «Contacto criminal».

rows: If people leave their gear unsecured, they must not want it very much.
I feel more comfortable sleeping under the open sky.
I always pre-plan my escape should things go bad; I always like to have an exit strategy.
I tend to give animal owners breeding and care advice whether or not they want it.
I lost a pet as a child and sadly reflect on it to this day.
I always form a powerful, emotional bond with my mount.
I recoil at the thought of killing someone else's pet or mount.
I prefer to hang to the back of a scuffle or discussion. Better to have my enemies in front of me.
Loyalty. Never bite the hand that feeds. (Good)
Unpredictability. Keep your enemy guessing and off-balance like a confused deer. (Chaotic)
Power. I strive to become leader of the pack at all costs. (Lawful)
Freedom. I bow to no one I don't respect. (Chaotic)
Resourcefulness. Our wits are our most valuable resource in troubled times. (Any)
Unity. Lone wolves fail where the pack succeeds. (Any)
I cannot leave a harmed animal behind; I must save it or put it out of its misery.
I leave behind my own personal calling cards when I do a job.
I do not trust people who do not have a pet, mount, or furry companion.
The pelt I wear on my back was from an animal that died saving my life, I will always cherish it.
If my pet does not like you, I do not like you!
Once you've ridden with me and fought by my side, I'll be there for you odds be damned.
I talk to animals; I believe they understand me, even if they do not.
I growl at and bite anyone who gets too close to my food while I am eating.
I strongly dislike enclosed spaces and require intoxication or firm encouragement to enter them.
I robbed the wrong caravan once. The owner is a powerful merchant who holds a grudge.
I'm an inveterate gambler.
I judge people based on how well they stand their ground in a fight. I got not time for cowards...

_.special: the charred and twisted remains of a failed experiment

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: Choose one of Draconic, Goblin, or Vedalken

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: An Izzet insignia, one set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, the charred and twisted remains of a failed experiment, a {@item hammer|phb}, a {@item block and tackle|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp (Azorius 1-zino coins)

entries.name: Feature: Urban Infrastructure
entries: La idea generalizada que se tiene de la Liga Izzet se basa en inventos descabellados, experimentos peligrosos y explosiones. Gran parte de esa percepción es acertada, pero la liga también se dedica a tareas cotidianas de construcción y arquitectura, principalmente a la creación de las infraestructuras que permiten a los habitantes de Ravnica disfrutar de agua corriente, plataformas levitantes y otras maravillas mágicas y tecnológicas.

Tienes conocimientos básicos sobre la estructura de los edificios, incluyendo lo que hay detrás de las paredes. También puedes conseguir planos de un edificio concreto para conocer los detalles de su construcción. Esos planos pueden revelar puntos de acceso, puntos débiles de la estructura o espacios secretos. Tu acceso a esa información no es ilimitado. Si obtener o utilizar esa información te mete en problemas con la ley, el gremio no podrá protegerte de las consecuencias.

entries.name: Izzet Guild Spells
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

En tu caso, los hechizos de la tabla de hechizos del gremio Izzet se añaden a la lista de hechizos de tu clase con capacidad para lanzar hechizos. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de hechizos, estos hechizos se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Izzet Guild Spells
rows: Cantrip
{@spell produce flame}, {@spell shocking grasp}
1st
{@spell chaos bolt|XGE}, {@spell create or destroy water}, {@spell unseen servant}
2nd
{@spell heat metal}, {@spell rope trick}
3rd
{@spell call lightning}, {@spell elemental weapon}, {@spell glyph of warding}
4th
{@spell conjure minor elementals}, {@spell divination}, {@spell Otiluke's resilient sphere}
5th
{@spell animate objects}, {@spell conjure elemental}

entries: Tus hechizos suelen ser ruidosos, llamativos o explosivos, incluso cuando el efecto es insignificante. Por ejemplo, cuando abres el portal de un hechizo {@spell rope trick}, es posible que el portal esté rodeado de destellos inofensivos pero llamativos.

Si utilizas un foco arcano, probablemente adopte la forma de un artilugio complejo que podría incluir guanteletes metálicos, frascos de cristal, tubos de cobre y correas de cuero para sujetarlo al cuerpo. El {@item mizzium apparatus|GGR} descrito en {@book chapter 5|GGR|4|Mizzium Apparatus} es una versión mágica de este equipo.
El hechizo {@spell chaos bolt|XGE} es uno de los favoritos de los lanzadores de hechizos de Izzet debido a su naturaleza impredecible.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los miembros de la Liga Izzet combinan, en proporciones variables, una energía caótica y frenética con la curiosidad intelectual. Algunos se dedican a actividades académicas, mientras que a otros simplemente les encantan las explosiones.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I have a hard time staying focused on... oh, and my brain tends to jump from one... did I mention focus?
I get really excited about my ideas and I can't wait to talk about them and start putting them into practice and tinkering with them and I want to tell you about how exciting it all is!
It's not magic—or anything, really—if you do it only halfway. Whatever I do, I give it all I've got.
I do what my gut tells me.
Life's an experiment, and I can't wait to see what happens.
I pepper my speech with the incomprehensible jargon of my trade, like mizzium droplets inserted into a weird-field suspension.
Great ideas are fine, but great results are what counts.
If you can guess what I'm about to do, that means I've run out of imagination.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Guild}. My guild is all that really matters. (Any)
{@b Creativity}. Half the world's troubles come from stodgy thinking, stuck in the past. We need innovative solutions. (Chaotic)
{@b Discovery}. Every experiment has the potential to reveal more secrets of the multiverse. (Any)
{@b Science}. A rigorous application of logical principles and protocols will lead us toward progress more surely than any belief system. (Lawful)
{@b Fun}. I love my job! Despite the dangerous working conditions, there's nothing I'd rather do. (Chaotic)
{@b Power}. Someday I'll find or create the magic that will make me the most powerful being in Ravnica. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I have dedicated my life to finding a solution to a scientific problem.
I'll never forget the laboratory where I learned my skills, or the other attendants who learned alongside me.
I'm convinced it was sabotage that destroyed my first laboratory and killed many of my friends, and I seek revenge against whoever did it.
I have the schematics for an invention that I hope to build one day, once I have the necessary resources.
A fellow student and I are racing to solve the same scientific puzzle.
I would do anything the guildmaster told me to do.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: If there's a plan, I'll probably forget it. If I don't forget it, I'll probably ignore it.
I get bored easily, and if nothing is happening I'll make something happen.
Nothing is ever simple, and if it seems simple, I'll find a way to make it complicated.
I tend to ignore sleep for days when I'm conducting research, often at the expense of my own health and safety.
I'm convinced there's not a soul in Ravnica, except maybe the great Niv-Mizzet, who can match my boundless intellect.
I'm incapable of admitting a flaw in my logic.

entries.name: Contacts
entries: Los laboratorios de la Liga Izzet están constantemente poniendo en marcha nuevos proyectos y cerrando otros antiguos, por lo que incluso al asistente más humilde le resulta fácil hacer amigos (y enemigos) en los laboratorios de toda Ravnica.
Tira dos veces en la tabla de «Contactos de Izzet» (para un aliado y un rival) y una vez en la tabla de «Contactos que no son de Izzet».

entries.caption: Izzet Contacts
rows: An older relative is a member of the guild's board of directors.
I know a sprite who carries important messages among the guild's laboratories.
A sibling is the head of a laboratory doing exotic research.
A former colleague is now an attendant in a laboratory in the central guildhall.
I'm in regular communication with an instructor who set me on the course of my life and research.
I had a romance with a chemister working in the Blistercoils.
As an attendant, I had a fierce rivalry with another attendant for our supervisor's attention.
The guildmaster, Niv-Mizzet, took note of one of my experiments!

entries.caption: Non-Izzet Contacts
rows: An Azorius inspector seems interested in my work.
I was ready to join the Boros before I decided on Izzet, and I sometimes still hear from the sergeant who tried to recruit me.
One of my former assistants turned out to be a Dimir spy. We're not on friendly terms anymore, but we have a habit of running into each other.
A Golgari assassin killed a bitter rival of mine, leaving me with conflicted feelings.
I helped a minor Gruul chieftain acquire an Izzet weapon.
Roll an additional Izzet contact; you can decide if the contact is an ally or a rival.
An Orzhov banker financed my laboratory's current work and expects great returns.
I have a cousin in the Cult of Rakdos, and we get along quite well.
A former attendant from the same laboratory ran off to join the Selesnya, and we get into a big argument every time we run into each other.
I compare notes and techniques with a Simic scientist over lunch sometimes.

entries.name: How Do I Fit In?
entries: Sea cual sea tu función en la Liga Izzet, se espera que contribuyas de alguna manera a sus investigaciones. Esa contribución puede consistir en participar en pruebas, ya sea como asistente, investigador o sujeto de estudio. Podrías ser uno de los soldados que protegen un laboratorio, o un obrero encargado de colocar equipos pesados en su sitio. La contribución de todos es importante, aunque los Izzet saben que algunas cuentan más que otras.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: An insignia of rank, a {@item playing card set|phb|deck of cards}, a set of {@item common clothes|PHB}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Squire of Solamnia
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Squire of Solamnia|DSotDQ}.
Además, los Caballeros de Solamnia te ofrecen alojamiento y comida gratuitos y sencillos en cualquiera de sus fortalezas o campamentos.

entries.name: Building a Knight of Solamnia Character
entries: Cualquier clase que posea destreza marcial puede encajar bien en los Caballeros de Solamnia. Los {@class Fighter||Fighters} y los {@class paladin||paladins} constituyen el grueso de las fuerzas de la orden. También se pueden encontrar {@class Cleric||Clerics} (a menudo con el dominio {@class Cleric|PHB|War|War}) entre las filas de los caballeros.

Si quieres darle un toque más original a tu personaje de Caballero de Solamnia, plantéate interpretar a un bardo de la {@class Bard|PHB|College of Valor|Valor} (o el {@class Bard|PHB|College of Swords|Swords|XGE} de {@book Xanathar's Guide to Everything|XGE}) o un {@class barbarian} dedicado a los ideales del dios de la naturaleza {@deity Habbakuk|dragonlance} (quizás adoptando el {@class barbarian||Path of the Zealot|Zealot|xge} de {@book Xanathar's Guide to Everything|XGE}).

entries.name: Knight of Solamnia Trinkets
entries: Cuando crees tu personaje, tira una vez en la tabla de abalorios de los Caballeros de Solamnia en lugar de en la {@item Trinket|PHB|Trinkets table} del Manual del Jugador para elegir tu abalorio inicial.

entries.caption: Knight of Solamnia Trinkets
rows: A flat silver disk you record your heroics upon
A piece of a fallen knight's armor
A pendant featuring a crown, a rose, or a sword
The pommel of your mentor's sword
A meaningful favor from someone you defended—perhaps a handkerchief or glove
A locket with a sketch of a silver dragon inside

_.special: signet, banner, or seal representing your place or rank in the order

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Persuasion}, plus one from among {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Nature}, and {@skill Religion}, as appropriate for your order

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Your choice of a {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} or a {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, a signet, banner, or seal representing your place or rank in the order, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Knightly Regard
entries: Recibes refugio y socorro de los miembros de tu orden de caballería y de quienes simpatizan con sus objetivos. Si tu orden es de carácter religioso, puedes obtener ayuda de los templos y otras comunidades religiosas de tu deidad. Los caballeros de órdenes cívicas pueden recibir ayuda de la comunidad —ya sea un asentamiento aislado o una gran nación— a la que sirven, y los caballeros de órdenes filosóficas pueden encontrar ayuda en aquellos a quienes han ayudado en la búsqueda de sus ideales, así como en quienes comparten dichos ideales.

Esta ayuda se materializa en forma de alojamiento y comida, y de cuidados médicos cuando es necesario, así como en actos de asistencia que en ocasiones entrañan riesgos, como cuando un grupo de ciudadanos locales se une para socorrer a un caballero que se encuentra en una situación desesperada, o cuando los partidarios de la orden ayudan a sacar clandestinamente de la ciudad a un caballero perseguido injustamente.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Utiliza las tablas del fondo «soldado de fondo» del Manual del Jugador como base para tus rasgos y motivaciones, modificando las entradas cuando sea necesario para adaptarlas a tu identidad como caballero de tu orden.

Tu compromiso casi siempre está ligado a la orden a la que perteneces (o, al menos, a sus miembros más destacados), y es muy poco habitual que los ideales de un caballero no reflejen los objetivos, los sentimientos o la filosofía de su orden.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of black ink}, an {@item ink pen|PHB}, a {@item hammer|PHB}, a {@item hooded lantern|PHB}, a {@item tinderbox|PHB}, a tome of history, a school uniform, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Lorehold Initiate
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Strixhaven Initiate|SCC} y debes elegir Lorehold dentro de ella.

Además, si tienes la característica «Lanzamiento de conjuros» o «Magia de pacto», los conjuros de la tabla «Conjuros de Lorehold» se añaden a la lista de conjuros de tu clase de lanzador de conjuros. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de conjuros, estos conjuros se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Lorehold Spells
rows: 1st
{@spell Comprehend Languages}, {@spell Identify}
2nd
{@spell Borrowed Knowledge|SCC}, {@spell Locate Object}
3rd
{@spell Speak with Dead}, {@spell Spirit Guardians}
4th
{@spell Arcane Eye}, {@spell Stone Shape}
5th
{@spell Flame Strike}, {@spell Legend Lore}

entries: Piensa en personalizar el aspecto de tus hechizos cuando los lances. Tus hechizos de Lorehold podrían generar destellos de luz dorada. Podrías utilizar un tomo o un pergamino como objeto de concentración, y los efectos de tus hechizos podrían reflejar el aspecto de los libros de referencia que estudias.

entries.name: Building a Lorehold Character
entries: Cualquier clase o subclase relacionada con el conocimiento del pasado puede encajar bien en Lorehold. Los bardos prosperan en Lorehold, y los magos (especialmente los de la {@class Wizard|PHB|School of Divination|Divination|PHB}) son numerosos entre sus estudiantes. Los clérigos (a menudo con los dominios {@class Cleric|PHB|Knowledge|Knowledge|PHB} o {@class Cleric|PHB|Light|Light|PHB}) también son bastante comunes.

Si quieres darle un toque más original a un estudiante de Lorehold, podrías plantearte interpretar a un bárbaro con una conexión primigenia con el pasado (quizás adoptando la {@class Barbarian|PHB|Path of the Ancestral Guardian|Ancestral Guardian|XGE} de {@book Xanathar's Guide to Everything|XGE}) o un paladín cuyo {@class Paladin|PHB|Oath of the Ancients|Ancients|PHB} le proporcione un vínculo concreto con la historia.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Entre las filas de la academia de Lorehold se encuentran tanto historiadores metódicos como aventureros audaces. La tabla de rasgos de personalidad de Lorehold sugiere una variedad de rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

entries.caption: Lorehold Personality Traits
rows: I thrive on esoteric lore. The more obscure the historical references I can include in everyday conversation, the better.
By searching for these lost artifacts, I hope to find who I really am along the way.
I can barely go a minute without talking about my research. I have so much knowledge in my head, and it needs to be let out somewhere!
The spirits of the dead are so much more interesting to talk with than living classmates.
I can speak eloquently about the historical ramifications of an ancient war. But ask me to add two-digit numbers together, and I'm a mess.
In the end, it's all just entropy. Everything falls apart someday.

entries.name: Lorehold Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla {@item Lorehold Trinket|SCC|Lorehold Trinkets}, en lugar de en la tabla {@item trinket|phb|Trinkets table} del {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, para elegir tu abalorio inicial.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Your choice of two of the following: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, or {@skill Persuasion}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, a student uniform, a {@item writing kit|TDCSR} ({@item pouch|PHB|small pouch} with a quill, {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|ink}, {@item Parchment (one sheet)|PHB|folded parchment} and a penknife), and a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Academic Requisition
entries: Has completado suficientes lecciones —y te has ganado uno o dos aliados entre el personal— como para poder acceder a ciertas zonas privadas del {@book Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} y otras universidades aliadas. Siempre que te encuentres en las instalaciones del {@book Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} o en otra institución académica importante, puedes requisar cualquier juego de {@filter tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} que se encuentre en las reglas de la quinta edición. Cada juego de {@filter tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} está marcado mágicamente para que suene una alarma si se saca del recinto de la universidad.

Cuando solicites servicios como el lanzamiento de hechizos a un PNJ del {@book Alabaster Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} o de una institución similar, podrás disfrutar de un descuento del 25 %, a criterio del DJ.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: El {@book Alabaster Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} admite a estudiantes de todos los oficios principales, las bellas artes y las artes mágicas. Los alumnos con el talento y los privilegios suficientes para ser admitidos viajan a {@book Emon|TDCSR|3|Emon, the City of Fellowship} desde todos los rincones de Tal'Dorei, con el deseo de estudiar junto a algunas de las mentes más brillantes y los arcanistas más talentosos del reino. Si procedes de una ciudad más pequeña, de una zona rural o de las zonas salvajes relativamente inexploradas de Tal'Dorei, estudiar en el {@book Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} puede que te haya dejado con una sensación de choque cultural, para bien o para mal.

Es probable que tu vínculo esté relacionado con tus objetivos como estudiante o graduado. Tu ideal probablemente incluya tus esperanzas de utilizar los conocimientos que has adquirido en el {@book Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} y tus viajes como aventurero para moldear el mundo a tu gusto.

entries.caption: Lyceum Scholar Personality Traits
rows: I can't believe I'm here! At the {@book Alabaster Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum}. Oh, gods, I've dreamed of this my whole life, and now I'm here!
I can't believe I squandered all the opportunities I had at school. I was supposed to be learning good stuff, but I wasted it all daydreaming about fighting monsters.
Every night at school, I'd knock back a couple of meads and read with my pals! Just a bunch of nerds having fun, and I loved it.
Everyone at school was such a stick in the mud. Dressing the same, listening to the same bards...ugh, it's sad. Just be yourself.
I'm happiest when I've got my little party with me. At school, it was like we were a squad of heroes, slaying projects like monsters.
I'd really rather you didn't bother me. Can't you see I'm studying here?
I don't care. I just don't care about it all. The dates I had to memorize, the formulae I learned...I just want to run away and live!
I'm just...tired. All the time. Oh, adventuring, sure, that's fine, as long as I can find time to...nap...goodnight.

entries.caption: Lyceum Scholar Ideals
rows: {@b Preparedness}. I can't go out into the world unless I know what I'm up against. Study first, act later. (Neutral)
{@b Stardom}. Having a team is good and all, but you can't win a game of ball without the star charger, and you know that's me. (Evil)
{@b Individuality}. The world keeps us down by trying to put us all into little boxes. I'm tired of living in my box, and I don't care what you think about it. (Chaotic)
{@b Purpose}. I study because there are things I need to know. I'll find my place in the world, and I'll make the world better. (Good)
{@b Code of Conduct}. The student code is there to benefit all students, you know. It's the same for laws! (Lawful)
{@b Recreation}. All this studying crap wasn't worth anything if you weren't partying when you were done. Meet me down at the tavern, okay? (Chaotic)

entries.caption: Lyceum Scholar Bonds
rows: I came to the {@book Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} with no one, but I fell in love with the city of {@book Emon|TDCSR|3|Emon, the City of Fellowship}. I've finally found a place that feels like home!
Most of my professors drove me to frustration, but there's one who was kind and wise. I know they'll always have my back.
My family saved every copper piece to give me the opportunities I have now. I can't let them down.
I came to the {@book Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} with a childhood friend, but we've long been drifting apart.
Discovery is the only thing that matters to me. The topic doesn't matter. Books keep me company on my loneliest days.
The {@book Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} is my life. I'd give up anything—everything—to protect it from harm.

entries.caption: Lyceum Scholar Flaws
rows: The {@book Lyceum|TDCSR|3|5. Alabaster Lyceum} taught me to never want to leave my room. The campus was so huge, and the crowds were so horrible.
You think you're so great just because you've got muscles, and endurance, and...shut up! Read a book sometime!
Huh? What? Sorry, I was thinking about a test I need to retake when I get back to school....
I spent too much time studying. Now I don't have any friends.
If you don't match my aesthetic, I'm not interested in you. We can work together, but we won't be friends. Got it?
I'm always striving for perfection. I got top of my class, sure, but only with a 98 average. And that's. Not. Perfect.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of colored ink}, an {@item ink pen|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Initiate of High Sorcery
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Initiate of High Sorcery|DSotDQ}.

Además, los Magos de la Alta Hechicería te proporcionan alojamiento y comida gratuitos y modestos de forma indefinida en cualquier Torre de la Alta Hechicería ocupada, así como durante una noche en el domicilio de un miembro de la organización.

entries.name: Building a Mage of High Sorcery Character
entries: Los Magos de la Alta Hechicería suelen ser hechiceros, brujos o magos, y pueden pertenecer a cualquier subclase. Los lanzadores de hechizos que obtienen su magia a través de la devoción suelen ser menos bienvenidos entre los magos tradicionalistas. No obstante, los Magos de la Alta Hechicería son astutos y rara vez dejan pasar oportunidades únicas o a personas excepcionales. Incluso los miembros de clases marciales que se entrenan en magia pueden encontrar un lugar excepcional entre las tres órdenes del grupo.

entries.name: Mage of High Sorcery Trinkets
entries: Cuando crees tu personaje, tira una vez en la tabla de abalorios del Mago de Alta Hechicería en lugar de en la {@item trinket|phb|Trinkets table} del Manual del Jugador para elegir tu abalorio inicial.

entries.caption: Mage of High Sorcery Trinkets
rows: An unopened letter from your first teacher
A broken wand made of black, red, or white wood
A scroll bearing an incomprehensible formula
A purposeless device covered in colored stones that can fold into various enigmatic shapes
A pouch or spellbook emblazoned with the triple moon symbol of the Mages of High Sorcery
A lens through which you can see Krynn's invisible black moon, Nuitari

_.special: satchel for material components and potions

b.displayName: other trinket of importance to you

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Two of the following: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Deception}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Perception}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Either calligraphers' supplies or alchemists' supplies

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A gnarled {@item wand|PHB} made of wood, a duster jacket, a satchel for material components and potions, an {@item amulet|PHB} or other {@item trinket|PHB} of importance to you

rows: My eyes are two different colours.
Whenever I cast a spell, my voice echoes and an unknown wind seems to blow around me.
My eyes glow with octarine light when I am casting spells.
I hear voices and sounds when close to magical entities, as if the magic itself speaks to me.
I have full conversations with myself out loud that occasionally can get heated.
Magic floods my mind and makes it difficult to sleep without constant nightmares and visions.
I speak to beings from other planes of existence who manifest as simple creatures before me.
I have a birthmark in a unique shape that appears every day for 2 and a half hours, then vanishes.

entries.name: Feature: Bookworm
entries: Una vez al día, tras completar un descanso largo, puedes dedicar una hora a crear un pergamino de hechizo. Para ello solo necesitas papel y tinta, y el nivel del hechizo que puedes crear es igual a la mitad de tu bonificación de competencia (redondeada a la baja) o inferior. El pergamino que crees debe corresponder a un hechizo que conozcas o hayas preparado. Se desintegra en polvo al cabo de 24 horas.

entries.caption: Suggested Characteristics
rows: I idolize one of the archmages of the Academy and hope to prove myself to them in time.
Nothing will get between me and my goals. When people say something I care about is impossible, I prove them wrong.
I am confident in my powers, and do not fear the horrors of Drakkenheim, for I can bend reality.
I am constantly reading books. The more knowledge I can obtain, the more I can outwit friends and foes alike.
I am a mage for hire and am not afraid to use my magic to get my hands dirty. A lot of people will pay top coin for a skillset like mine.
I am a sucker for a good mystery and pride myself in my ability to solve them.
Everyone is always so serious - we all die in the end, might as well enjoy the ride.
I always push myself to be the best at whatever it is I set out to do.
Respect. My powers are a blessing and a curse, and I work diligently to show people not to fear magic. (Good)
Knowledge. I left the Academy on good terms to work at one of the many historical institutes of the world, hoping that my love for books and history would be of use. (Any)
Love. I left the Academy due to love, and I plan to keep my promise to that love. (Good)
Forgiveness. I must undo the mistakes of my past by proving myself to those I care about most. (Good)
Power. Delerium is power, and I must learn all I can about its origins and properties if I am to harness that power. (Chaotic)
Independence. I stand alone from the Academy for a reason. I do not wish to be on their bad side, but I do not wish to be on their good side either. (Neutral)
It is my duty to protect the Amethyst Academy.
My life's work in the study of delerium caused my expulsion. I must continue that research to prove its value.
The mysteries of my past and my power are tied to the meteor. I need answers.
My terrible mistake was covered up by my mentor in the Academy. I owe them my life.
My nightmares have guided me to Drakkenheim. I must investigate these visions.
I come from a long line of wizards, my exit from the Academy was highly upsetting to them and I need to earn my way back into their favour, even if it means risking my life in Drakkenheim.
I walk straight into danger. What's the worst that could happen?
I believe my plan is always far superior to everyone else's.
I am distracted by possibilities of gaining knowledge or power, regardless of the cost or danger.
I overcomplicate most situations with small details and over analyzing simple things.
I get angry quickly, and cause more harm than good with my magic when I get mad.
I can't get enough delerium. I want the power for myself.

_.displayName: dagger that belonged to a fallen comrade

_.special: folded flag emblazoned with the symbol of your ship or company

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item dagger|phb} that belonged to a fallen comrade, a folded flag emblazoned with the symbol of your ship or company, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Steady
entries: Puedes desplazarte el doble de lo habitual (hasta 16 horas) cada día antes de que te afecte el efecto de una marcha forzada (consulta «Ritmo de desplazamiento» en el capítulo 8 del Manual del Jugador). Además, puedes encontrar automáticamente una ruta segura para atracar una embarcación en la costa, siempre que exista dicha ruta.

entries.name: Hardship Endured
entries: Las adversidades que has vivido te han convertido en un arma viviente imparable. Estas adversidades son fundamentales para ti y constituyen el núcleo de una filosofía o código ético personal que suele guiar tus acciones. Puedes consultar la siguiente tabla para determinar cuáles son estas adversidades o elegir las que mejor se adapten a tu personaje.

rows: Nearly Drowned. You hid underwater to avoid detection by enemies and held your breath for an extremely long time. Just before you would have died, you had a revelation about your existence.
Captured. You spent months enduring thirst, starvation, and torture at the hands of your enemy, but you never broke.
Sacrifice. You enabled the escape of your fellow soldiers, but at great cost to yourself. Some of your past comrades may think you're dead.
Juggernaut. No reasonable explanation can explain how you survived a particular battle. Every arrow and bolt missed you. You slew scores of enemies single-handedly and led your comrades to victory.
Stowaway. For days, you hid in the bilge of an enemy ship, surviving on brackish water and foolhardy rats. At the right moment, you crept up to the deck and took over the ship on your own.
Leave None Behind. You carried an injured marine for miles to avoid capture and death.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los marines son admirados por otros soldados y respetados por sus superiores. Son guerreros veteranos que rara vez pierden la compostura en el campo de batalla. Los marines que abandonan el servicio suelen trabajar como mercenarios, pero su experiencia en combate también los convierte en excelentes aventureros. Aunque son autosuficientes, los marines suelen rendir mejor en grupo, ya que valoran la camaradería y la compañía de personas afines.

entries.caption: Marine Personality Traits
rows: I speak rarely but mean every word I say.
I laugh loudly and see the humor in stressful situations.
I prefer to solve problems without violence, but I finish fights decisively.
I enjoy being out in nature; poor weather never sours my mood.
I am dependable.
I am always working on some project or other.
I become cantankerous and quiet in the rain.
When the sea is within my sight, my mood is jovial and optimistic.

entries.caption: Marine Ideals
rows: {@b Teamwork.} Success depends on cooperation and communication. (Good)
{@b Code.} The marines' code provides a solution for every problem, and following it is imperative. (Lawful)
{@b Embracing.} Life is messy. Throwing yourself into the worst of it is necessary to get the job done. (Chaotic)
{@b Might.} The strong train so that they might rule those who are weak. (Evil)
{@b Bravery.} To act when others quake in fear—this is the essence of the warrior. (Any)
{@b Perseverance.} No injury or obstacle can turn me from my goal. (Any)

entries.caption: Marine Bonds
rows: I face danger and evil to offset an unredeemable act in my past.
I. Will. Finish. The. Job.
I must set an example of hope for those who have given up.
I'm searching for a fellow marine captured by an elusive enemy.
Fear leads to tyranny, and both must be eradicated.
My commander betrayed my unit, and I will have revenge.

entries.caption: Marine Flaws
rows: I grow combative and unpredictable when I drink.
I find civilian life difficult and struggle to say the right thing in social situations.
My intensity can drive others away.
I hold grudges and have difficulty forgiving others.
I become irrational when innocent people are hurt.
I sometimes stay up all night listening to the ghosts of my fallen enemies.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set}, {@filter vehicles (land)|items|source=phb;dmg|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (land)}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A uniform of your company ({@item traveler's clothes|phb} in quality), an insignia of your rank, a {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} of your choice, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing the remainder of your last wages (10 gp).

entries.name: Feature: Mercenary Life
entries: Conoces la vida de mercenario como solo alguien que la ha vivido puede conocerla. Eres capaz de identificar a las compañías mercenarias por sus emblemas y sabes algo sobre cada una de ellas, incluyendo quién las ha contratado recientemente. Puedes encontrar las tabernas y salones de fiestas donde se alojan los mercenarios en cualquier zona, siempre que hables el idioma. Puedes encontrar trabajo como mercenario entre aventuras, suficiente para mantener un estilo de vida cómodo (consulta «{@book Practicing a Profession|PHB|8|Practicing a Profession}» en «Actividades en el tiempo libre» en el capítulo 8 del Manual del Jugador).

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Utiliza las tablas del fondo de {@background soldier} del Manual del Jugador como base para tus rasgos y motivaciones, modificando las entradas cuando sea necesario para adaptarlas a tu identidad como mercenario.

Tu vínculo podría estar relacionado con la compañía con la que viajaste anteriormente o con algunos de los compañeros con los que serviste. El ideal que defiendes depende en gran medida de tu visión del mundo y de tu motivación para luchar.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Navigator's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Pouch|XPHB|2 Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 22 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of artistic {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} and one {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and a purse containing 10 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Rico

entries.name: Overview
entries: Desde tu hogar en lo alto de la colina, has mirado desde arriba (literalmente y quizá en sentido figurado) a las masas desaliñadas de Mulmaster durante toda tu vida. Tus túnicas con ribetes de piel y tu formación en las artes visuales y escénicas te identifican como alguien adinerado y quizá de buena cuna; eres miembro de la aristocracia de la Ciudad del Peligro. Ninguno de tus familiares directos forma parte del Consejo de las Espadas ni es siquiera un Zor o una Zora... todavía. Sin embargo, eres parte de la élite de Mulmaster y, tanto si ansías personalmente una posición más elevada como si no, te sientes como en casa en los salones de baile donde la aristocracia se reúne para conspirar, intrigar, hacer negocios, debatir sobre las artes y, sobre todo, para ver y ser visto.

entries.name: Feature: Highborn
entries: Mulmaster está gobernada por y para su aristocracia. Todas las demás clases de ciudadanos de la ciudad te muestran respeto, e incluso el clero, los soldados, los Halcones y los Manto te tratan con deferencia. Otros aristócratas y nobles te aceptan en sus círculos y es probable que te conozcan o hayan oído hablar de ti. Tus contactos pueden conseguirte la atención de un Zor o una Zora en las circunstancias adecuadas. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Noble».

rows: My ambitions are boundless. I will be a Zor or Zora one day!
I must always look my best.
Beauty is everywhere. I can find it in even the homeliest person and the most horrible tragedy.
Decorum must be preserved at all costs.
I will not admit I am wrong if I can avoid it.
I am extremely well-educated and frequently remind others of that fact.
I take what I can today, because I do not know what tomorrow holds.
My life is full of dance, song, drink, and love.
Generous. I have a responsibility to help and protect the less fortunate. (Good)
Loyal. My word, once given, is my bond. (Lawful)
Callous. I am unconcerned with any negative effects my actions may have on the lives and fortunes of others. (Evil)
Impulsive. I follow my heart. (Chaotic)
Ignorant. Explanations bore me. (Neutral)
Isolationist. I am concerned with the fortunes of my friends and family. Others must see to themselves. (Any)
I have dedicated my wealth and my talents to the service of one of the city's many temples.
My family and I are loyal supporters of High Blade Jaseen Drakehorn. Our fortunes are inexorably tied to hers. I would do anything to support her.
Like many families who were close to High Blade Selfaril Uoumdolphin, mine has suffered greatly since his fall. We honor his memory in secret.
My family plotted with Rassendyll Uoumdolphin brother usurped brother as High Blade. Betrayal is the quickest route to power.
Wealth and power are nothing. Fulfillment can only be found in artistic expression.
It's not how you feel, who you know, or what you can do - it's how you look, and I look fabulous.
I have difficulty caring about anyone or anything other than myself.
Having grown up with wealth, I am careless with my finances. I overspend and am overly generous.
The ends (my advancement) justify any means.
I must have what I want and will brook no delay.
My family has lost everything. I must keep up appearances, lest we become a laughingstock.
I have no artistic sense. I hide that fact behind extreme opinions and have become a trendsetter.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, a {@item signet ring|phb}, a scroll of pedigree, and a purse containing 25 gp

entries.name: Feature: Position of Privilege
entries: Gracias a tu noble cuna, la gente tiende a pensar lo mejor de ti. Eres bienvenido en la alta sociedad, y la gente da por sentado que tienes derecho a estar dondequiera que te encuentres. La gente común hace todo lo posible por complacerte y evitar tu descontento, y otras personas de cuna noble te tratan como a un miembro de su mismo círculo social. Si lo necesitas, puedes conseguir una audiencia con un noble local.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los nobles nacen y se crían en un estilo de vida muy diferente al que la mayoría de la gente llega a experimentar, y su personalidad refleja esa educación. Un título nobiliario conlleva una gran cantidad de obligaciones: responsabilidades para con la familia, para con otros nobles (incluido el soberano), para con las personas confiadas al cuidado de la familia, o incluso para con el propio título. Pero esta responsabilidad suele ser una buena forma de socavar a un noble.

rows: My eloquent flattery makes everyone I talk to feel like the most wonderful and important person in the world.
The common folk love me for my kindness and generosity.
No one could doubt by looking at my regal bearing that I am a cut above the unwashed masses.
I take great pains to always look my best and follow the latest fashions.
I don't like to get my hands dirty, and I won't be caught dead in unsuitable accommodations.
Despite my noble birth, I do not place myself above other folk. We all have the same blood.
My favor, once lost, is lost forever.
If you do me an injury, I will crush you, ruin your name, and salt your fields.
Respect. Respect is due to me because of my position, but all people regardless of station deserve to be treated with dignity. (Good)
Responsibility. It is my duty to respect the authority of those above me, just as those below me must respect mine. (Lawful)
Independence. I must prove that I can handle myself without coddling from my family. (Chaotic)
Power. If I can attain more power, no one will tell me what to do. (Evil)
Family. Blood runs thicker than water. (Any)
Noble Obligation. It is my duty to protect and care for the people beneath me. (Good)
I will face any challenge to win the approval of my family.
My house's alliance with another noble family must be sustained at all costs.
Nothing is more important than the other members of my family.
I am in love with the heir of a family that my family despises.
My loyalty to my sovereign is unwavering.
The common folk must see me as a hero of the people.
I secretly believe that everyone is beneath me.
I hide a truly scandalous secret that could ruin my family forever.
I too often hear veiled insults and threats in every word addressed to me, and I'm quick to anger.
I have an insatiable desire for carnal pleasures.
In fact, the world does revolve around me.
By my words and actions, I often bring shame to my family.

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Gaming Set|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Fine Clothes|XPHB}, {@item Perfume|XPHB}, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP

_.special: foot-long chain made of ten gold coins

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: An Orzhov insignia, a foot-long chain made of ten gold coins, vestments, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 1 pp (an Orzhov-minted 10-zino coin)

entries.name: Feature: Leverage
entries: Puedes ejercer influencia sobre una o varias personas que se encuentren por debajo de ti en la jerarquía del gremio y exigirles ayuda cuando sea necesario. Por ejemplo, puedes hacer que se transmita un mensaje por todo un barrio, conseguir un breve trayecto en carruaje sin pagar o que otros limpien el charco de sangre que has dejado en un callejón. El DJ decide si tus exigencias son razonables y si hay subordinados disponibles para satisfacerlas. A medida que mejora tu estatus en el gremio, ganas influencia sobre más personas, incluidas aquellas que ocupan puestos de mayor poder.

entries.name: Orzhov Guild Spells
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

En tu caso, los hechizos de la tabla de hechizos del gremio Orzhov se añaden a la lista de hechizos de tu clase lanzadora de hechizos. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de hechizos, estos hechizos se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Orzhov Guild Spells
rows: Cantrip
{@spell friends}, {@spell guidance}
1st
{@spell command}, {@spell illusory script}
2nd
{@spell enthrall}, {@spell ray of enfeeblement}, {@spell zone of truth}
3rd
{@spell bestow curse}, {@spell speak with dead}, {@spell spirit guardians}
4th
{@spell blight}, {@spell death ward}, {@spell Leomund's secret chest}
5th
{@spell geas}

entries: Tu magia suele manifestarse en forma de sombras arremolinadas, luz brillante o, a veces, en la aparición momentánea de formas espirituales difusas. Tus hechizos pueden derramar la sangre de tus enemigos o incluso llegar a afectar directamente a sus almas.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los miembros del Sindicato de Orzhov abarcan desde la decadente nobleza que encabeza la oligarquía hasta los desdichados agobiados por las deudas que se encuentran en la base. Tú te sitúas en algún punto entre esos dos extremos, por lo que podrías comportarte con la arrogancia de los muy ricos o con la humildad de los más desfavorecidos.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I am always willing to act in accordance with the financial incentive offered.
Debts are never meant to be forgiven.
I am accustomed to enjoying the finest pleasures money can buy.
No one could doubt that I am a cut above the masses of pitiful peasants that infest the city.
I can't stand to spend a zib more than necessary to purchase what I need.
I hate it when people try to make light of a serious situation.
I want to make sure everyone is aware of how wealthy, powerful, and important I am.
I can't think of anything to look forward to.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Guild}. My guild is all that really matters. (Any)
{@b Wealth}. I will do whatever it takes to become as rich as the oligarchs. (Evil)
{@b Power}. One day, I will be the one giving orders. (Evil)
{@b Prestige}. I want to be admired, respected, feared, or even hated for my position and wealth. (Evil)
{@b Stability}. The economy functions best when chaos is kept under control and everyone knows their place. (Lawful)
{@b Eternity}. I want to live forever—in the flesh as long as possible, and as a spirit afterward. (Any)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: The unbearable weight of my debt has driven me to desperation.
I'm duty-bound to obey the dictates of an ancestor on the Ghost Council.
I value my worldly goods more highly than my mortal life.
An oligarch publicly humiliated me, and I will exact revenge on that whole family.
My faith in the Obzedat never wavers.
I want to prove myself more worthy than an older sibling and thereby ensure that I inherit a greater share of my parents' wealth.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I hold a scandalous secret that could ruin my family forever—but could also earn me the favor of the Ghost Council.
I'm convinced that everyone I know is plotting against me.
I'll brave any risk if the monetary reward is great enough.
I am convinced that I am far more important than anyone else is willing to acknowledge.
I have little respect for anyone who isn't wealthy.
I'll take any opportunity to steal from wealthier people, even for worthless trinkets.

entries.name: Contacts
entries: El Sindicato de Orzhov funciona según una jerarquía estricta basada en una red de vínculos entre familias antiguas y adineradas. Tu familia podría proporcionarte contactos importantes, mientras que sus actividades en el ámbito del crimen, la banca o el cobro de deudas podrían vincularte con miembros de otros gremios.
Tira dos veces en la tabla de contactos de Orzhov (para un aliado y un rival) y una vez en la tabla de contactos no Orzhov.

entries.caption: Orzhov Contacts
rows: The spirit of an ancestor has taken an interest in me.
An older cousin has the ear of a powerful oligarch.
I know a knight who is responsible for collecting debts from powerful people.
A vampire pontiff tried to use me as a pawn in past schemes.
A silent spirit follows me around.
A sibling has keys to parts of Vizkopa Bank.
A giant thinks I'm adorable.
I regularly offer tribute to an angel, and the angel has been kind to me in turn.

entries.caption: Non-Orzhov Contacts
rows: An Azorius arrester is always snooping into my family's business transactions.
A Boros paladin saved my life, to my everlasting shame.
I know a shopkeeper who is secretly a Dimir agent and tries to make sure that I keep that secret hidden.
I'm fascinated by the culture of the Golgari kraul, and I have formed a friendship with one of their death priests.
A Gruul druid hates me but would never dare to touch me.
I know an Izzet engineer who is desperate to pay off a debt accrued by a deceased relative.
Roll an additional Orzhov contact; you can decide if the contact is an ally or a rival.
My childhood friend is now a Rakdos torturer. We still meet for drinks occasionally.
I have the key to a vault where a Selesnya druid is hiding an item of secret shame.
I was married to a Simic bioengineer.

entries.name: How Do I Fit In?
entries: La estructura del Sindicato de Orzhov implica que siempre estás cumpliendo las órdenes de alguien que ocupa un puesto más alto que el tuyo. En definitiva, tu papel en el gremio viene determinado por lo que decidan por ti las personas (y los espíritus) que están por encima de ti.

Durante la mayor parte de tu carrera, es probable que te veas involucrado en algún aspecto de las actividades delictivas cotidianas del gremio. Esto puede implicar imponer tu autoridad para hacer cumplir la voluntad del gremio o utilizar la autoridad religiosa para extorsionar a la gente y obtener ofrendas. Pero también puede significar realizar diversos recados para tus superiores, desde entregar mensajes hasta llevar a cabo asesinatos.

_.special: trophy from an animal you killed

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item staff|phb}, a {@item hunting trap|phb}, a trophy from an animal you killed, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Wanderer
entries: Tienes una memoria excelente para los mapas y la geografía, y siempre eres capaz de recordar la disposición general del terreno, los asentamientos y otros elementos que te rodean. Además, puedes conseguir comida y agua potable para ti y hasta otras cinco personas cada día, siempre que el terreno ofrezca bayas, caza menor, agua, etc.

entries.name: Specialty
entries: Has estado en lugares extraños y has visto cosas que otros ni siquiera pueden imaginar. Piensa en algunas de las tierras lejanas que has visitado y en cómo te han marcado. Puedes tirar los dados en la siguiente tabla para determinar a qué te dedicabas durante tu estancia en la naturaleza, o elegir la ocupación que mejor se adapte a tu personaje.

rows: Forester
Trapper
Homesteader
Guide
Exile or outcast
Bounty hunter
Pilgrim
Tribal nomad
Hunter-gatherer
Tribal marauder

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Aunque a menudo se les considera groseros y maleducados entre la gente civilizada, los forasteros tienen poco respeto por las sutilezas de la vida en las ciudades. Los lazos con la tribu, el clan, la familia y el mundo natural del que forman parte son los vínculos más importantes para la mayoría de los forasteros.

rows: I'm driven by a wanderlust that led me away from home.
I watch over my friends as if they were a litter of newborn pups.
I once ran twenty-five miles without stopping to warn to my clan of an approaching orc horde. I'd do it again if I had to.
I have a lesson for every situation, drawn from observing nature.
I place no stock in wealthy or well-mannered folk. Money and manners won't save you from a hungry owlbear.
I'm always picking things up, absently fiddling with them, and sometimes accidentally breaking them.
I feel far more comfortable around animals than people.
I was, in fact, raised by wolves.
Change. Life is like the seasons, in constant change, and we must change with it. (Chaotic)
Greater Good. It is each person's responsibility to make the most happiness for the whole tribe. (Good)
Honor. If I dishonor myself, I dishonor my whole clan. (Lawful)
Might. The strongest are meant to rule. (Evil)
Nature. The natural world is more important than all the constructs of civilization. (Neutral)
Glory. I must earn glory in battle, for myself and my clan. (Any)
My family, clan, or tribe is the most important thing in my life, even when they are far from me.
An injury to the unspoiled wilderness of my home is an injury to me.
I will bring terrible wrath down on the evildoers who destroyed my homeland.
I am the last of my tribe, and it is up to me to ensure their names enter legend.
I suffer awful visions of a coming disaster and will do anything to prevent it.
It is my duty to provide children to sustain my tribe.
I am too enamored of ale, wine, and other intoxicants.
There's no room for caution in a life lived to the fullest.
I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me.
I am slow to trust members of other races, tribes, and societies.
Violence is my answer to almost any challenge.
Don't expect me to save those who can't save themselves. It is nature's way that the strong thrive and the weak perish.

_.displayName: small trinket that connects you to the life you once had before the occupation of Phlan
dark common clothes that includes a cloak and hood

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, {@filter vehicles (land)|items|source=phb;dmg|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (land)}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A bag of {@item caltrops (bag of 20)|phb}, a small {@item trinket|phb} that connects you to the life you once had before the occupation of Phlan, a {@item healer's kit|phb}, a set of dark {@item common clothes|phb} that includes a cloak and hood, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Pobre

entries.name: Overview
entries: La toma de Phlan por parte de Vorgansharax sigue muy presente en tu memoria. Estabas ocupándote de tus quehaceres cotidianos cuando las fuerzas del dragón verde salieron de las alcantarillas y asaltaron tu hogar. Muchos de los ciudadanos de Phlan, tanto jóvenes como mayores, fueron capturados, asesinados u ofrecidos como tributo a la Virulencia Mutilada. Tú mismo fuiste uno de los capturados. Pero, ya fuera con la ayuda de aventureros o gracias a tu propio ingenio y a tu firme determinación, lograste escapar.

En lugar de huir de la región, has decidido quedarte y luchar. Tras encontrar refugio fuera de la ciudad y del matorral mortal que la rodea, te enfrentas a las Lágrimas de la Virulencia y a sus monstruosos aliados. Has aprendido a sobrevivir en circunstancias extremas y desesperadas, con las provisiones cada vez más escasas y la llegada de refuerzos incierta. Te has acostumbrado a actuar al amparo de la noche, asestando todos los golpes que puedes para vengar a los amigos y familiares que perdiste en la actualmente ocupada Phlan. Expulsarás a Vorgansharax, o morirás en el intento.

entries.name: Origin
entries: Tras haber dejado atrás tu vida como ciudadano, te has adaptado a la dura vida en los parajes salvajes que rodean Phlan. El oficio que ejercías sigue influyendo en tu forma de ver las cosas, en cómo afrontas las situaciones y en cómo contribuyes al movimiento de resistencia contra la «Virulencia Mutilada». Puedes tirar en la siguiente tabla para determinar cuál era tu ocupación antes de la caída, o elegir la que mejor se adapte a tu personaje (selecciona de la columna general o de la columna específica, pero no de ambas).

rows: Fisher
Stojanow River Worker
Hunter
Twilight Marsh Worker
Craftsperson
Mantor's Library Scribe
Priest/Priestess
Clergy of Ilmater
Cook
Laughing Goblin Server
City Watch
Black Fist Guard
Servant
House Sokol Retainer
Unskilled Laborer
Bay of Phlan Dockworker

entries.name: Feature: Guerrilla
entries: Has llegado a conocer los bosques, arroyos, cuevas y otros elementos naturales de los alrededores en los que puedes refugiarte o tender emboscadas. Eres capaz de examinar rápidamente tu entorno en busca de elementos que te ofrezcan ventaja. Además, puedes rebuscar en tu entorno natural para reunir provisiones sencillas (como antorchas improvisadas, cuerdas, retales de tela, etc.) que se consumen tras su uso. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Forastero».

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Has renunciado a la vida que conocías como ciudadano de Phlan. Sin embargo, la invasión de la Virulencia Mutilada resuena en lo más profundo de tu ser. Quizás tengas algunos amigos o familiares que lograron escapar contigo. O, tal vez, todas las personas que amabas perecieron o desaparecieron durante la caída. Quizá sepas de alguien que, contra todo pronóstico, está sobreviviendo en la espesura y anhelas liberarlo de una vida de peligro dentro de la ciudad.

rows: My patience knows no bounds, so long as my goal is in sight.
In life and in struggle, the ends justify my actions.
If you aren't helping me, you'd best at least stay out of my way.
I long for the life that was taken away from me.
Friends and family perished, tragically, before my eyes. I hope never to undergo that again.
Making the right choices in life are important to me. The choices I make might save not just my life, but the lives of others as well.
I can never allow my foes to get the drop on me.
Time is a precious resource that I must spend wisely.
Leadership. The oppressed need someone to inspire them to courageous acts. (Good)
Unpredictability. Keeping the enemy guessing and off-balance is my tactical strength. (Chaos)
Determination. Threats to my home must be eliminated at all costs. (Any)
Freedom. Those who are enslaved and unjustly imprisoned deserve my aid. (Good)
Resourcefulness. Our wits are our most valuable resource in troubled times. (Any)
Unity. Working together, we can overcome all obstacles, even the most seemingly insurmountable ones. (Any)
I'll never let my fellow insurgents down. They are my only remaining friends.
I was separated from a loved one during my escape from town. I will find them.
One of the Tears of the Virulence was a trusted friend, until the day they betrayed the city. They will pay harshly for their transgressions.
An item I hold close is my last remaining connection to the family I lost during the fall.
The dragon who took my past life away from me will feel the full extent of my vengeance.
The knowledge in Mantor's Library is an irreplaceable treasure that must be protected.
I have no respect for those who flee. I harbor a deep grudge against the citizens who abandoned Phlan.
Ale is the only way I can escape the desperation of my circumstances.
It doesn't take much to get me into a fight.
Being an insurgent means doing things that aren't always ethical. I'm still learning to live with that.
My desire to liberate Phlan oftentimes clouds my judgment, despite my best efforts.
I relentlessly despise the Maimed Virulence and his allies. I'd abandon other goals in order to strike out at them.

_.special: token of the life you once knew

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} (one of your choice), a token of the life you once knew, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Modesto

entries.name: Overview
entries: Atrás quedaron aquellos días más felices en los que entrabas en la posada «Laughing Goblin» tras una dura jornada de trabajo. Todo ha cambiado, y tienes suerte de estar vivo. En Phlan podías considerarte una de esas personas con experiencia en la calle que sabían cuándo pagar un soborno y con quién colaborar para ganarse la vida. Tu capacidad para escuchar los vientos del cambio te ha salvado antes, y esta vez te ha permitido ser uno de los pocos afortunados que escaparon de Phlan con algo más que la camisa que llevabas puesta.

entries.name: Feature: Phlan Survivor
entries: Sea cual sea la situación en la que te encontraras antes, ahora eres uno de los muchos refugiados que han llegado a Mulmaster. Puedes encontrar refugio junto a otras personas procedentes de Phlan y a quienes simpatizan con tu difícil situación. En Mulmaster, esto significa que puedes encontrar un lugar donde descansar, recuperarte y esconderte de la guardia, ya sea junto a otros refugiados de Phlan o con los Zhents de los guetos. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Héroe popular».

rows: I may have lost everything I worked for most of my life, but there's work to be done, no time to linger on the past.
I worked hard to get where I am and I refuse to let a little hardship stop me from succeeding.
I protect those around me, you never know when one of them will be useful.
I have always gotten ahead by giving, why change now?
I prepare for everything, it paid off in Phlan and it will pay off again.
I will reclaim my home, though the path may be long, I will never give up hope.
I never cared for personal hygiene, and am amazed that It bothers others.
I am always willing to volunteer my services, just as long as don't have to do anything.
Justice. Corruption brought Phlan down, I will not tolerate that any longer. (Lawful)
Acceptance. Stability is a myth, to think you can control your future is futile. (Chaotic)
Hope. I am guided by a higher power and I trust that everything will be right in the end. (Good)
Restraint. I hate those who caused my loss. It is all I can do not to lash out at them. (Any)
Strength. As shown in Phlan, the strong survive. If you are weak you deserve what you get (Evil)
Openness. I am always willing to share my life story with anyone who will listen. (Any)
I have the chance at a new life and this time I am going to do things right.
The Lord Regent brought this suffering upon his people. I will see him brought to justice.
I await the day I will be able to return to my home in Phlan.
I will never forget the debt owed to Glevith of the Welcomers. I will be ready to repay that debt when called upon.
There was someone I cared about in Phlan, I will find out what happened to them.
Some say my life wasn't worth saving, I will prove them wrong.
I used the lives of children to facilitate my escape from Phlan.
I am a sucker for the underdog, and always bet on the loosing team.
I am incapable of standing up for myself.
I will borrow money from friends with no intention to repay it.
I am unable to keep secrets. A secret is just an untold story.
When something goes wrong, it's never my fault.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, {@item fine clothes|phb}, 20 gp

entries.name: Feature: Legalese
entries: Tu experiencia con el sistema jurídico local te ha proporcionado un profundo conocimiento de todos los entresijos de dicho sistema. Incluso cuando la ley no está de tu parte, puedes utilizar términos complejos como «ex injuria jus non oritur» o «cogitationis poenam nemo patitur» para intimidar a la gente y hacerles creer que sabes de lo que hablas. Con personas comunes y corrientes que no saben más que tú, es posible que consigas intimidarlas o engañarlas para obtener favores o un trato especial.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Hay muchos tipos de demandantes. Algunos son simples víctimas que solo buscan una indemnización justa por sus lesiones. Otros son profesionales de los tribunales, dispuestos a llegar a cualquier extremo para parecer agraviados con el fin de obtener una indemnización cuantiosa.

rows: I can't believe I have a chance to join Acquisitions Incorporated! The fun I'm going to have!
I've been wronged my entire life, and the world owes me.
I have always tried to make the best of a bad situation.
The law doesn't protect the honest and the hard working. I'm going to do whatever needs to be done to make things right.
I'm always in the wrong place at the wrong time.
My superiors are smarter and wiser than I am. I do what I'm told.
Never pass up the opportunity to make an easy bit of coin. That's my motto.
I'm beginning to feel like the gods are not on my side.
Justice. Those who break the law need to answer for their crimes. (Lawful)
Freedom. People must have the freedom to do what they want and pursue their dreams. (Chaotic)
Greed. Everyone I see is getting theirs, so I'm surely going to get mine. (Evil)
Chaos. You're out of order! And you're out of order! This whole realm is out of order! (Chaotic)
Humility. I'm just a small part of a larger whole. So is everyone else. (Neutral)
Responsibility. We all have our roles to play. I'll hold up my end of the bargain. (Any)
Others hurt in the same accident that hurt me are my new family. I'll make sure they're taken care of.
The rulers of this place were kind to me, and they have my lifelong devotion.
My parents worry about me, but I'll make them proud.
The only bond that matters is the one holding my money pouch to my belt.
The other new hires at Acquisitions Incorporated are my allies. We have each other's backs.
My legal counsel is my best friend. I owe all my forthcoming opportunities to their hard work.
The person who gains the most reward for the least effort wins.
Three magic beans for just one cow? What a deal!
I have only one vice, but it controls my life.
Sleep is for the weak. We need to keep training more if we're going to be ready for the challenges ahead.
Until my songs are sung in every tavern in this realm, I won't be satisfied.
If people find me unpleasant, that's their problem.
