entries.name: Factions of Sigil
entries: En la Ciudad de las Puertas han cobrado protagonismo doce facciones, aunque existen muchas más. Tu personaje podría pertenecer a uno de estos grupos o a otra facción ideológica, tal vez una de tu propia creación.
Las principales facciones de Sigil, que se describen con más detalle en el capítulo 2, se rigen por las siguientes filosofías:

items.name: Athar
entries: Deities are frauds and merely channel the might of a true, higher power.

items.name: Bleak Cabal
entries: There is no greater truth to the multiverse. Each being must discover their own meaning.

items.name: Doomguard
entries: Nothing lasts forever. The purpose of everything is to crumble and decay.

items.name: Fated
entries: Everyone makes their own fate and is entitled to whatever they can take and hold.

items.name: Fraternity of Order
entries: All of existence is governed by laws, and power comes from understanding and exploiting them.

items.name: Hands of Havoc
entries: Those who try to impose a single order on the multiverse are doomed to fail.

items.name: Harmonium
entries: The multiverse will be perfect only when everything is acting in harmony, whether it wants to or not.

items.name: Heralds of Dust
entries: Everyone is already dead; the entirety of the multiverse is an afterlife. Undeath holds the key to the next stage of existence.

items.name: Mercykillers
entries: Cold, relentless justice is absolute, and no one is above it.

items.name: Mind's Eye
entries: The multiverse exists to be explored. It shapes us, and we shape it in turn.

items.name: Society of Sensation
entries: Sensation is the proof of existence. By experiencing everything, we can understand the multiverse in all its complexity.

items.name: Transcendent Order
entries: Thought clouds action. To fall in step with the multiverse, one must act on instinct alone.

entries.name: Feature: Conviction
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Scion of the Outer Planes|SatO}. Además, los miembros de tu organización te proporcionan alojamiento y comida modestos y gratuitos en cualquiera de sus propiedades o en los hogares de otros miembros de la facción.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los aventureros que se rigen por una filosofía concreta sobre el multiverso son bienvenidos en las facciones que comparten esas creencias. La tabla de rasgos de personalidad del «filósofo planar» sugiere varios rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

rows: I don't venerate any gods. With time, we can be as powerful as them or greater.
Experience is everything; live in the moment.
When things crumble, I find meaning in the dust.
Life thrives through order, and I seek to maintain that order.
When others make plans, the multiverse laughs and so do I.
I know what's right, and none will stand in my way.

entries.name: Building a Planar Philosopher Character
entries: Es posible que algunos grupos de filósofos planares prefieran ciertos tipos de personajes, pero, en general, cualquier personaje que defienda y promueva las creencias de dicho grupo es bienvenido en sus filas.

entries.name: Planar Philosopher Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla {@item Planar Philosopher Trinket|SatO|Planar Philosopher Trinkets}, en lugar de en la tabla {@item Trinket|PHB|Trinkets} del Manual del Jugador, para elegir tu abalorio inicial.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} or {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of black ink}, an {@item ink pen|PHB}, a set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or a {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} (one of your choice), a school uniform, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Prismari Initiate
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Strixhaven Initiate|SCC} y debes elegir «Prismari» en ella.

Además, si tienes la característica «Lanzamiento de conjuros» o «Magia de pacto», los conjuros de la tabla «Conjuros de Prismari» se añaden a la lista de conjuros de tu clase de lanzador de conjuros. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de conjuros, estos conjuros se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Prismari Spells
rows: 1st
{@spell Chromatic Orb}, {@spell Thunderwave}
2nd
{@spell Flaming Sphere}, {@spell Kinetic Jaunt|SCC}
3rd
{@spell Haste}, {@spell Water Walk}
4th
{@spell Freedom of Movement}, {@spell Wall of Fire}
5th
{@spell Cone of Cold}, {@spell Conjure Elemental}

entries: Considera la posibilidad de personalizar el aspecto de tus hechizos cuando los lances. Podrías lanzar tus hechizos de Prismari con movimientos dinámicos y gestuales, casi como una danza, a modo de componente somático. Incluso una ráfaga de fuego en tus manos es una obra de arte esculpida; las fuerzas elementales crean grandiosos diseños mientras lanzas hechizos. Estas fuerzas podrían permanecer en tu cuerpo o en tu ropa como elementos decorativos una vez que tus hechizos se hayan disipado, como chispas que bailan en tu cabello y tu tacto deja rastros de escarcha en todo lo que tocas.

entries.name: Building a Prismari Character
entries: Cualquier clase o subclase que maneje las fuerzas elementales del frío, el fuego, el rayo y el viento puede encajar bien en Prismari. Los druidas y los hechiceros son habituales en Prismari, y los magos que estudian las escuelas de {@class Wizard|PHB|Evocation|Evocation|PHB} o {@class Wizard|PHB|Transmutation|Transmutation|PHB} también están bien representados. Los clérigos no son muy comunes en esta escuela, pero algunos con el dominio {@class Cleric|PHB|Tempest domain|Tempest|PHB} acaban aquí.

Más allá de las filas de los lanzadores de conjuros tradicionales, entre los alumnos de Prismari también se encuentran monjes que siguen el {@class Monk|PHB|Way of the Four Elements|Four Elements|PHB}. Algunos pícaros y luchadores acrobáticos (incluidos aquellos que emulan el arquetipo del {@class Fighter|PHB|Eldritch Knight|Eldritch Knight|PHB}) también disfrutan del carácter atlético de las actuaciones de los Prismari.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Aunque el plan de estudios del Prismari College atrae a muchos artistas extrovertidos y motivados, en la escuela no faltan estudiantes tímidos ni fanfarrones holgazanes. La tabla de rasgos de personalidad de Prismari sugiere una variedad de rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

entries.caption: Prismari Personality Traits
rows: I'm the life of the party, and I expect everyone's attention when I walk into a room.
Two weeks ago, I was enthralled with my latest project. Now, I think it's garbage and deserves to be destroyed.
I believe everyone has the ability to express their truest selves through art, and I'm happy to quietly push them in the right direction.
Everyone is a critic, and I work to win them all over.
I'm beset with such an overwhelming sense of ennui regarding my art. Nothing quite captures my attention anymore.
Instead of confronting my negative emotions, I channel them into explosive artistic displays.

entries.name: Prismari Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla {@item Prismari Trinket|SCC|Prismari Trinkets}, en lugar de en la tabla {@item trinket|phb|Trinkets table} del {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, para elegir tu abalorio inicial.

items.entry: A {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of black ink}, an {@item ink pen|PHB}, an {@item abacus|PHB}, a book of arcane theory, a school uniform, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Quandrix Initiate
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Strixhaven Initiate|SCC} y debes elegir Quandrix dentro de ella.

Además, si tienes la característica «Lanzamiento de conjuros» o «Magia de pacto», los conjuros de la tabla «Conjuros de Quandrix» se añaden a la lista de conjuros de tu clase de lanzador de conjuros. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de conjuros, estos conjuros se añaden a todas ellas.)

{@spell Entangle}, {@spell Guiding Bolt}
2nd

3rd
{@spell Aura of Vitality}, {@spell Haste}
4th

5th
{@spell Circle of Power}, {@spell Passwall}

entries: Considera la posibilidad de personalizar el aspecto de tus hechizos cuando los lances. Tus hechizos de Quandrix podrían manifestarse en medio de remolinos caleidoscópicos de patrones fractales, amplificando los movimientos más sutiles de tus componentes somáticos. Cuando tu magia cree o altere criaturas, podría rodear brevemente a los objetivos con diseños fractales resplandecientes o patrones teselados.

entries.name: Building a Quandrix Character
entries: Cualquier clase o subclase capaz de lanzar hechizos puede funcionar bien para un personaje Quandrix. Tanto la orientación académica de los magos (especialmente aquellos que estudian las Escuelas de {@class Wizard|PHB|Abjuration|Abjuration|PHB}, {@class Wizard|PHB|Illusion|Illusion|PHB} o {@class Wizard|PHB|Transmutation|Transmutation|PHB}) y las manipulaciones metamágicas de los hechiceros son bienvenidas en Quandrix, y muchos druidas también exploran los patrones de la naturaleza en Quandrix. Algunos clérigos, en particular aquellos con los dominios {@class Cleric|PHB|Knowledge|Knowledge|PHB} o {@class Cleric|PHB|Nature|Nature|PHB}, también estudian en Quandrix.
Aside from traditional spellcasters, a few characters of other classes find homes in Quandrix. Some fighters, monks, rangers, and rogues study here, using Quandrix principles to train their minds.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Con temas que van desde lo físico y tangible hasta lo paradójico y extraño, el alumnado del Quandrix College está formado por una mezcla ecléctica de personas. La tabla de rasgos de personalidad de Quandrix sugiere una variedad de rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

entries.caption: Quandrix Personality Traits
rows: When I find a subject I'm interested in, I won't stop studying until I know everything about it. It keeps me up at night.
I hope this all makes sense to me one day. Until then, I'm going to keep faking it.
Equations and patterns come naturally to my mind. I wish friendship came just as easily.
I believe I'm always the smartest person in the room. And I'll prove it, even if no one asks me to.
If these classes have taught me anything, it's that reality is a lie, and nothing matters. So why bother?
Before I graduate, I want to achieve something mathematically impossible. I must leave a legacy!

entries.name: Quandrix Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla {@item Quandrix Trinket|SCC|Quandrix Trinkets}, en lugar de en la tabla {@item trinket|phb|Trinkets table} del {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, para elegir tu abalorio inicial.

_.displayName: hooded lantern made of wrought iron

_.special: 10-foot length of chain with sharply spiked links

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A Rakdos insignia, a {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} (one of your choice), a {@item costume clothes|phb|costume}, a {@item hooded lantern|phb} made of wrought iron, a 10-foot length of chain with sharply spiked links, a {@item tinderbox|phb}, 10 {@item torch|phb|torches}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp (a mix of Azorius and Boros 1-zino coins), and a bottle of sweet, red juice

entries.name: A Flair for the Dramatic
entries: Las actuaciones de Rakdos suelen combinar acrobacias circenses clásicas con fuego, púas y ganchos de hierro forjado, y monstruos. Puedes tirar un {@dice d8} o elegir entre las opciones de la tabla «Opciones de actuación» para determinar tu estilo de actuación preferido.

entries.caption: Performance Options
rows: Spikewheel acrobat
Lampooning satirist
Fire juggler
Marionette puppeteer
Pain artist
Noise musician
Nightmare clown
Master of ceremonies

entries.name: Feature: Fearsome Reputation
entries: La gente te reconoce como miembro del Culto de Rakdos y se cuida mucho de no despertar tu ira ni exponerse a tus burlas. Puedes salirte con la tuya en delitos menores, como negarte a pagar la comida en un restaurante o derribar la puerta de una tienda local, siempre que ninguna autoridad legal sea testigo del delito. La mayoría de la gente te tiene demasiado miedo como para denunciar tus fechorías a los Azorius.

entries.name: Rakdos Guild Spells
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

En tu caso, los hechizos de la tabla de hechizos del gremio Rakdos se añaden a la lista de hechizos de tu clase capaz de lanzar hechizos. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de hechizos, estos hechizos se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Rakdos Guild Spells
rows: Cantrip
{@spell fire bolt}, {@spell vicious mockery}
1st
{@spell burning hands}, {@spell dissonant whispers}, {@spell hellish rebuke}
2nd
{@spell crown of madness}, {@spell enthrall}, {@spell flaming sphere}
3rd
{@spell fear}, {@spell haste}
4th
{@spell confusion}, {@spell wall of fire}
5th
{@spell dominate person}

entries: Tu magia suele dar lugar a un espectáculo llamativo, envolviéndote a ti o a tus objetivos en una mezcla de llamas inofensivas y formas sombrías. Cuando manipulas la mente de un oponente, es posible que aparezca momentáneamente un símbolo llameante de Rakdos, como una máscara sobre el rostro del objetivo.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los miembros de cultos demoníacos no suelen tener fama de ser las personas más amables ni las más equilibradas mentalmente, así que es probable que haya algo en tu naturaleza que te distinga de los ciudadanos respetuosos con la ley de Rávnica.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I revel in mayhem, the more destructive the better.
When violence breaks out, I lose myself in rage, and it's sometimes hard to stop.
Everything is funny to me, and the most hilarious and bloodiest things leave me cackling with sadistic glee.
I derive genuine pleasure from the pain of others.
I enjoy testing other people's patience.
I can't stand it when things are predictable, so I like to add a little chaos to every situation.
I throw my weight around to make sure I get my way.
I enjoy breaking delicate works of art. And fingers, which are sort of the same.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Guild}. My guild is all that really matters. (Any)
{@b Hedonism}. Death comes for everyone, so take as much pleasure as you can from every moment of life. (Neutral)
{@b Creativity}. I strive to find more ways to express my art through pain—my own as well as others'. (Chaotic)
{@b Freedom}. No one tells me what to do. (Chaotic)
{@b Equality}. I want to see Ravnica remade, with no guilds and no hierarchies. (Chaotic)
{@b Spectacle}. People are inspired by the greatness they see in art. (Any)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I have belonged to the same performance troupe for years, and these people mean everything to me.
A blood witch told me I have a special destiny to fulfill, and I'm trying to figure out what it is.
I'm secretly hoping that I can change the cult from the inside, using my influence to help rein in the wanton violence.
I own something that Rakdos once touched (it's seared black at the spot), and I cherish it.
I want to be better at my chosen form of performance than any other member of my troupe.
I am devoted to Rakdos and live to impress him.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: My family is prominent in another guild. I enjoy my wild life, but I don't want to embarrass them.
I couldn't hide my emotions and opinions even if I wanted to.
I throw caution to the wind.
I resent the rich and powerful.
When I'm angry, I lash out in violence.
There's no such thing as too much pleasure.

entries.name: Contacts
entries: El Culto de Rakdos es todo menos organizado. Los miembros suelen pasar de una compañía teatral a otra. Casi todos los miembros del culto conocen a antiguos compañeros que ahora forman parte de otras compañías, lo que da lugar a una amplia red de contactos.
Tira dos veces en la tabla de contactos de Rakdos (para un aliado y un rival) y una vez en la tabla de contactos que no son de Rakdos.

entries.caption: Rakdos Contacts
rows: I was part of a two-person act until my former partner moved to a different troupe.
My sibling and I ran away from home and joined the Cult of Rakdos together. We're very close.
A childhood friend of mine is an attendant in Rix Maadi, the Rakdos guildhall.
My parents brought me into the guild and taught me my trade.
There's a lesser demon in the cult who thinks he owes me a favor, and who am I to argue?
The master of ceremonies in my troupe is well connected with other troupes.
I had a romance with a pain artist in another troupe.
Rakdos himself has witnessed me perform.

entries.caption: Non-Rakdos Contacts
rows: I know an Azorius elocutor who has a very amusing dark side.
A Boros captain really wants to "redeem" me.
I think a member of my troupe is a Dimir agent.
I once convinced a Golgari medusa to participate in a show. We've been on good terms ever since.
I came from the Gruul and still have relatives there.
An Izzet technician provides pyrotechnics for my performances.
An Orzhov oligarch has taken an interest in my career, like a patron of the arts.
Roll an additional Rakdos contact; you can decide if the contact is an ally or a rival.
A Selesnya healer attends my performances regularly.
A Simic biomancer provides mutant monsters to add a taste of the bizarre to our shows.

entries.name: How Do I Fit In?
entries: El Culto de Rakdos fomenta la iniciativa individual entre sus miembros. Su objetivo es sembrar el caos, y cree firmemente en sembrar el desorden en su propia casa antes de llevar esa misión a la ciudad. Así pues, tu papel consiste en llevar a cabo tu visión de la gran sátira y el arte performativo disruptivo, mientras aspiras a superar a tus compañeros de gremio y a atraer la atención del propio Rakdos.

Trabajas como parte de una compañía, poniendo tu talento artístico al servicio de la visión del director del circo. Pero tu actuación es única, y nadie espera que sigas un guion. De hecho, si terminas una actuación sin haber hecho algo que no hayas hecho antes, está claro que no te estás esforzando lo suficiente.

_.displayName: a holy symbol of your previous cult

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Vestments and a {@item holy symbol|phb} of your previous cult, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a belt {@item pouch|PHB} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Fell Teachings
entries: Te has empapado de conocimientos sobre uno de los {@book Betrayer Gods|TDCSR|2|Betrayer Gods} y te sabes de memoria todo, desde sus mandamientos básicos hasta algunos de sus secretos más esotéricos. Elige uno de los {@book Betrayer Gods|TDCSR|2|Betrayer Gods}. Tienes {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} en las tiradas de Inteligencia ({@skill Religion}) para obtener información sobre su fe, incluidos secretos oscuros desconocidos para la mayoría de los fieles.

Además, puedes consultar con tu director de juego para crear un secreto que hayas descubierto durante tu estancia en la secta. Este secreto podría ser el germen de una conspiración, el mito de un héroe legendario cuyo verdadero significado haya ido cambiando con el paso de los años, o incluso la ubicación de un artefacto divino de leyenda.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: La vida de todo antiguo miembro de una secta viene marcada, en cierta medida, por el proceso de huir del pasado y de intentar labrarse un futuro lejos de las creencias que antes lo dominaban. Es probable que tu vínculo se relacione con aquellas personas que te dieron la lucidez y la fuerza necesarias para abandonar tus antiguos hábitos. Tu ideal podría consistir en tu deseo de acabar con quienes promueven el mal del que escapaste y, tal vez, en encontrar una nueva fe en un dios misericordioso.

entries.caption: Reformed Cultist Personality Traits
rows: I need a {@item dagger|phb} close at hand at all times. Just in case they find me.
I can't believe I'm out here fighting monsters. After everything I've been through, why can't I find a normal life?
I need a stiff drink before I do anything stressful these days. I know it's a problem. Just...let me have this.
Murder is okay when it's for a good cause! I didn't tear my past out by the roots so I could let evil people cause more harm.
My past is filled with stories like you wouldn't believe. Ones that'll really make your skin crawl. Do you want to hear...?
Yeah, I'm crying. I do that. Get over yourself.
I know you've told me your name twice already, but that's not good enough. How can I be sure you are who you say you are?
My mind is always racing. I can't...I just need to...you have to give me a second—or else I can't...organize my thoughts.

entries.caption: Reformed Cultist Ideals
rows: {@b Life}. I've spent too long shackled to an evil master. No matter what happened before, I deserve my freedom now. (Chaotic)
{@b Redemption}. People can change, but redemption must be something they choose for themselves. If they do, it is my duty to help them along that path. (Good)
{@b Power}. When I abandoned the cult, it wasn't out of some misguided sense of righteousness. That pathetic organization was merely a shackle on my potential. (Evil)
{@b Vengeance}. The cult has poisoned my life. I will see all its followers suffer. (Any)
{@b Hierarchy}. The cult was vile, but its strength was in stability and organization. As long as good folk lack unity, evil will always triumph. (Lawful)
{@b Reparations}. As a cultist, I harmed people whose names I'll never know. I feel obligated to repay my debt by aiding others. (Good)

entries.caption: Reformed Cultist Bonds
rows: My cousin escaped the cult with me. I lost track of them when we fled, but I know they're alive. I can feel it.
I was saved from the cult by a priest of one of the {@book Prime Deities|TDCSR|2|Prime Deities}. If not for that sign of faith, I would surely be lost.
I was told by the person who saved me that a sage once said: "Life needs things to live." I don't know what that means, but I've dedicated my existence to finding out.
One of my cultist parents had a change of heart when I was a teenager, and we fled together in the dark of night. I didn't want to leave, but I understand now that their courage saved my life.
I was bested by a warrior when I fumbled a cult-ordered assassination. I don't know why that person took pity on me, but they gave me purpose when I was lost.
Now that I've saved myself, the only person important to me is my former cult leader—because I've sworn that they'll die by my hand.

entries.caption: Reformed Cultist Flaws
rows: I'm haunted by what I saw in those ritual chambers. Every time I see blood, I...oh, gods, I can't bear to even think about it.
I ran from the cult long ago. But deep down, there's a part of me that still thinks they were right about certain things.
I can't help but feel a rush whenever I see a life snuffed out before me. Just one more kill... just one more.
Organized religion terrifies me. {@book Betrayer Gods|TDCSR|2|Betrayer Gods} or {@book Prime Deities|TDCSR|2|Prime Deities}...it doesn't matter. The sight of the faithful freezes my blood cold.
Oh, I always tell the truth. Always. I've never had to keep a secret from anyone, so of course I'll be open with you.
I don't trust easily. If you grew up being lied to about every little thing? The fundamental nature of the world? You wouldn't, either.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A bottle of black ink, an {@item ink pen|PHB}, five sheets of paper, a {@item gaming set|PHB} (matching your chosen proficiency), a {@item signet ring|PHB}, a set of {@item fine clothes|PHB}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 18 gp

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
entries: One {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} of your choice (such as {@item playing card set|phb|playing cards} or {@item three-dragon ante set|phb|three-dragon ante cards})

entries.name: Feature: Fortune's Favor
entries: Tu inesperada buena suerte se refleja en una ventaja menor. Obtienes la ventaja {@feat Lucky}, {@feat Magic Initiate} o {@feat Skilled} (a tu elección). Tu elección de la hazaña refleja la transformación que cambió tu vida. Un encuentro con un genio que te concedió tres deseos podría haber dado lugar a poderes mágicos representados por Iniciado en la magia. Si pagaste todas las deudas de tu familia con una ronda fortuita de ante de tres dragones, podrías ser Afortunado en su lugar. Alternativamente, podrías usar la hazaña Hábil para reflejar cualquier prueba que hayas soportado para asegurar tu nuevo destino y para representar el conocimiento y las habilidades que te impartió cualquier fuerza que transformó tu vida.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: La visión que tu personaje tiene de la vida ha cambiado gracias a su nuevo destino. La tabla «Rasgos de personalidad recompensados» sugiere rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje y cartas del {@item Deck of Many Things} que podrían haber motivado ese rasgo.

rows: A safe home is a foundation on which anything else can be built. (Key, Throne)
I was elevated to heights I could never otherwise attain, and I won't waste my fortune. (Star, Sun)
I try to be a source of inspiration and joy to others. Life is never as bad as you think! (Euryale, Jester)
Courage and boldness can carry the day when all else fails. (Comet, Knight)
My good fortune means I can lift others up as well. (Gem, Moon)
Having the right answers is the first step to solving any problem, no matter how dire. (Fates, Sage)

entries.name: Building a Rewarded Character
entries: Los personajes «recompensados» tienen historias muy diversas, pero todos comparten algo en común: pasaban por una mala racha antes de que sus vidas dieran un giro radical. Es posible que hubieran perdido toda esperanza de llevar una vida más feliz, hasta que, de repente, se les presentó una segunda oportunidad. A menudo, un personaje «recompensado» ha pasado muchos años luchando por escapar de circunstancias dolorosas. Ahora, liberados de la prisión (a veces literal) que era su antigua vida, dejan atrás sus preocupaciones y se convierten en aventureros.

Si la vida de tu personaje cambió gracias a una {@item Deck of Many Things}, piensa qué carta fue la responsable. Quizás la carta de los Destinos deshizo un trágico error que tu personaje cometió en su juventud. La carta de la Gema podría haber borrado las deudas acumuladas a lo largo de toda una vida. Quizá la carta del Sabio te proporcionó el consejo necesario para escapar de una situación desesperada, la carta de la Estrella aumentó una característica hasta su valor actual, o un hechizo {@spell Wish} lanzado tras robar la carta de la Luna transformó a tu personaje de un vendedor ambulante a un hechicero novato imbuido de magia y nuevos conocimientos y habilidades. Si estás creando un personaje de nivel superior al 1, los objetos mágicos que posea podrían haberle sido otorgados por la carta de la Llave o del Sol.

entries.name: Rewarded Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla de abalorios de recompensa en lugar de en la tabla de abalorios del {@book Player's Handbook|PHB} para elegir tu abalorio inicial.

rows: A perfumed silk scarf from an admirer
A crystal bead that glows like a candle in the dark
A letter of introduction and invitation from an influential person in a far-off city
A motto or symbol whose meaning eludes you, etched on a piece of your equipment
A crisp playing card that never seems to tear or soil, depicting the card that affected you
Half a medallion designed to be rejoined to its other half

_.special: ledger from your previous employer containing a small piece of useful information

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, a ledger from your previous employer containing a small piece of useful information, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Inside Informant
entries: Tienes contactos con tu antiguo empleador o con otros grupos con los que trataste durante tu anterior empleo. Puedes comunicarte con tus contactos y obtener información, a criterio del director de juego.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Si quedaste satisfecho con tus prácticas anteriores, es posible que la despedida fuera amistosa. Si no fue así, quizá tuviste que salir del recinto escoltado por guardias armados. Si te pasaron por alto en tu puesto anterior, es posible que te quedaras con una mezcla de rabia contenida, indiferencia fingida y un profundo conocimiento de dónde están enterrados los cadáveres (quizá literalmente).

rows: My previous employer didn't respect me, and now I'll do whatever I can to gain respect.
The job is important, but the relationships I forge with my coworkers are even more so.
The job is everything to me. Who needs relaxation, hobbies, and a social life?
I know I'm not the best and brightest, but if I put my best self forward, I can overcome anything.
My former boss was an idiot. So was my boss before that. And before that. I'm sure those were all coincidences.
This company is so much better than my previous one. It will always be the best until they stop paying me.
I know this dagger belongs to the company, but I'm sure they won't miss it. Or this flask. Or this armor.
It's only a matter of time before I'll be upper management. I just have to kiss up to my superiors and kick down those beneath me.
Advancement. Money and power can be gained more easily within an organization. I plan to gain as much as possible. (Evil)
Structure. Life goes much more smoothly when you follow the rules and work within a system. (Lawful)
Uncertainty. The more chaos that swirls around me, the more opportunities I can find to profit. (Chaotic)
Justice. I can't stand people being treated unjustly. I do whatever it takes to stop injustice and those who flout the law. (Lawful)
Pleasure. What's the use of working hard and making money if you can't enjoy the finer things in life? (Any)
Power. Money is fine, but real power means never having to say you're sorry. (Evil)
I have a family member in need. I consider them in everything I do.
My peers keep me grounded.
My past mistakes cost someone else dearly. I have to rectify that.
A childhood mentor put me on my current path. If I succeed, I want to repay that mentor in some way.
I value an oath of loyalty I took to a group of friends over everything else in my life.
Although I don't get along well with people, my pet means the world to me.
I know what's best. Trust me.
Flaw? I have no flaws. I'm perfect.
My loyalties are... fluid.
If anything goes wrong, it must be someone else's fault. Let me explain that in detail.
There's right and there's wrong, and there's no gray area in between.
Our superiors might not like what you're doing. I'm going to have to put that in my report.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A cracked {@item hourglass|PHB}, a set of rusty {@item manacles|PHB}, a half-empty bottle, a {@item hunting trap|PHB}, a {@item gaming set|PHB} (matching your chosen proficiency), a set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 13 gp

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
entries: One {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} of your choice (such as playing cards or three-dragon ante cards)

entries.name: Feature: Still Standing
entries: Has superado una desgracia devastadora y posees reservas ocultas que los demás no esperan. Obtienes la dotación {@feat Alert}, {@feat Skilled} o {@feat Tough} (a tu elección). Tu elección de la hazaña refleja cómo has afrontado la terrible pérdida que cambió tu vida para siempre. Si has mantenido tus sentidos alerta ante cada oportunidad y has salido de la miseria aferrándote al más mínimo atisbo de esperanza, elige Alerta. Si has redoblado tus esfuerzos para recuperar lo que una vez fue tuyo, elige Hábil. Si has perseverado estoicamente a pesar de tu desgracia, elige Resistente.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Superar las adversidades moldea la perspectiva de uno. La tabla «Rasgos de personalidad arruinados» sugiere rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje (y cartas de ruina que podrían haber dado lugar a ese rasgo).

rows: I've changed from my past, and I work to live up to my new path. (Balance, Throne)
Every moment is a gift I refuse to squander. (Euryale, Skull)
Now that I've overcome having nothing, I can survive anything. (Fool, Ruin, Talons)
I know enemies are set against me, and I always prepare for the worst. (Flames, Rogue)
I interpret every event as part of a larger pattern I just haven't worked out yet. (Puzzle, Star)
I must make up for so much time I've already lost. (Donjon, Void)

entries.name: Building a Ruined Character
entries: Los personajes arruinados estaban en la cima del mundo antes de que les sobreviniera la desgracia. Muchos eran ricos. Otros procedían de entornos modestos, pero estaban rodeados de amigos, familiares y seres queridos. Quizá fueran famosos, o simplemente nunca antes se habían enfrentado a dificultades graves. Algunos nacieron en el seno de familias privilegiadas o alcanzaron la fama mediante el engaño o una reputación falsa. Ahora, una {@item Deck of Many Things} —u otra calamidad— los ha derribado como un castillo de naipes.

Si la vida de tu personaje se ha visto arruinada por una {@item Deck of Many Things}, piensa qué carta fue la responsable. Quizás tu personaje estuvo encarcelado durante años por la carta «Donjon» o «Void», y ahora todos sus conocidos han fallecido. Quizá tu personaje robó la carta «Rogue», y la persona más cercana a él —su cónyuge, un hijo o un padre— se volvió en su contra. Un demonio desatado por la carta «Flames» podría haberle destrozado la vida. La carta Ruina o Garras podría haberle robado sus bienes materiales o haberle cargado con una enorme deuda.

entries.name: Ruined Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla de «Abalorios estropeados» en lugar de en la tabla de «Abalorios» del {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.

rows: A rusted scrap of a once-beloved family heirloom
A land deed, but all the names and markings that once tied it to you have faded into obscurity
A bauble once imbued with powerful magic
A battered playing card with a hole pierced in it, its face depicting the card that affected you
A yellowed Humanoid tooth that whispers eerily when placed under a pillow
A keepsake from someone you were once close to but who is now your enemy

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} (one of your choice), a small knife, a {@item whetstone|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Rune Styles
entries: Cada tallador de runas tiene un estilo único y un material preferido. Para determinar cómo creas tus runas, puedes tirar en la tabla de estilos de runas.

entries.caption: Rune Style
rows: You inscribe runes in wax or clay with a fine metal needle.
You whittle pieces of wood into small figurines you mark with runes.
You engrave runes onto glass beads and thread them onto necklaces and bracelets.
You stitch runes into the hems of clothing.
You carve runes on a set of animal bones you can throw in different formations.
You draw runes into candles, melting the wax to smooth over the engravings.

entries.name: Building a Rune Carver Character
entries: Las investigaciones académicas, los misterios antiguos o un encuentro decisivo podrían inspirar a un personaje a indagar en los secretos de un tallador de runas.

entries.name: Feature: Rune Shaper
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Rune Shaper|BGG}.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: La tabla de rasgos de personalidad del «Rune Carver» sugiere una variedad de rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

rows: Is it practical to learn an ancient language that is rarely spoken? No. But is it fun? Very.
I learned one of my ancestors was a lauded rune carver whose story was lost to time. I seek to rekindle that legacy.
The old, traditional markings of runecraft look so boring. Why not give my runes some flair?
In my studies of runes, I strive to understand how great civilizations of the past fell, so I can prevent it from happening to societies of the present.
Life may be a whirlwind of chaos, but whenever I create my runes, I feel at peace.
My brain struggles to process words written in ink, but the feeling of carved runes makes my mind sing.

_.special: letter from a dead colleague posing a question you have not yet been able to answer

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|phb|bottle of black ink}, a quill, a small knife, a letter from a dead colleague posing a question you have not yet been able to answer, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Researcher
entries: Cuando intentas aprender o recordar un dato de la tradición, si no conoces esa información, a menudo sabes dónde y de quién puedes obtenerla. Por lo general, esta información procede de una biblioteca, un scriptorium, una universidad, o de un sabio u otra persona o criatura erudita. Tu DM podría decidir que el conocimiento que buscas está oculto en un lugar casi inaccesible, o que simplemente no se puede encontrar. Desenterrar los secretos más profundos del multiverso puede requerir una aventura o incluso toda una campaña.

entries.name: Specialty
entries: Para determinar la naturaleza de tu formación académica, tira un dado de 8 caras o elige una de las opciones de la tabla siguiente.

rows: Alchemist
Astronomer
Discredited academic
Librarian
Professor
Researcher
Wizard's apprentice
Scribe

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los sabios se caracterizan por sus extensos estudios, y sus rasgos reflejan esta vida dedicada al estudio. Entregado a la investigación académica, un sabio valora enormemente el conocimiento, a veces por sí mismo y otras como medio para alcanzar otros ideales.

rows: I use polysyllabic words that convey the impression of great erudition.
I've read every book in the world's greatest libraries—or I like to boast that I have.
I'm used to helping out those who aren't as smart as I am, and I patiently explain anything and everything to others.
There's nothing I like more than a good mystery.
I'm willing to listen to every side of an argument before I make my own judgment.
I... speak... slowly... when talking... to idiots,... which... almost... everyone... is... compared... to me.
I am horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.
I'm convinced that people are always trying to steal my secrets.
Knowledge. The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge. (Neutral)
Beauty. What is beautiful points us beyond itself toward what is true. (Good)
Logic. Emotions must not cloud our logical thinking. (Lawful)
No Limits. Nothing should fetter the infinite possibility inherent in all existence. (Chaotic)
Power. Knowledge is the path to power and domination. (Evil)
Self-Improvement. The goal of a life of study is the betterment of oneself. (Any)
It is my duty to protect my students.
I have an ancient text that holds terrible secrets that must not fall into the wrong hands.
I work to preserve a library, university, scriptorium, or monastery.
My life's work is a series of tomes related to a specific field of lore.
I've been searching my whole life for the answer to a certain question.
I sold my soul for knowledge. I hope to do great deeds and win it back.
I am easily distracted by the promise of information.
Most people scream and run when they see a demon. I stop and take notes on its anatomy.
Unlocking an ancient mystery is worth the price of a civilization.
I overlook obvious solutions in favor of complicated ones.
I speak without really thinking through my words, invariably insulting others.
I can't keep a secret to save my life, or anyone else's.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff|XPHB}, {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Book|XPHB} (history), {@item Parchment|XPHB} (8 sheets), {@item Robe|XPHB}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A belaying pin ({@item club|phb}), {@item silk rope (50 feet)|phb}, a lucky charm such as a rabbit foot or a small stone with a hole in the center (or you may roll for a random {@item trinket|phb} on the Trinkets table in chapter 5), a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Ship's Passage
entries: Cuando lo necesites, puedes conseguir un pasaje gratuito en un velero para ti y tus compañeros de aventura. Podrías navegar en el barco en el que serviste o en otro con el que tengas buenas relaciones (quizás uno capitaneado por un antiguo compañero de tripulación). Como estás pidiendo un favor, no puedes estar seguro de que el horario o la ruta se ajusten a todas tus necesidades. Tu Dungeon Master determinará cuánto tiempo tardaréis en llegar a vuestro destino. A cambio del pasaje gratuito, se espera que tú y tus compañeros ayudéis a la tripulación durante el viaje.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los marineros pueden ser gente dura, pero las responsabilidades de la vida a bordo de un barco también los convierten, por lo general, en personas de confianza. La vida a bordo moldea su forma de ver el mundo y da forma a sus vínculos más importantes.

rows: My friends know they can rely on me, no matter what.
I work hard so that I can play hard when the work is done.
I enjoy sailing into new ports and making new friends over a flagon of ale.
I stretch the truth for the sake of a good story.
To me, a tavern brawl is a nice way to get to know a new city.
I never pass up a friendly wager.
My language is as foul as an otyugh nest.
I like a job well done, especially if I can convince someone else to do it.
Respect. The thing that keeps a ship together is mutual respect between captain and crew. (Good)
Fairness. We all do the work, so we all share in the rewards. (Lawful)
Freedom. The sea is freedom—the freedom to go anywhere and do anything. (Chaotic)
Mastery. I'm a predator, and the other ships on the sea are my prey. (Evil)
People. I'm committed to my crewmates, not to ideals. (Neutral)
Aspiration. Someday, I'll own my own ship and chart my own destiny. (Any)
I'm loyal to my captain first, everything else second.
The ship is most important—crewmates and captains come and go.
I'll always remember my first ship.
In a harbor town, I have a paramour whose eyes nearly stole me from the sea.
I was cheated out of my fair share of the profits, and I want to get my due.
Ruthless pirates murdered my captain and crewmates, plundered our ship, and left me to die. Vengeance will be mine.
I follow orders, even if I think they're wrong.
I'll say anything to avoid having to do extra work.
Once someone questions my courage, I never back down no matter how dangerous the situation.
Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.
I can't help but pocket loose coins and other trinkets I come across.
My pride will probably lead to my destruction.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|XPHB}, {@item Navigator's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Rope|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Fine Clothes|XPHB}, {@item Lamp|XPHB}, {@item Oil|XPHB} (3 flasks), {@item Parchment|XPHB} (12 sheets), 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item disguise kit|phb}, a {@item forgery kit|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a belt {@item pouch|phb}, 5 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Modesto

entries.name: Overview
entries: Aunque no seas humano, y a pesar de la Gran Ley de la Humanidad de Hillsfar, sigues viviendo en la Ciudad del Comercio. Lo haces manteniendo una identidad secreta, falsificando documentos y llevando un disfraz. Pocos, si es que hay alguno, saben que no eres humano. Si eres un halfling o un gnomo, pasas por una persona de baja estatura o por un niño. Si eres un semielfo, un semiorco o un genasi, disimulas tus rasgos no humanos. Otras razas utilizan una combinación de disfraces y ropa que oculta su figura para pasar desapercibidas. Tus razones para hacerlo son personales. Quizás seas un disidente o el agente de una potencia extranjera. Tal vez tengas una relación con alguien a quien no soportas dejar. Sea como sea, esta forma de vida te ha pasado factura.

entries.name: Feature: Secret Identity
entries: Has creado una identidad secreta que utilizas para ocultar tu verdadera raza y que te sirve de excusa para justificar tu presencia en Hillsfar. Además, puedes falsificar documentos, incluidos documentos oficiales y cartas personales, siempre y cuando hayas visto un ejemplo del tipo de documento o de la letra que intentas imitar. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Charlatán».

rows: Despite its problems, I love Hillsfar, it's the greatest city in the world. The only one for me.
I move from place to place, never staying anywhere long and leaving nothing behind.
I think flattery is the best way to direct attention away from me.
I don't make friends easily. They're a liability I cannot afford.
Risk and danger are exhilarate me. Pulling off schemes and deceptions is a rush.
The First Lord is right, humans are superior. I really admire them, despite the atrocities.
I avoid people of my own race, as well as things associated with my race, lest they give me away.
I live for the Arena. I admire gladiators and enjoy the thrill of blood on the sands!
Quisling. Supporting the rulers of the land and following the laws is the road to salvation. (Lawful)
Scoflaw. The laws and lawmakers are corrupt. I follow laws only when it suits me. (Chaotic)
Optimist. Everyone Is basically good. Though the government is misguided it will all be okay. (Any)
Secretive. I am in the habit of not talking about myself. My business is none of yours. (Any)
Heroic. I do everything I can to help non-humans, regardless of the personal cost to me. (Good)
Depraved. I have lost my moral compass. The ends justify most any means. (Evil)
The humans of Hillsfar have inflicted terrible harm on me, my family, and my race. I will have revenge.
I am part of an underground network that smuggles non-humans into and out of the city.
I am a partisan. I commit minor acts of defiance against the First Lord and Red Plumes when I can.
I am a spy. I report on events in and around Hillsfar.
My secret identity is the only thing protecting me from the Arena. I will stop at nothing to maintain it.
I am madly in love with a human who does not know my true identity, and I fear rejection if I reveal it.
After years of denying who I am, I now despise myself and other members of my pathetic race.
Years of hiding have made me somewhat paranoid. I trust no one.
I've been lying so often and for so long that I can't help it anymore. I frequently lie for no reason at all.
I am ashamed. I failed to protect a member of my family who was seized and thrown into the Area.
I am struggling with maintaining my secret identity. I subconsciously want to get caught and therefore sometimes let my secret identity slip.
Years of successfully deceiving others have made me cocky. I think no one can see through my lies.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or one {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: Choose one of Elvish, Loxodon, or Sylvan

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A Selesnya insignia, a {@item healer's kit|phb}, {@item robes|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp (Azorius 1-zino coins)

entries.name: Feature: Conclave's Shelter
entries: Como miembro del Conclave de Selesnya, puedes contar con que tus compañeros de gremio te proporcionen refugio y ayuda. Tú y tus compañeros podéis encontrar un lugar donde esconderos o descansar en cualquier enclave de Selesnya de la ciudad, a menos que hayáis demostrado ser un peligro para ellos. Los miembros del enclave os protegerán de la ley o de cualquiera que os busque, aunque no arriesgarán sus vidas por ello.
Además, como miembro del gremio, puedes recibir curación y cuidados gratuitos en un enclave de Selesnya, aunque deberás proporcionar los componentes materiales necesarios para los hechizos.

entries.name: Selesnya Guild Spells
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

En tu caso, los hechizos de la tabla de hechizos del gremio Selesnya se añaden a la lista de hechizos de tu clase con capacidad para lanzar hechizos. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de hechizos, estos hechizos se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Selesnya Guild Spells
rows: Cantrip
{@spell druidcraft}, {@spell friends}
1st
{@spell animal friendship}, {@spell charm person}
2nd
{@spell aid}, {@spell animal messenger}, {@spell calm emotions}, {@spell warding bond}
3rd
{@spell plant growth}, {@spell speak with plants}
4th
{@spell aura of life}, {@spell conjure minor elementals}
5th
{@spell awaken}, {@spell commune with nature}

entries: Los miembros del Cónclave de Selesnya se refieren a su magia como «doruvati», una palabra silvana que significa «don». Cuando utilizas estos dones de Mat'Selesnya, elegantes remolinos de luz verde y plateada bailan en el aire a tu alrededor, y es posible que hojas verdes fantasmales floten en el aire. Una sensación de suave calidez y el aroma de las flores de primavera o las hojas de otoño pueden acompañar tus hechizos.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: La mayoría de los miembros del Cónclave de Selesnya son auténticos creyentes: esta comunidad tan unida deja poco espacio para los cínicos o los desilusionados. Son espirituales, empáticos y, por lo general, pacíficos, a menos que se vean impulsados a actuar. Tanto sus defectos como sus vínculos surgen de forma natural de su estrecha relación con la comunidad.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I never raise my voice or lose my temper.
I feel the pains and joys of everyone around me, friend or foe.
I would rather make a friend than thwart an enemy.
I'm always straining to peer into another reality that seems to be just beyond my senses.
I'm uneasy if I can't see plants growing or feel soil beneath my feet.
Seeing illness or injury in any creature saddens me.
I have much to be proud of, but I am still just one strand in the grand, interwoven tapestry of life.
Nature offers rich and abundant metaphors for understanding the complexities of life.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Guild}. My guild is all that really matters. (Any)
{@b Harmony}. Nothing is more beautiful than voices and actions aligned in common purpose. (Good)
{@b Order}. Like a well-pruned tree, society thrives when everything is kept in good order. (Lawful)
{@b Life}. Preserving life and nature is always a worthwhile endeavor. (Good)
{@b Humility}. Ambition and pride are the roots of strife. (Good)
{@b Evangelism}. When all have joined the Selesnya Conclave, Ravnica will finally know peace. (Any)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I would give my life in the defense of the small enclave where I first encountered Mat'Selesnya.
I love beasts and plants of all kinds, and am loath to harm them.
A healer nursed me to recovery from a mortal illness.
I'll sing the invitation of Mat'Selesnya with my dying breath.
I cherish a leaf from Vitu-Ghazi that changes color with the seasons, even though it is no longer attached to the tree.
Every member of the conclave is my kin, and I would fight for any one of them.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I'm terrified of getting into a fight where my side is outnumbered.
I assume that people mean well until they prove otherwise.
I enjoy comfort and quiet, and prefer to avoid extra effort.
I have a fierce temper that doesn't reflect the inner calm I seek.
I'm convinced that everyone else in the conclave has a deeper connection to the Worldsoul than I do.
I'm trying to atone for the life of crime I led before I joined the Selesnya, but I find it hard to give up my bad habits.

entries.name: Contacts
entries: El Conclave de Selesnya se basa en las conexiones, por lo que sus miembros cultivan contactos en todo el gremio. El gremio también lleva a cabo una intensa campaña de reclutamiento para atraer a miembros de otros gremios, y a menudo estos nuevos miembros mantienen la amistad con sus antiguos compañeros de gremio.
Tira dos veces en la tabla de «Contactos de Selesnya» (para un aliado y un rival) y una vez en la tabla de «Contactos que no son de Selesnya».

entries.caption: Selesnya Contacts
rows: A wise centaur trainer believed in me even though I was a terrible student.
A good friend has risen to become a Ledev guardian.
I left my former guild and joined the Selesnya along with a close friend.
The dryad at the head of my enclave has taken an interest in my activities.
A sibling is an instructor at the guild's training grounds.
One of my parents is a votary, tasked with protecting the temple gardens at the Vitu-Ghazi guildhall.
I had a romance with a well-known Selesnya healer.
Trostani, the head of the guild and the voice of Mat'Selesnya, once welcomed me into her presence.

entries.caption: Non-Selesnya Contacts
rows: I left the Azorius, and a former colleague still resents me for that act.
A good friend, eager for action, left the Selesnya and joined the Boros.
I had a relationship with a guild mate who turned out to be a Dimir agent.
I know a disgruntled Golgari assassin who is ripe for recruitment.
I'm friendly with a Gruul centaur who almost joined us a few years back.
I once had a heated public argument with an Izzet chemister, and neither of us is allowed back into that restaurant.
I paid off my debt to the Orzhov Syndicate, but my good friend was not so lucky and remains indebted to that guild.
At a time of terrible grief in my life, a Rakdos performer made a mockery of my pain, leaving me with mixed feelings of sadness and humor.
Roll an additional Selesnya contact; you can decide if the contact is an ally or a rival.
I have a sibling in the Simic Combine, and we argue every time we see each other.

entries.name: How Do I Fit In?
entries: Aunque el gremio enseña la importancia de subordinar la voluntad individual al bien del cónclave, también valora la diversidad de las personas, del mismo modo que un campo en el que se cultivan diferentes cosechas es más saludable que uno en el que solo se cultiva una. Ese principio se aplica a tus habilidades como aventurero. Siempre que tus esfuerzos se dirijan a promover los objetivos del gremio en lugar de tus intereses personales, se te permite poner en práctica tus talentos a tu manera.

Dicho esto, nunca debes perder de vista que formas parte de una comunidad más amplia. Esto incluye a todo el gremio, por supuesto, pero tus vínculos con la comunidad comienzan con tu vernadi (enclave) y su voda (líder dríada). Las dríadas quieren saber qué estás haciendo y qué propósito tiene, y actuarán para limitar tus acciones —o incluso expulsarte del gremio— si determinan que no estás velando por los intereses de Selesnya.

_.special: transparent cylinder of shadow that has no opening

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item forgery kit|phb}, a transparent cylinder of shadow that has no opening, a {@item signet ring|phb}, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and 15 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Modesto

entries.name: Overview
entries: Creciste en una época en la que los magos de Netheril estaban en guerra con los elfos de Cormanthor. Recuerdas estar sentado con las piernas cruzadas escuchando las historias de la gloriosa Thultanthar, también conocida como el Enclave de las Sombras y la Ciudad de las Sombras, y aspirabas a estudiar allí; quizá incluso lo hiciste, durante un tiempo. Tus sueños se hicieron añicos hace unos años, cuando Thultanthar cayó del cielo sobre Myth Drannor.

Sabes que había una guarnición de Netheril acuartelada cerca de Hillsfar y has oído rumores de que su caída se debió a traidores entre sus propias filas. Sigues siendo leal a Netheril y buscas a otros partidarios y fanáticos de Shade en el bosque de Cormanthor y en los alrededores de Hillsfar.

entries.name: Feature: Secret Society
entries: Tienes una forma especial de comunicarte con otras personas que comparten tu misma opinión sobre la Sombra. Cuando entras en un pueblo o en una ciudad más grande, puedes identificar a contactos que te proporcionarán información sobre quienes podrían obstaculizar tus objetivos y quienes te ayudarían, simplemente por tu deseo de ver cómo el Enclave de la Sombra recupera todo su esplendor. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Criminal».

rows: I am a bully; I try to hide it though.
I let my actions speak for themselves
I am important; I will not let anyone forget that.
You are either with me or against me.
I know it is only a time before I am betrayed by those I care for.
I never understand why people get so emotional.
They are out to get me. It is only my cunning that keeps me ahead of them
Everyone has a choice, the one I make is always right though.
Hope. I know even if I need do evil acts, history will be my redemption. (Chaos)
Dedicated. I can do anything I put my mind to (Lawful)
Exciting. I have found the truth of the Shadovar and want to share it with everyone. (Any)
Frugal. I horde my possessions knowing that someday I will be called upon to give everything I have to the cause (Any)
Eloquent. I use my words to sway others to my beliefs. (Any)
Compassionate. It is through love that others will join in our cause. (Good)
They say the Shade broke the bonds of mortality; I want to find out how.
The whispers in my head remind me that there is power to be found in the shadows.
For the glory of Netheril, I will grow in power.
I once lived in Hillsfar, I was chased out before I was able to say farewell.
My true love was a killed by the Red Plumes; I plot to make them suffer.
I had a loved one die in the arena at Hillsfar; I am out to prove I am stronger than them!
I always over exaggerate my abilities.
I cannot bear to let those I care for out of my sight.
I am incapable of standing up for myself.
The group I am with has committed atrocities; I am always worried their actions will become public.
I always enjoy a good mug of ale... or five.
I know what I do is wrong, but am afraid to speak up about it.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of well-loved {@item carpenter's tools|phb}, a blank {@item book|phb}, {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|phb|1 ounce of ink}, an {@item ink pen|phb}, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, and a leather {@item pouch|phb} with 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: I'll Patch It!
entries: Siempre que dispongas de herramientas de carpintero y madera, puedes realizar reparaciones en un vehículo acuático. Al usar esta habilidad, restauras un número de puntos de vida en el casco de un vehículo acuático igual a 5 × tu modificador de competencia. No podrás volver a reparar un vehículo de esta forma hasta que haya sido arrastrado a tierra y reparado por completo.

entries.name: Life at Sea
entries: Tu vida en el mar y en puerto te ha moldeado; puedes consultar la siguiente tabla para determinar su impacto o elegir el elemento que mejor se adapte a tu personaje.

rows: {@b Grand Designs.} You are working on plans and schematics for a new, very fast ship. You must examine as many different kinds of vessels as possible to help ensure the success of your design.
{@b Solid and Sound.} You patched up a war galley and prevented it from sinking. The local navy regards you as a friend.

{@b Favored.} You insisted on thicker planking for a merchant vessel's hull, which saved it from sinking when it smashed against a reef. You have a standing invitation to visit the merchant's distant mansion.
{@b Master of Armaments.} You specialized in designing and mounting defenses for the navy. You easily recognize and determine the quality of such items.
{@b Low Places.} You have contacts in the smuggling outfits along the coast; you occasionally repair the criminals' ships in exchange for coin and favors.

{@b Mysteries of the Deep.} You experienced an encounter with a possibly divine being while sailing alone. Work with your DM to determine the secret about the deep waters of the sea that this entity revealed to you.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los carpinteros navales son artesanos y diseñadores ingeniosos. A menudo tienen su mesa habitual en la taberna local, ya que son indispensables para las comunidades costeras. Algunos viajan con flotas navales y pueden llegar a ocupar cargos de oficial si su carácter se lo permite. Los carpinteros navales sienten una gran afinidad por el trabajo manual y a menudo realizan hazañas de carpintería que otros podrían considerar milagrosas.

entries.caption: Shipwright Personality Traits
rows: I love talking and being heard more than I like to listen.
I'm extremely fond of puzzles.
I thrive under pressure.
I love sketching and designing objects, especially boats.
I'm not afraid of hard work—in fact, I prefer it.
A pipe, an ale, and the smell of the sea: paradise.
I have an endless supply of cautionary tales related to the sea.
I don't mind getting my hands dirty.

entries.caption: Shipwright Ideals
rows: Crew. If everyone on deck pitches in, we'll never sink. (Good)
Careful Lines. A ship must be balanced according to the laws of the universe. (Lawful)
Invention. Make what you need out of whatever is at hand. (Chaotic)
Perfection. To measure a being and find it lacking is the greatest disappointment. (Evil)
Reflection. Muddied water always clears in time. (Any)
Hope. The horizon at sea holds the greatest promise. (Any)

entries.caption: Shipwright Bonds
rows: I must visit all the oceans of the world and behold the ships that sail there.
Much of the treasure I claim will be used to enrich my community.
I must find a kind of wood rumored to possess magical qualities.
I repair broken things to redeem what's broken in myself.
I will craft a boat capable of sailing through the most dangerous of storms.
A kraken destroyed my masterpiece; its teeth shall adorn my hearth.

entries.caption: Shipwright Flaws
rows: I don't know when to throw something away. You never know when it might be useful again.
I get frustrated to the point of distraction by shoddy craftsmanship.
Though I am an excellent crafter, my work tends to look as though it belongs on a ship.
I am so obsessed with sketching my ideas for elaborate inventions that I sometimes forget little thing like eating and sleeping.
I'm judgmental of those who are not skilled with tools of some kind.
I sometimes take things that don't belong to me, especially if they are very well made.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of black ink}, an {@item ink pen|PHB}, a book of poetry, a school uniform, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Silverquill Initiate
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Strixhaven Initiate|SCC} y debes elegir «Pluma de Plata» dentro de ella.

Además, si tienes la característica «Lanzamiento de conjuros» o «Magia de pacto», los conjuros de la tabla «Conjuros de Pluma de Plata» se añaden a la lista de conjuros de tu clase de lanzador de conjuros. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de conjuros, estos conjuros se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Silverquill Spells
rows: 1st
{@spell Dissonant Whispers}, {@spell Silvery Barbs|SCC}
2nd
{@spell Calm Emotions}, {@spell Darkness}
3rd
{@spell Beacon of Hope}, {@spell Daylight}
4th
{@spell Compulsion}, {@spell Confusion}
5th
{@spell Dominate Person}, {@spell Rary's Telepathic Bond}

entries: Considera la posibilidad de personalizar el aspecto de tus hechizos cuando los lances. Tus hechizos de Pluma de Plata podrían ir acompañados de efectos visuales que se asemejen a manchas de tinta o a ondas radiante de luz dorada. Los efectos sonoros de tus hechizos suelen sonar como ecos amplificados de tu propia voz al pronunciar los componentes verbales de los hechizos, incluso en medio del estruendo de un rayo o de una erupción de fuego.

entries.name: Building a Silverquill Character
entries: Muchos bardos encuentran su hogar en Silverquill, donde aprovechan el poder de sus voces combinándolo con la magia de Silverquill. Los magos (especialmente aquellos que estudian las escuelas de {@class Wizard|PHB|Illusion|Illusion|PHB} y {@class Wizard|PHB|Enchantment|Enchantment|PHB}) son habituales en Silverquill, al igual que los brujos. Los clérigos con los dominios divinos de {@class Cleric|PHB|Light|Light|PHB} y {@class Cleric|PHB|Trickery|Trickery|PHB} también encajan bien entre los magos de Silverquill.
También hay varios paladines y pícaros que estudian en el Colegio Pluma de Plata, lo que pone de manifiesto la diversidad del alumnado.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Con las exigentes normas de la universidad acechándoles, los alumnos de Silverquill van desde los arrogantes y despiadados hasta los perfeccionistas abrumados. La tabla de rasgos de personalidad de Silverquill sugiere una variedad de rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

entries.caption: Silverquill Personality Traits
rows: I'll say whatever I need to in order to maintain my high social status.
I prefer saying the blunt truth over a pretty lie, and I don't particularly care whose feelings I hurt.
I believe that uplifting my peers is the best way to succeed.
I've mastered the art of using humor as a defense, and I always have a charming joke ready.
I always wait before speaking, analyzing the situation for whichever angle is most advantageous to my goals.
No one knows about the all-nighters I've pulled to keep my magic looking effortless, and I'm going to keep it that way.

entries.name: Silverquill Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla {@item Silverquill Trinket|SCC|Silverquill Trinkets}, en lugar de en la tabla {@item trinket|phb|Trinkets table} del {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, para elegir tu amuleto inicial.

_.displayName: vial of acid (derived from digestive juices)

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A Simic insignia, a set of {@item common clothes|phb|commoner's clothes}, a {@item book|phb} of research notes, an {@item ink pen|phb}, a {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|phb|bottle of squid ink}, a {@item oil (flask)|phb|flask of oil} (made from blubber), a {@item acid (vial)|phb|vial of acid} (derived from digestive juices), a vial of fish scales, a vial of seaweed, a vial of jellyfish stingers, a glass bottle of unidentified slime, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp (Azorius 1-zino coins)

entries.name: Clades and Projects
entries: Como investigador Simic, formas parte de un clado —un grupo diverso de personas que aúnan talentos dispares en pos de un objetivo común— o eres investigador en un proyecto especializado y de corta duración centrado en abordar una necesidad inmediata. Puedes tirar un {@dice d6} o elegir entre las opciones de la tabla «Opciones de investigación» para determinar tu área de investigación.

entries.caption: Research Options
rows: Hull Clade, focused on protection and durability
Fin Clade, focused on movement
Gyre Clade, focused on cyclical patterns and metamagic
Guardian Project, focused on creating guard monsters and super soldiers
Crypsis Project, focused on intelligence and counterintelligence
Independent research in a new area

entries.name: Feature: Researcher
entries: Cuando intentas aprender o recordar un dato mágico o científico, si no conoces esa información, sabes dónde y de quién puedes obtenerla. Por lo general, esta información procede de un laboratorio Simic o, en ocasiones, de una instalación Izzet, una biblioteca, una universidad o un erudito independiente u otra persona o criatura culta. Saber dónde se puede encontrar la información no te permite aprenderla automáticamente; es posible que tengas que ofrecer sobornos, favores u otros incentivos para inducir a la gente a revelar sus secretos.

Tu DM podría decidir que el conocimiento que buscas está oculto en un lugar inaccesible, o que simplemente no se puede encontrar. Desentrañar los secretos más profundos del multiverso puede requerir una aventura o incluso toda una campaña.

entries.name: Simic Guild Spells
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature}

En tu caso, los hechizos de la tabla «Hechizos del gremio Simic» se añaden a la lista de hechizos de tu clase con capacidad para lanzar hechizos. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de hechizos, estos hechizos se añaden a todas ellas.)

rows: Cantrip
{@spell acid splash}, {@spell druidcraft}
1st

2nd

3rd
{@spell gaseous form}, {@spell water breathing}, {@spell wind wall}
