entries: Cuando tu magia provoca alteraciones físicas en ti mismo o en los demás, el resultado suele presentar características propias de peces, anfibios u otras criaturas acuáticas. A veces, tu lanzamiento de hechizos va acompañado de remolinos azul verdosos de energía mágica, que forman espirales que reflejan la perfección matemática de la naturaleza.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: La extraña ciencia de la Combinación Simic atrae a un determinado tipo de personalidad y abarca un conjunto de creencias sobre la naturaleza de la vida. Los vínculos y defectos de los miembros de Simic se derivan de su investigación científica, incluida la creación de nuevas formas de vida, a las que pueden llegar a encariñarse mucho.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I can't wait to see what I become next!
I am convinced that everything inclines toward constant improvement.
I'm eager to explain every detail of my most intricate experiments and theories to anyone who shows the least bit of interest.
I assume that everyone needs even the most basic concepts explained to them.
I describe everything that happens as if it were going into my research notes (and it often is).
I am insatiably curious about the seemingly infinite forms and adaptations of life.
I can't resist prying into anything forbidden, since it must be terribly interesting.
I employ a highly technical vocabulary to avoid imprecision and ambiguity in my communication.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: {@b Guild}. My guild is all that really matters. (Any)
{@b Change}. All life is meant to progress toward perfection, and our work is to hurry it along—no matter what must be upended along the way. (Chaotic)
{@b Knowledge}. Understanding the world is more important than what you do with your knowledge. (Neutral)
{@b Greater Good}. I want to reshape the world into higher forms of life so that all can enjoy evolution. (Good)
{@b Logic}. It's foolish to let emotions and principles interfere with the conclusions of logic. (Lawful)
{@b Superiority}. My vast intellect and strength are directed toward increasing my sway over others. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I helped create a krasis that I love like a pet and would carry with me everywhere... except it's the size of a building, and it might eat me.
In my laboratory, I discovered something that I think could eliminate half the life on Ravnica.
The other researchers in my clade are my family—a big, eccentric family including members and parts of many species.
The laboratory where I did my research contains everything that is precious to me.
I will get revenge on the shortsighted fool who killed my precious krasis creation.
Everything I do is an attempt to impress someone I love.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I have a rather embarrassing mutation that I do everything I can to keep hidden.
I'm more interested in taking notes on monstrous anatomy than in fighting monsters.
Every social situation I'm in seems to lead to my asking rude personal questions.
I'm supremely confident in my ability to adapt to any situation and handle any danger.
I'll take any risk to earn recognition for my scientific brilliance.
I have a tendency to take shortcuts in my research and any other tasks I have to complete.

entries.name: Contacts
entries: La naturaleza cambiante de los clados, cuyos miembros proceden de distintos laboratorios y varían a medida que los investigadores descubren nuevos intereses, crea numerosas conexiones entre los Simic. Los miembros del gremio viven en sumideros acuáticos llamados «zonots», y su aislamiento los protege de tener mucho contacto con personas ajenas al gremio. No obstante, un buen número de miembros Simic son antiguos miembros de otros gremios.
Tira dos veces en la tabla de «Contactos Simic» (para un aliado y un rival) y una vez en la tabla de «Contactos no Simic».

entries.caption: Simic Contacts
rows: My research builds on my parents' work and takes it in interesting new directions.
If a serious problem confounds me, I can count on my mentor to provide clarity of thought.
A former laboratory colleague went on to work on the Guardian Project.
A former colleague has ventured into fields of research that are possibly immoral and almost certainly illegal.
A former lover is now the supervisor of a prominent clade.
My sibling has become an almost unrecognizable mutant.
An old friend has retreated into a secluded life as an ascetic deepsage, devoted to contemplating philosophical principles.
My former clade supervisor is now engaged in field research studying some of the largest beasts and monsters on Ravnica.

entries.caption: Non-Simic Contacts
rows: My older sibling is upset that I didn't follow them into the Azorius.
A Boros sergeant is always asking questions about my work, but I suspect they're genuinely curious.
A friend in my clade thinks I don't know they're a Dimir agent.
I helped a Golgari spore druid with the fertilization and growth of their fungus field.
I can't fathom what could have made my childhood friend run off and join the Gruul.
I love comparing notes with my friend in the Izzet, though our fields of research are very different.
I borrowed a lot of money from an Orzhov syndic to help finance my research.
A Rakdos ringmaster has taken an interest in my research which, come to think of it, might make a nice sideshow act.
I left the Selesnya—and a lover—behind when I joined the Simic.
Roll an additional Simic contact; you can decide if the contact is an ally or a rival.

entries.name: How Do I Fit In?
entries: Como aventurero Simic, es probable que tu misión esté en consonancia con la filosofía adaptacionista; las desavenencias y tensiones entre los gremios pronto desembocarán en un conflicto abierto, y tu gremio necesita tu ayuda para garantizar la supervivencia de los Simic. Esa ayuda podría consistir en defender los zonots Simic de las incursiones Golgari o proteger la investigación Simic de la intrusión Azorius. También podría implicar un trabajo diplomático más sutil para mantener el equilibrio entre los gremios, o subterfugios destinados a socavar el afán de poder de otro gremio.

El desarrollo personal también es una parte importante de tu misión. Cualquier cosa que puedas hacer para mejorar tus habilidades —ya sea aprender un nuevo hechizo o adoptar una nueva mutación híbrida— proporciona a los Simic un arma más poderosa en su arsenal. La confederación debe cambiar para sobrevivir, y eso significa que los miembros individuales del gremio también deben crecer y adaptarse.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A fancy leather vest or a pair of leather boots, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a leather {@item pouch|phb} with 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Down Low
entries: Conoces a una red de contrabandistas dispuestos a echarte una mano en situaciones difíciles. Cuando te encuentres en un pueblo, una ciudad u otra comunidad de tamaño similar (a criterio del DJ), tú y tus compañeros podéis alojaros gratis en refugios. La vida en los refugios es muy austera. Durante vuestra estancia en un refugio, podéis optar por mantener en secreto vuestra presencia (y la de vuestros compañeros).

entries.name: Claim to Fame
entries: Todo contrabandista tiene esa historia que lo distingue del resto de delincuentes comunes. Ya sea por tu ingenio, tu destreza como marinero o tu labia, has sobrevivido para contarlo... y lo cuentas a menudo. Puedes tirar en la siguiente tabla para determinar tu historia o elegir la que mejor se adapte a tu personaje.

rows: Spirit of the Whale. You smuggled stolen dwarven spirits in the body of a dead whale being pulled behind a fishing boat. When you delivered the goods, the corpse suddenly exploded, sending whale meat and whiskey bottles for half a mile.
Cart and Sword. You drove a cart filled with stolen art through the middle of a battlefield while singing sea shanties to confuse the combatants.
The Recruit. You enlisted in another nation's navy for the purpose of smuggling stolen jewels to a distant port. You attained a minor rank before disappearing from the navy and making your way here.

River of Shadows. Your riverboat accidentally slipped through the veil into the Shadowfell for several hours. While you were there, you sold some stolen dragonborn artifacts before returning to this plane and paddling home.

Gold-Hearted. You agreed to transport a family escaping a war. The baby began to cry at a checkpoint, and you gave the guards all your gold to let you pass. The family never found out about this gesture.

Playing Both Sides. You once smuggled crates of crossbow bolts and bundles of arrows, each destined for an opposing side in a regional war, at the same time. The buyers arrived within moments of each other but did not discover your trickery.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: En general, los contrabandistas anteponen la supervivencia y, después, el beneficio económico a cualquier otra cosa. Pueden formar parte de una organización más grande o dirigir su propia pequeña embarcación de contrabando. Los contrabandistas viven las mentiras que han contado y tienen una habilidad natural para recordar todas las falsedades y medias verdades que han soltado a lo largo de su vida.

entries.caption: Smuggler Personality Traits
rows: I love being on the water but hate fishing.
I think of everything in terms of monetary value.
I never stop smiling.
Nothing rattles me; I have a lie for every occasion.
I love gold but won't cheat a friend.
I enjoy doing things others believe to be impossible.
I become wistful when I see the sun rise over the ocean.
I am no common criminal; I am a mastermind.

entries.caption: Smuggler Ideals
rows: {@b Wealth} Heaps of coins in a secure vault is all I dream of. (Any)
{@b Smuggler's Code} I uphold the unwritten rules of the smugglers, who do not cheat one another or directly harm innocents. (Lawful)
{@b All for a Coin} I'll do nearly anything if it means I turn a profit. (Evil)
{@b Peace and Prosperity} I smuggle only to achieve a greater goal that benefits my community. (Good)
{@b People} For all my many lies, I place a high value on friendship. (Any)
{@b Daring} I am most happy when risking everything. (Any)

entries.caption: Smuggler Bonds
rows: My vessel was stolen from me, and I burn with the desire to recover it.
I intend to become the leader of the network of smugglers that I belong to.
I owe a debt that cannot be repaid in gold.
After one last job, I will retire from the business.
I was tricked by a fellow smuggler who stole something precious from me. I will find that thief.
I give most of my profits to a charitable cause, and I don't like to brag about it.

entries.caption: Smuggler Flaws
rows: Lying is reflexive, and I sometimes engage in it without realizing.
I tend to assess my relationships in terms of profit and loss.
I believe everyone has a price and am cynical toward those who present themselves as virtuous.
I struggle to trust the words of others.
Few people know the real me.
Though I act charming, I feel nothing for others and don't know what friendship is.

_.special: trophy taken from a fallen enemy (a dagger, broken blade, or piece of a banner)

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set}, {@filter vehicles (land)|items|source=phb;dmg|miscellaneous=mundane|type=vehicle (land)}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: An insignia of rank, a trophy taken from a fallen enemy (a {@item dagger|phb}, broken blade, or piece of a banner), a bone {@item dice set|phb} or {@item playing card set|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Military Rank
entries: Tienes un rango militar derivado de tu carrera como soldado. Los soldados leales a tu antigua organización militar siguen reconociendo tu autoridad e influencia, y te muestran respeto si son de rango inferior. Puedes invocar tu rango para ejercer influencia sobre otros soldados y requisar equipo básico o caballos para uso temporal. Por lo general, también puedes acceder a campamentos y fortalezas militares amigos donde se reconoce tu rango.

entries.name: Specialty
entries: Durante tu etapa como soldado, desempeñaste una función concreta en tu unidad o en el ejército. Tira un d8 o elige una de las opciones de la tabla siguiente para determinar cuál fue tu función:

rows: Officer
Scout
Infantry
Cavalry
Healer
Quartermaster
Standard-bearer
Support staff (cook, blacksmith, or the like)

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los horrores de la guerra, sumados a la rígida disciplina del servicio militar, dejan huella en todos los soldados, moldeando sus ideales, creando fuertes lazos y, a menudo, dejándolos marcados y vulnerables al miedo, la vergüenza y el odio.

rows: I'm always polite and respectful.
I'm haunted by memories of war. I can't get the images of violence out of my mind.
I've lost too many friends, and I'm slow to make new ones.
I'm full of inspiring and cautionary tales from my military experience relevant to almost every combat situation.
I can stare down a hell hound without flinching.
I enjoy being strong and like breaking things.
I have a crude sense of humor.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.
Greater Good. Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others. (Good)
Responsibility. I do what I must and obey just authority. (Lawful)
Independence. When people follow orders blindly, they embrace a kind of tyranny. (Chaotic)
Might. In life as in war, the stronger force wins. (Evil)
Live and Let Live. Ideals aren't worth killing over or going to war for. (Neutral)
Nation. My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)
I would still lay down my life for the people I served with.
Someone saved my life on the battlefield. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.
My honor is my life.
I'll never forget the crushing defeat my company suffered or the enemies who dealt it.
Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
The monstrous enemy we faced in battle still leaves me quivering with fear.
I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven warrior.
I made a terrible mistake in battle that cost many lives—and I would do anything to keep that mistake secret.
My hatred of my enemies is blinding and unreasoning.
I obey the law, even if the law causes misery.
I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.

items.entry: One type of {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set}, thieves' tools

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Pobre

entries.name: Overview
entries: «¡Tenemos que irnos, ahora mismo!». Esas palabras siguen rondando tus sueños por las noches. Cuando todo el mundo huía de Phlan, tú decidiste quedarte. Ya fuera por un vínculo emocional o por la búsqueda de riquezas, tomaste una decisión que marcaría el resto de tu vida.

La comida escaseaba cada vez más para quienes carecían de contactos. Te convertiste en mendigo y, para sobrevivir, intercambiabas información con cualquiera que tuviera comida u oro de sobra. Eras bueno en lo que hacías y te creías invencible. Eso cambió cuando te capturaron las Lágrimas de la Virulencia, los soldados de Vorgansharax, la Virulencia Mutilada, por vender secretos a quienes se empeñaban en derrocar al dragón. Te encerraron en las celdas de la Puerta de Stojanow. Las primeras semanas esperabas seguir con vida. A medida que las semanas se convertían en meses y los interrogatorios continuaban, empezaste a rezar por la muerte.

entries.name: Feature: Ex-Convict
entries: Los conocimientos adquiridos durante tu encarcelamiento te permiten conocer bien a los guardias y carceleros locales. Sabes cuáles aceptarán sobornos o harán la vista gorda por ti. También puedes buscar refugio frente a las autoridades junto a otros delincuentes de la zona. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Cortesano».

rows: I am a bully; others will suffer as I have.
I always say yes even when I mean no; it's just easier.
I aim to misbehave.
I go out of my way to frustrate or anger those in power.
I strive to obey the law. I will never again make the mistake of going against authority.
I always plan everything out. The one time I let others plan things it did not end well for me.
I take blame to protect others from pain.
I hoard information, you never know what may come in handy.
Loss. I freely give those who offend me what was so brutally denied me, death. (Chaos)
Dedication. I never betray those who trust me. (Law)
Vengeance. I use any means to get information I need; I have been well taught. (Evil)
Redemption. Everyone deserves a second chance. (Good)
Resilience. I can survive any challenge (Any)
Leadership. The best teams are made up of those that society has discarded.
I take up arms to help establish a free Phlan.
The horrors of my time in Stojanow haunt my dreams, only after a day of hard work can I find sleep.
I am indebted to those who freed me from prison, I will repay this debt.
My torturer survived the attack that set me free, I will find him/her.
I will not rest while others suffer fates similar to mine.
I am searching for a way to heal the scars of Stojanow, both physical and emotional.
During stressful times, I find myself crying for no reason.
My nerve endings are shot from the interrogations; I am numb to all but the harshest touch.
I am incapable of standing up for myself.
I folded under the torture, and gave information that I promised would be kept secret. My life would be in jeopardy if others found out.
Survival is worth more than friendship.
The ghosts from my past hinder my actions.

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Two of the following: {@skill Perception}, {@skill Survival}, {@skill Stealth}, {@skill Athletics}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: Cook's utensils, one other set of artisan's tools

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: {@item Cook's utensils|PHB}, {@item climber's kit|PHB}, a {@item shovel|PHB}, a pair of thick gloves, a cloak with a hood.

rows: Being alone for so long means I am very used to conversing with myself out loud.
I eat things that others find disgusting. I have learned to love the delicacies of scavenged food in the ruins.
I have many scars across my body from barely scraping by.
I am missing a finger on one hand due to a horrible encounter I had in the ruins.
I keep a locket of someone I lost in the ruins. I stare at it every night before I fall asleep to remember what I am looking for.
I keep souvenirs of the monsters I have bested in these ruins, to remind myself how strong I truly am.
I can sleep just about anywhere, nothing really phases me anymore.
I often recite the names of people I used to know and lost so I can hold on to their memory.

entries.name: Feature: Makeshift Meals
entries: Sabes cómo purificar la comida y las raciones que encuentras en las ruinas. Cuando realizas un descanso corto, preparas una comida para un número de criaturas igual a tu bonificación de competencia. Las criaturas que consumen la comida recuperan puntos de vida equivalentes a tu nivel. Una vez que lo hacen, no pueden recuperar puntos de vida con otra de tus comidas hasta que completen un descanso largo.

entries.caption: Suggested Characteristics
rows: I always have an exit strategy in mind if things go poorly.
You can't survive in this grim city without a good sense of humor, but I have a taste for gallows humor.
I try to work in the thin grey area between the squabbling factions, squeezing under their radar when possible. The less I am seen, the better.
If you spot danger, it is best to avoid it, that's how you survive.
Drakkenheim is a dangerous place. But I can navigate it with my eyes closed. No one else I've ever met is as good as I am.
In order to survive the monsters of Drakkenheim, one must be a monster of Drakkenheim.
Take everything you can from the dead, take it from the living if you can. If you are to survive, you must take any opportunity to scavenge.
I will never give up until I reclaim what I lost in these ruins.
Self-Reliance. I won't risk my life for others. Everyone must fend for themselves—better you than me. (Evil)
Bravery. I find the thrill of surviving the monsters and magics of Drakkenheim exhilarating and thrive on the chaos. (Chaotic)
Safety. Whatever I can do to keep myself fed and keep a safe place to rest is good in my books. (Any)
Helpful. People need all the help they can get in the city, and I know I can provide it. (Good)
Hope. I believe there is something worth saving here, we must hold on to the idea of a better future. (Good)
Responsibility. I lived here before the meteor, I'll live here long after. I must protect my home and do what I can to make it livable again. (Lawful)
I had family in these ruins. I know not what became of them, but I must find out.
This city is my home, and I will fight for what's left of it until the very end.
I'll do any dirty work in the city if it means a hot meal, a warm bed, or some good company.
I've spent so long in these ruins, its the outside world that terrifies me now.
Why haven't I left Drakkenheim? Have you seen how much gold there is to be made here?
I am bound to the throne of Drakkenheim, and fight to see it one day reclaimed.
Any meal could be my last. I'll eat just about anything. I do what I must to survive.
I don't like being outside the Haze of the city for too long, I've gotten used to it.
I am convinced my family is alive in the city somewhere. I hear their voices call to me at night.
I don't trust anyone easily. I'll sleep with one eye open even around my companions, for Drakkenheim makes monsters of us all.
The years spent here have turned me to a vice, I very much rely on that vice to get me through my days.
I hear voices constantly. Sometimes I get distracted with conversations with people who are not there.

_.special: small article of jewelry that is distinct to your tribe

items.entry: {@item Herbalism kit|phb}, a small article of jewelry that is distinct to your tribe, a {@item hunting trap|phb}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 5 gp

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Pobre

entries.name: Overview
entries: Naciste en una tribu nómada que tenía su hogar en las colinas de Ticklebelly. Emigrabas de un lugar a otro, viviendo de la tierra junto a tu tribu. La tribu solía desplazarse estacionalmente hacia el sur, hasta el Mar de Hierba y el Mojón del Gigante; hacia el norte, hasta las Montañas de la Espina del Dragón; e incluso, en ocasiones, hacia el este, cruzando el río Stojanow hasta las fronteras del Bosque Tembloroso.

En vuestras migraciones, vuestro pueblo ha llegado a conocer a las tribus de gigantes de piedra que pueblan el Montículo del Gigante. Un día llegaron a las colinas los cultistas del dragón: magos vestidos de púrpura y montados en bestias horribles, guerreros ataviados de negro con máscaras malvadas e incluso soldados de la cercana ciudad de Phlan. Entonces llegó el dragón llamado Vorgansharax y estableció su guarida en las colinas, provocando que crecieran matorrales espantosos y que los animales se comportaran de forma extraña. Los cultistas comenzaron a asaltar campamentos nómadas en busca de víctimas que ofrecer al wyrm. Con el tiempo, el dragón partió para atacar Phlan, pero la vida nunca volvió a ser la misma para los nómadas de las Colinas de Ticklebelly.

entries.name: Feature: At Home in the Wild
entries: La naturaleza salvaje es tu hogar y te sientes cómodo viviendo en ella. Cuando estás en plena naturaleza, puedes encontrar un lugar donde esconderte, descansar o recuperarte. Este lugar de descanso es lo suficientemente seguro como para protegerte de la mayoría de las amenazas naturales. Las amenazas sobrenaturales, mágicas o que te estén buscando activamente podrían tener dificultades para encontrarte, dependiendo de la naturaleza de la amenaza (según lo determine el DM). Sin embargo, esta característica no te protege ni te oculta de la adivinación, la exploración mental ni de amenazas que no requieran necesariamente los cinco sentidos para encontrarte. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica «Héroe popular».

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los nómadas de Ticklebelly solo se adentran en la civilización cuando es necesario. Eres sociable dentro de tu tribu, con otras tribus nómadas e incluso con las tribus de gigantes de piedra que pueblan el Montículo del Gigante. Sin embargo, las demás comunidades suelen ponerte en guardia o dejarte boquiabierto. ¿Fue este asombro lo que te llevó a una vida de aventuras? Por otro lado, eres ferozmente protector y dedicado a tu tribu. Quizás fue esta dedicación la que te llevó a aventurarte; ya fuera por tu propia voluntad o a instancias de los líderes de tu tribu.

rows: I eagerly inject myself into the unknown.
Villages, towns, and cities do not suit me. I'd rather be out in the wilderness any day.
I accomplish my tasks efficiently, using as few resources as possible.
It's difficult for me to remain in one place for long.
I loudly brag about my tribe every chance I get.
Having walked among giants, I am fearless in the face of bigger creatures.
I am quiet and reserved, but observant. Nothing escapes my attention.
My word is my bond. I see a promise to completion, even if it conflicts with my beliefs.
Kinship. Family is most important in life. Though I may be far from my own, the bonds of family must be protected in others' lives as well. (Good)
Preservation. Nature must not be despoiled by encroaching civilization. (Any)
Wanderlust. One must expand their horizons by seeing the world and exploring. (Chaos)
Isolation. My tribe and its ways must be protected and shielded from outside influence. (Neutral)
Protection. Threats to the land and to the people must be dealt with at any and all costs. (Law)
Belonging: All creatures have a place in the world, so I strive to help others find theirs. (Good)
I ache to return to my tribe and the family I left, but cannot until my obligations are fulfilled.
The dragon cultists that invaded my homeland stole away one of my tribe's people. I will not know rest until I've found them.
The dragon's presence in the hills destroyed valuable territory and resulted in deaths within my tribe. The creature must pay for what it has done.
I carry a trinket that spiritually and emotionally ties me to my people and my home.
I discovered a strange relic in the hills during my tribe's wanderings. I must discover what it is.
One of the stone giant clans from the Giant's Cairn has graced me with a mark of kinship.
I throw myself and my friends into situations rarely ever thinking about consequences.
Unfamiliar people and surroundings put me on edge.
I have absolutely no patience for slowpokes and those who prove indecisive.
My desire to experience new things causes me to make unsafe choices.
I am overly protective of nature, sometimes to the detriment of my companions and myself.
My lack of worldliness often proves my undoing in social, commercial, and hostile situations.

entries.name: Lifestyle
entries: Modesto

entries.name: Overview
entries: Eres una de las muchas personas que se encargan de que las rutas comerciales estén despejadas en TODO momento. Te aseguras de que se respete la Gran Ley del Comercio a toda costa. Trabajas solo o en grupo para acabar con los bandidos y salteadores que podrían impedir el paso de las caravanas. Investigas posibles emboscadas y rumores sobre personas que podrían querer robar o detener a las caravanas. Eres tanto investigador como agente de la ley.

Puedes dirigirte a cualquier pueblo o aldea de los alrededores de Hillsfar y encontrar a alguien dispuesto a darte información, ya sean rumores o hechos. A veces, esto conlleva un pequeño soborno de entre 1 y 9 piezas de plata.

entries.name: Feature: Investigative Services
entries: Formas parte de una pequeña tropa apostada a las afueras de Hillsfar. Tienes una forma especial de comunicarte con los demás y estos parecen sentirse a gusto en tu presencia. Puedes hacer valer tu rango para acceder a la escena de un crimen o para requisar equipo o caballos de forma temporal. Cuando entras en una ciudad o pueblo cercano a Hillsfar, puedes identificar a un contacto que te proporcionará información sobre los rumores locales y te ayudará simplemente por tu deseo de obtener respuestas e información para cualquiera que quiera perturbar el comercio. Nota: Esta característica es una variante de la característica de soldado.

rows: I am always polite and respectful
I let my actions speak for themselves
I am haunted by my past having seen the murder of a close friend or family member and it is the one case I always needed to solve but have not been able to.
I am quick to judge and slow to vindicate
I can be very persuasive and am able to ask quest ions where others might not be able to.
I have a quirky personality that seems to take others off their guard.
My sense of humor is considered by most to be awkward.
Everyone has a choice, and they can always make the right choice, mine!
Hope. my job is to speak for the victim (Good)
Dedicated. Once I start an investigation, until told to do so, I do not quit, not matter where it leads. (Lawful)
Nation. My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)
Mercenary. When I do investigations, I expect answers immediately. (Any)
Eloquent. I use my words to sway others to give me answers. (Good)
Might. It is through threats and force that I get my answers. (Lawful)
To this day an unsolved case will always leave me haunted and bother me.
Through the might of my personality I will solve an investigation or puzzle.
It is my right to believe what I will, just try and stop me.
I need to prove my worth to my fellow Sheriffs
Someone I cared for died under suspicious circumstances. I will find out what happened to them and bring their killer to justice.
I speak for those that cannot speak for themselves.
I always over exaggerate my abilities.
I cannot bear to let those I care for out of my sight.
I took a bribe to tank an investigation and I would do anything to keep it secret.
I have little respect for those that are of "low" intelligence/race.
I always enjoy a good mug of ale... or five to cover up my past.
I speak for the First Lord of Hillsfar and make sure everyone knows it.

rows: You keep a cryptic map to a lost treasure that you have always wanted to uncover.
You have a coin that is heads on both sides, helpful for winning a chance game.
You have a magnifying spyglass you use to examine items.
You have a ring that opens to reveal a small compartment inside.
Your left boot has a compartment for a hidden dagger.
You carry an old compass that doesn't point north, you hope it points towards a great treasure.
You have a collection of exotic coins and medals that are of personal value to you.
You have a rival treasure hunter who used to be a partner. You parted ways years ago.

entries.name: Feature: Detail-Oriented
entries: Duplicas tu bonificación de destreza al realizar cualquier tirada de habilidad para explorar las ruinas de Drakkenheim.

entries.caption: Suggested Characteristics
rows: I believe that I am destined for greatness, and nothing can convince me otherwise.
I always have a plan or plot to outwit my foes. It may not always be good, but it's almost always overly complex.
I love to flaunt my wealth and showcase the things I have bought with it.
I pay no mind to the risks of a situation. I always bet on myself and my abilities and it's gotten me this far. Never tell me the odds.
I have a quip, allegory, or joke for almost any situation.
I lie about anything and everything. I lie for almost no reason at all, sometimes just to see if I can fool the people around me.
I use flattery and honeyed words to get what I want.
I can't help it if valuable objects lying around end up in my pockets. It's for safe keeping.
Independent. No one tells me what to do. I make my own rules, and my own luck. (Chaotic)
Fair. I do not take anything from anyone who couldn't afford to lose it. I am a treasure hunter, not a thief. (Lawful)
Family. I care about material possessions and wealth, but not as much as I care about my friends and family. (Good)

Aspiration. Wealth is power. Wealth means you will be remembered. In this world making a name for yourself is as simple as acquiring enough gold to buy your way to victory. I intend to be remembered. (Any)
Danger. Every great discovery requires risk. The greater the risk, the greater the reward. It's the thrill of the hunt that I live for. (Any)
Dignity. The dead and their prized belongings deserve more than to waste away in the ruins. They deserve to be found, remembered, and taken care of. (Lawful)
My desire for wealth is out of a need to protect my family.
Something important to me was stolen. I've longed to get it back ever since.
I'm wanted for my many crimes and hope that where I am going, the law will not follow.
I made mistakes in my past that cost me the life of someone I loved. I will not let that happen again.
I plan to be the greatest thief or most cunning explorer of all time.
This is my last job, the big one. After this I hope to settle down with my wealth, maybe start a family.
My entire identity is layers of falsities presented to hide my true self, for I am not a good person. I've never told the truth for as long as I can remember and it's too late now to stop.
Every situation, every person, is only as valuable to me as what I can gain from them. I'm not afraid to pull strings to bend luck in my favour.
I jump to defensive measures as soon as someone catches me in a lie, or tries to call me out for anything.
I take what I want, and I want it all.
I like to show my skills, talk big, and take big risks in the hopes of impressing everyone watching.
I know for a fact I am the smartest person in the room, and if people are suggesting anything otherwise they are terribly mistaken.

entries.name: Feature: Ear to the Ground
entries: Estás en contacto frecuente con personas del entorno social en el que se mueven tus objetivos. Estas personas pueden estar relacionadas con el mundo del hampa, con la gente de la calle o con miembros de la alta sociedad. Esta conexión se materializa en forma de un contacto en cualquier ciudad que visites, una persona que te proporciona información sobre la gente y los lugares de la zona.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Utiliza las tablas del trasfondo {@background criminal} del Manual del Jugador como base para las características y motivaciones de tu cazarrecompensas, modificando las entradas cuando sea necesario para adaptarlas a tu identidad como cazarrecompensas.

Por ejemplo, tu compromiso podría estar relacionado con otros cazarrecompensas o con las organizaciones o personas que te contratan. Tu ideal podría estar vinculado a tu determinación de atrapar siempre a tu presa o a tu deseo de mantener tu reputación de persona de confianza.

_.special: map of the city you grew up in
token to remember your parents by

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A small knife, a map of the city you grew up in, a pet mouse, a token to remember your parents by, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: City Secrets
entries: Conoces los caminos secretos y el trazado de las ciudades, y eres capaz de encontrar atajos entre la maraña urbana que otros pasarían por alto. Cuando no estás en combate, tú (y los compañeros a los que lideras) podéis desplazaros entre dos puntos cualesquiera de la ciudad al doble de la velocidad a la que lo harías normalmente.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los niños de la calle están marcados por una vida de pobreza extrema, para bien y para mal. Suelen actuar impulsados, bien por un compromiso con las personas con las que compartieron su vida en la calle, bien por un ardiente deseo de encontrar una vida mejor —y quizá de vengarse de todos los ricos que los trataron mal—.

rows: I hide scraps of food and trinkets away in my pockets.
I ask a lot of questions.
I like to squeeze into small places where no one else can get to me.
I sleep with my back to a wall or tree, with everything I own wrapped in a bundle in my arms.
I eat like a pig and have bad manners.
I think anyone who's nice to me is hiding evil intent.
I don't like to bathe.
I bluntly say what others are hinting at or hiding.
Respect. All people, rich or poor, deserve respect. (Good)
Community. We have to take care of each other, because no one else is going to do it. (Lawful)
Change. The low are lifted up, and the high and mighty are brought down. Change is the nature of things. (Chaotic)
Retribution. The rich need to be shown what life and death are like in the gutters. (Evil)
People. I help the people who help me—that's what keeps us alive. (Neutral)
Aspiration. I'm going to prove that I'm worthy of a better life. (Any)
My town or city is my home, and I'll fight to defend it.
I sponsor an orphanage to keep others from enduring what I was forced to endure.
I owe my survival to another urchin who taught me to live on the streets.
I owe a debt I can never repay to the person who took pity on me.
I escaped my life of poverty by robbing an important person, and I'm wanted for it.
No one else should have to endure the hardships I've been through.
If I'm outnumbered, I will run away from a fight.
Gold seems like a lot of money to me, and I'll do just about anything for more of it.
I will never fully trust anyone other than myself.
I'd rather kill someone in their sleep than fight fair.
It's not stealing if I need it more than someone else.
People who can't take care of themselves get what they deserve.

entries.name: Feature: Uthgardt Heritage
entries: Conoces a la perfección no solo el territorio de tu tribu, sino también el terreno y los recursos naturales del resto del norte. Estás tan familiarizado con cualquier zona salvaje que, cuando vas a buscar provisiones, consigues el doble de comida y agua de lo que conseguirías normalmente.

Además, puedes recurrir a la hospitalidad de tu pueblo y de los aliados de tu tribu, entre los que suelen encontrarse miembros de los círculos druídicos, tribus de elfos nómadas, los Harpers y los cleros dedicados a los dioses del Primer Círculo.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Use the tables for the {@background outlander} background in the Player's Handbook as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity as a member of an Uthgardt tribe.

Even if you have left your tribe behind (at least for now), you hold to the traditions of your people. You will never cut down a still-living tree, and you may not countenance such an act being done in your presence. The Uthgardt ancestral mounds - great hills where the totem spirits were defeated by Uthgar and where the heroes of the tribes are interred - are sacred to you.

Your bond is undoubtedly associated with your tribe or some aspect of Uthgardt philosophy or culture (perhaps even Uthgar himself). Your ideal is a personal choice that probably hews closely to the ethos of your people and certainly doesn't contradict or compromise what being an Uthgardt stands for.

_.special: uniform in the style of your unit and indicative of your rank

_.displayName: horn with which to summon help

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A uniform in the style of your unit and indicative of your rank, a {@item horn|phb} with which to summon help, a set of {@item manacles|phb}, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Watcher's Eye
entries: Tu experiencia en la aplicación de la ley y en el trato con los delincuentes te permite conocer bien las leyes locales y a los delincuentes. Puedes localizar fácilmente la sede local de la guardia o de una organización similar, y con la misma facilidad identificar los focos de actividad delictiva de una comunidad, aunque es más probable que seas bien recibido en los primeros lugares que en los segundos.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Utiliza las tablas del trasfondo {@background soldier} del Manual del Jugador como base para tus rasgos y motivaciones, modificando las entradas cuando sea necesario para adaptarlas a tu identidad como miembro de la guardia municipal.

Es probable que tu compromiso esté relacionado con tus compañeros de la patrulla o con la propia organización de la patrulla, y es casi seguro que se refiera a tu comunidad. Tu ideal probablemente tenga que ver con el fomento de la paz y la seguridad. Es probable que el ideal de un investigador esté relacionado con la consecución de la justicia mediante la resolución satisfactoria de los delitos.

items.name: Variant: Myriad Operative
entries: Your skill set might be similar to that of many members of the {@book Clasp|TDCSR|2|The Clasp}, but you work for a criminal organization that is far more sophisticated—and even less scrupulous. As a {@book Myriad|TDCSR|2|The Myriad} operative in Tal'Dorei, you might have been given a specific task that furthers that syndicate's hunger to expand beyond Wildemount, or which gives them an edge in their rivalry with the {@book Clasp|TDCSR|2|The Clasp}. Moreover, you understand the wisdom of keeping your activities secret from fellow criminals as well as law enforcement, since the agents of the {@book Clasp|TDCSR|2|The Clasp} will show you no mercy if your true identity is ever revealed.

background.name: Variant Continental Nobility (Last of the Line)

items.name: Feature: Spy Contact
entries: You have a reliable and trustworthy contact who acts as your liaison to a network of other spies. You know how to get messages to and from your contact, even over great distances; specifically, you know the local messengers, corrupt caravan masters, and seedy sailors who can deliver messages for you.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@item Disguise kit|phb}, one type of {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: An inexpensive but unusual weapon, such as a {@item trident|phb} or {@item net|phb} (one of your choice), the favor of an admirer (love letter, lock of hair, or trinket), {@item costume clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

items.name: Feature: By Popular Demand
entries: You can always find a place to perform in any place that features combat for entertainment—perhaps a gladiatorial arena or secret pit fighting club. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each night. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure. When strangers recognize you in a town where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, or {@item navigator's tools|phb}, or an additional language

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} (one of your choice) or a {@item mule|phb} and {@item cart|phb}, a letter of introduction from your guild, a set of {@item traveler's clothes|phb}, and a belt {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

items.name: Feature: Retainers
entries: You have the service of three retainers loyal to your family. These retainers can be attendants or messengers, and one might be a majordomo. {@b One of your retainers is a noble who serves as your squire, aiding you in exchange for training on his or her own path to knighthood} (This person could be your bond.). Your two remaining retainers might include a groom to care for your horse and a servant who polishes your armor (and even helps you put it on).

Your retainers can perform mundane tasks for you, but they do not fight for you, will not follow you into obviously dangerous areas (such as dungeons), and will leave if they are frequently endangered or abused.

items.name: Variant Noble (Knight)
entries: A knighthood is among the lowest noble titles in most societies, but it can be a path to higher status. If you wish to be a knight, choose the Retainers feature instead of the Position of Privilege feature.

As an emblem of chivalry and the ideals of courtly love, you might include among your equipment a banner or other token from a noble lord or lady to whom you have given your heart-in a chaste sort of devotion.

items.name: Feature: Retainers
entries: You have the service of three retainers loyal to your family. These retainers can be attendants or messengers, and one might be a majordomo. Your retainers are commoners who can perform mundane tasks for you, but they do not fight for you, will not follow you into obviously dangerous areas (such as dungeons), and will leave if they are frequently endangered or abused.

items.name: Feature: Bad Reputation
entries: No matter where you go, people are afraid of you due to your reputation. When you are in a civilized settlement, you can get away with minor criminal offenses, such as refusing to pay for food at a tavern or breaking down doors at a local shop, since most people will not report your activity to the authorities.

background.name: Variant Survivor (Veteran of the Civil War)

items.name: Variant: Grey Hunter
entries: As elite as they are, the members of the {@book Whitestone Rifle Corps|TDCSR|3|Whitestone Rifle Corps} do not represent the apex of firearms skill in {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone}. A clandestine group of elite soldiers and survivalists is drawn secretly from the Rifle Corps ranks. Called the {@book Grey Hunters|TDCSR|3|Grey Hunters}, these soldiers are special operatives of the de Rolo family, and loyally serve as spies, bodyguards, and even assassins when the job requires it. Though few officially know of them, rumors of the {@book Grey Hunters'|TDCSR|3|Grey Hunters} existence swirl constantly throughout the city-state, often in response to their activities after having been loaned out to protect {@book Whitestone's|TDCSR|3|Whitestone} allies.

You are one of these {@book Grey Hunters|TDCSR|3|Grey Hunters}, even if just a trainee (if you're starting your campaign at low levels). You have the ear of the lord and lady of {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone}, though you must exercise this privilege graciously lest you lose it.

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools}, one type of {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} or a {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} (one of your choice), a scroll of your god's teachings, a vizier's cartouche, a set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 25 gp

entries.name: Feature: Voice of Authority
entries: Tu voz es la voz de tu dios, al menos en teoría. Es posible que tu trabajo consista en formar e instruir a los iniciados, quienes están obligados a obedecerte. En cualquier circunstancia, se espera que un iniciado acate tu palabra y obedezca tus órdenes. Sin embargo, si abusas de esta autoridad, tu dios podría castigarte personalmente.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Las características de un visir reflejan fielmente los ideales y la personalidad del dios al que sirve.

rows: Everything I do, I do gracefully and deliberately, and with complete confidence. (Oketra)
Nothing can shake my rock-hard focus. (Oketra)
When I am at peace, I am an oasis of perfect calm in the world. When I am roused to anger, I am an embodiment of terror. (Kefnet)
I enjoy teasing acolytes and initiates with juicy tidbits of knowledge wrapped up in fiendishly difficult puzzles. (Kefnet)
I have the utmost faith in myself and my abilities. (Rhonas)
I get restless when life in the city feels too tame, too safe. (Rhonas)
I enjoy solitude as an opportunity to plan my victory. (Bontu)
I use satire as a way to undermine the teachings of the other gods. (Bontu)
I love, fight, and feast with equal zeal. (Hazoret)
I think of those in my care as my family, in a way that most people have trouble understanding. (Hazoret)
{@b Solidarity.} The worthy must respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will be united in goal and action. (Oketra)
{@b Knowledge.} The worthy shall cultivate a nimble mind, so as to perceive the wonders beyond imagination that wait in the afterlife. (Kefnet)
{@b Strength.} The worthy shall hone a strong body that can withstand the boundless energies of the afterlife. (Rhonas)
{@b Ambition.} The worthy shall strive for greatness, for supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife. (Bontu)
{@b Zeal.} The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless passion, rising to overcome every obstacle in their way. (Hazoret)
{@b Naktamun.} The life of the city is ordered according to the plan of the God-Pharaoh, and that order must be preserved at all costs.
My loyalty to my companions embodies the ideal of loyalty to my god. (Oketra)
The teachings of my god are more precious to me than any possession. (Kefnet)
I would do anything to defend the temple of my god from any harm or desecration. (Rhonas)
I am committed to the service of my god—because it's my sure ticket into the afterlife. (Bontu)
I love my god and never want my service to end. (Hazoret)
I have a close friend or lover who is also a vizier.
I am in love with an initiate, and I want to shield this person from death in the trials.
I secretly wish I had not been chosen as a vizier, so I could participate in the trials as an initiate.
I secretly question whether the gods care at all about us or what we do.
A vizier of another god seeks my death in retribution for a past insult.
I am terrified of what lies beyond the Gate to the Afterlife.
I secretly believe the God-Pharaoh's return will not bring blessing to this world.

items.name: Feature: Shelter of Dissenters
entries: If they wish to have any hope of survival, whether hiding within the city or cast out into the desert, dissenters must help each other. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other dissenters. They will help shield you from those who hunt you, possibly even risking their lives for you.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a black cloak with a hood, a {@item poisoner's kit|phb}, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Shadow Network
entries: Tienes acceso a la red oculta de Volstrucker, que te permite comunicarte con otros miembros de la orden a larga distancia. Si escribes una carta con una tinta arcana especial, la diriges a un miembro de Volstrucker y la arrojas al fuego, la carta se reducirá a cenizas y volverá a materializarse íntegra en manos del agente al que la hayas dirigido.

La tinta que se utiliza para enviar una carta a través de la red de las sombras es la misma que emplean los magos para escribir hechizos en un libro de hechizos. Escribir una carta con esta tinta cuesta 10 po por página.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Los agentes del Volstrucker están entrenados para cumplir órdenes sin cuestionar y para matar sin piedad. El trauma que lleva a alguien a ingresar en la orden puede agravarse aún más ante la oscuridad de las misiones de un agente del Volstrucker. Oficialmente, nadie abandona jamás la orden, pero aquellos lo suficientemente desesperados hacen lo que sea necesario para conseguir algo de libertad.

rows: I prefer to keep my thoughts to myself.
I indulge vice in excess to quiet my conscience.
I've left emotion behind me. I'm now perfectly placid.
Some event from the past keeps worming its way into my mind, making me restless.
I always keep my word—except when I'm commanded to break it.
I laugh off insults and never take them personally.
Order. The will of the crown is absolute. (Law)
True Loyalty. The Cerberus Assembly is greater than any power, even the crown. (Law)
Death. The penalty for disloyalty is death. (Evil)
Determination. I cannot fail. Not ever. (Neutral)
Fear. People should not respect power. They should fear it. (Evil)
Escape. The Volstrucker are pure evil! I can't atone for what I've done for them, but I can escape with my life. (Any)
The job is all that matters. I will see it through.
My orders are important, but my comrades are worth more than anything. I would die for them.
Everything I've done, I've done to protect someone close to me.
If the empire falls, all of civilization falls with it. I will hold back chaos and barbarism at any cost.
I drink to dull the pain in the back of my head.
I go a bit mad when I see blood.
I can hear the voices of everyone I've killed. I see their faces. I can't be free of these ghosts.
Fear is a powerful motivator. I will do whatever it takes to prevent those who know what I am from seeing me fail, and from those I care about from knowing what I am.

_.special: skin of fine zzar or wine

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of {@filter gaming set|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=gaming set} or {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A set of {@item fine clothes|phb}, a {@item signet ring|phb} or brooch, a scroll of pedigree, a skin of fine zzar or wine, and a purse containing 20 gp

entries.name: Feature: Kept in Style
entries: Mientras te encuentres en Waterdeep o en cualquier otro lugar del norte, tu casa se encarga de tus necesidades cotidianas. Tu nombre y tu sello bastan para cubrir la mayor parte de tus gastos; las posadas, tabernas y salones de fiestas que frecuentas se encargan gustosamente de anotar tu deuda y enviar un resumen de gastos a la finca de tu familia en Waterdeep para saldar lo que debes.

Esta ventaja te permite llevar un estilo de vida cómodo sin tener que pagar 2 po al día por ello, o reduce el coste de un estilo de vida acomodado o aristocrático en esa cantidad. No puedes optar por llevar un estilo de vida menos acomodado y utilizar la diferencia como ingresos: la ventaja es una línea de crédito, no una recompensa monetaria real.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Use the tables for the {@background noble} background in the Player's Handbook as the basis for your traits and motivations, modifying the entries when appropriate to suit your identity as a member of a Waterdhavian family.

Like other nobles, you were born and raised in a different world from the one that most folk know - one that grants you privilege but also calls you to fulfill a duty befitting your station. Your bond might be associated with your family alone, or it could be concerned with another noble house that sides with or opposes your own. Your ideal depends to some extent on how you view your role in the family, and how you intend to conduct yourself in the world at large as a representative of your house.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|XPHB|2 Daggers}, {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} (any), {@item Bedroll|XPHB}, {@item Pouch|XPHB|2 Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: Your choice of two of the following: {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Perception}, or {@skill Survival}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Your choice of a {@item musket} or a {@item pistol}, a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, and a {@item pouch|PHB} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Feature: Legacy of Secrecy
entries: Se te ha confiado el uso y el cuidado de un arma tan poderosa como aterradora. El rifle que empuñas podría transformar el panorama de la guerra y la vida en Tal'Dorei. Es un arma que atormenta la mente de su creador, {@creature Percival de Rolo|TDCSR}, y que se manifiesta como un dolor que siempre acecha tras sus amables ojos.

Tu comandante del {@item musket} te ha entregado un {@item pistol} o una {@book Whitestone Rifle Corps|TDCSR|3|Whitestone Rifle Corps}. Esta arma es un símbolo de tu estatus y, cuando la muestras, las personas que te rodean —especialmente aventureros, mercenarios, guardias, ingenieros y aficionados a las armas— te tratan de forma diferente. Podrías ser visto como un noble defensor del pueblo, un acaparador egoísta de poder o cualquier cosa entre medias, a discreción del DJ.

entries.name: Feature: Rifle Corps Relationship
entries: Eres —o eras— miembro de un grupo de élite y de confianza formado por los defensores más acérrimos de {@book Whitestone's|TDCSR|3|Whitestone}. Consulta con tu DJ para determinar tu relación actual con el Cuerpo de Fusileros. Si tu campaña comienza en {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone}, es posible que seas un miembro activo de esa unidad. De lo contrario, puedes utilizar la tabla de Relaciones con el Cuerpo de Fusileros para obtener sugerencias.

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Relationships
rows: I retired honorably from the Rifle Corps—and now it's time for me to pursue my own adventures.
I'm on an important mission to protect {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone} or guard one of our allies.
{@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone} is in trouble, and I was sent away to seek help.
I don't think firearms technology should be kept secret, so I escaped from the Rifle Corps with my weapon and am on the run.
I was on a mission with my company when I got separated from them. Now I need to find my way back home.
My weapon was stolen. I built a new one, but I can't return home until I've tracked down the thief and recovered the original. ({@book Whitestone Hunter|TDCSR|3|Grey Hunters} variant only)

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Quienes se alistan en el {@book Whitestone Rifle Corps|TDCSR|3|Whitestone Rifle Corps} pasan a formar parte de una unidad de élite y de confianza conocida como los defensores más acérrimos de la ciudad-estado. Pero esto implica colaborar con tu DJ para determinar por qué no estás en casa protegiendo {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone}. Quizás aceptaste una misión para proteger a alguien en nombre de la familia de Rolo, o tal vez te separaste de tu compañía mientras realizabas un encargo. Sea como sea, ahora te ves envuelto en una serie de nuevas aventuras mientras intentas regresar a casa.

Es probable que tu vínculo esté relacionado con tus compañeros de armas o con el propio {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone}. Tu ideal podría estar ligado a la justicia o la protección, pero también podría tratarse de una perversión secreta y egoísta de esas virtudes.

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Personality Traits
rows: I want to make a good impression at all times. That means keeping my clothes and gear clean and in top condition.
I don't like being the center of attention. I'd rather let someone else do the talking while I watch their back.
I feel safe only if I'm carrying my trusty rifle. And my dagger. And my concealed pistol. Oh, and of course my....
I don't trust people with my secrets easily, so it feels like a big deal when someone else shares a secret with me.
I like coming up with solutions to problems using my esoteric knowledge of natural philosophy.
Everyone around me takes things so seriously. Sometimes I just want to let loose and have fun!
Knowing things that other people don't know makes me feel special and important.
I'm most at home in woods and mountains, where everything feels at once familiar, always growing and changing.

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Ideals
rows: {@b Responsibility}. I have a duty to protect the people of {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone} and to uphold the trust placed in me by the de Rolos. (Lawful)
{@b Militarization}. Everyone should have access to the most powerful weapons available, so they can defend themselves effectively. (Evil)
{@b Cooperation}. Any problem can be solved as long as people are willing to work together. (Good)
{@b Camaraderie}. It's important to have people you can trust to help out in a fight—and to uncork a bottle together afterward. (Any)
{@b Context}. There are no universal rights or wrongs. Every choice depends on the details of the situation. (Chaotic)
{@b Secrecy}. Information is valuable, but it can also be dangerous. I'll keep my mouth shut and gather as much intel as I can. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Bons
rows: I never knew what to do with myself until I joined the Rifle Corps. Now I have a purpose and comrades to give me direction.
One of my fellow Rifle Corps soldiers saved my life—and then I saved theirs. That kind of bond lasts forever.

{@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone} is the best city in all of Tal'Dorei. Nowhere else has been blessed by the {@deity The Dawnfather|Exandria|TDCSR|Dawnfather} and has a clock that tracks the movement of the stars!
My quick thinking saved a noble from assassination, and she showed me great kindness in return. I daren't say it, but I'm more loyal to her than I am to the de Rolos.
My weapon is my life. I clean it, repair it, and care for it—and it serves me loyally in return.
The people of {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone} cared for my family when we had nothing. I promise to repay their compassion with my service.

entries.caption: Rifle Corps Flaws
rows: Who cares about keeping this gun safe? "Don't let it fall into the wrong hands!" Ha! It's only a matter of time before someone slips up and these weapons are everywhere.
I think being part of the Rifle Corps is so cool. I love telling people about my position so I can impress them.
My weapon was stolen. I built a new one, but I can't return home until I've tracked down the thief and recovered the original.
I'm tired of protecting spoiled people who don't know how to protect themselves.
I shoot first and ask questions later.
The first and only time I killed someone, it changed my life. I still dream about it, and I'll never be the carefree person I was before.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A belaying pin ({@item club|phb}), a set of {@item traveler's clothes|PHB}, a {@item grappling hook|PHB}, {@item Hempen Rope (50 feet)|PHB|50 feet of hempen rope}, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 10 gp

entries.name: Close Encounter
entries: Has vivido un encuentro angustioso con uno de los muchos horrores del Espacio Salvaje. Has logrado escapar con vida, pero el encuentro te ha dejado alguna que otra cicatriz, o quizá una pesadilla recurrente. Tira en la tabla de Encuentros Cercanos para determinar qué criatura estuvo a punto de vencerte. Las criaturas marcadas con un asterisco aparecen en {@book Boo's Astral Menagerie|BAM}; las demás se describen en el {@book Monster Manual|MM}.

entries.name: Feature: Wildspace Adaptation
entries: Obtienes la {@feat Tough||Tough feat} del {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. Además, has aprendido a adaptarte a la gravedad cero. La ingravidez no te supone desventaja en ninguna de tus tiradas de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo (véase «{@book Weightlessness|AAG|2|Weightlessness}» en el {@book chapter 2|AAG|2}).

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@item Disguise kit|phb} or one type of {@filter musical Instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item disguise kit|PHB} or a {@filter musical instrument|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=instrument} of your choice, a deck of cards, a carnival uniform or {@item costume clothes|phb|costume}, one trinket (determined by rolling on the {@item Feywild Trinket|WBtW|Feywild Trinkets}), and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 8 gp

entries.name: Feature: Carnival Fixture
entries: El Carnaval de la Luz de las Brujas te ofrece alojamiento y comida sencillos y gratuitos. Además, podrás pasear por el carnaval y disfrutar de sus numerosas maravillas sin coste alguno, siempre y cuando no interrumpas los espectáculos ni causes ningún otro tipo de problema.

entries.name: Carnival Companion
entries: Con el paso de los años, te has ganado la amistad de otro personaje habitual del carnaval. Tira un {@dice d8} y consulta la tabla de «Compañeros del carnaval» para determinar con quién o con qué te has hecho amigo, o bien elige la opción que prefieras. Colabora con tu DJ para desarrollar esta amistad. Este compañero te acompañará mientras estés en el carnaval, pero no abandonará el recinto por voluntad propia.

El DJ puede utilizar la ficha de características {@creature Witchlight Hand (Medium)|WBtW|Witchlight hand} del {@adventure chapter 1|WBtW|1} para representar a los malabaristas, artistas y domadores de animales que actúan como compañeros de feria. Las estadísticas de los demás compañeros aparecen en el {@book Monster Manual|MM}.

entries.caption: Carnival Companion
rows: Old, cantankerous Witchlight hand
Young, impressionable Witchlight hand
Performer (such as an acrobat, a clown, or a musician)
Retired performer
Seasoned animal trainer
Old {@creature blink dog}
Cheery {@creature sprite}
Harmless, magical wisp of light (no stat block required) that has a flying speed of 30 feet, can hover, and sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet

entries.name: Character Traits
entries: As the players choose backgrounds for their characters, they can use the following tables to help determine their characters' personality traits, ideals, bonds, and flaws. Players can use these tables instead of the ones that appear in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, or they can mix and match them. If a rolled result doesn't make sense for a character, the player can roll again or choose a more appropriate entry on the table.
These tables, while optional, are well suited to Feywild-themed adventures and are ideal for any character who has the feylost or Witchlight hand background.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I'm haunted by fey laughter that only I can hear, though I know it's just my mind playing tricks on me.
Like a nomad, I can't settle down in one place for very long.
Good music makes me weep like a baby.
Wherever I go, I try to bring a little of the warmth and tranquility of home with me.
I have never lost my childlike sense of wonder.
When I have a new idea, I get wildly excited about it until I come up with another, better idea.
I live by my own set of weird and wonderful rules.
I can't bring myself to trust most adults.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: Friendship. I never leave a friend behind. (Good)
Empathy. No creature should be made to suffer. (Good)
Wanderlust. I prefer to take the less traveled path. (Chaotic)
Changeability. Change is good, which is why I live by an ever-changing set of rules. (Chaotic)
Honor. A deal is a deal, and I would never break one. (Lawful)
Rule of Three. Everything in the multiverse happens in threes. I see the "rule of three" everywhere. (Lawful)
Obsession. I won't let go of a grudge. (Evil)
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to get what I want, regardless of the harm it might cause. (Evil)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I would never break my word.
I find magic in all its forms to be compelling. The more magical a place, the more I am drawn to it.
I do what I can to protect the natural world.
A trusted friend is the most important thing in the multiverse to me.
I can't bring myself to harm a Fey creature, either because I consider myself one or because I fear the repercussions.
The Witchlight Carnival feels like home to me.
I'm drawn to the Feywild and long to return there, if only for a short while.
I feel indebted to {@creature Mister Witch|WBtW} and {@creature Mister Light|WBtW} for giving me a home and a purpose.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I easily lose track of time. My poor sense of time means I'm always late.
I think the whole multiverse is out to get me.
I'm always operating under a tight timeline, and I'm obsessed with keeping everything on schedule.
I'm a kleptomaniac who covets shiny, sparkling treasure.
I'm forgetful. Sometimes I can't remember even the simplest things.
I never give away anything for free and always expect something in return.
I have many vices and tend to indulge them.
I'm always changing my mind—well, almost always.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|bottle of black ink}, an {@item ink pen|PHB}, a book about plant identification, an {@item iron pot|PHB}, an {@item herbalism kit|PHB}, a school uniform, and a {@item pouch|phb} containing 15 gp

entries.name: Feature: Witherbloom Initiate
entries: Obtienes la dote {@feat Strixhaven Initiate|SCC} y debes elegir «Witherbloom» dentro de ella.

Además, si tienes la característica «Lanzamiento de conjuros» o «Magia de pacto», los conjuros de la tabla «Conjuros de Witherbloom» se añaden a la lista de conjuros de tu clase de lanzador de conjuros. (Si eres un personaje multiclase con varias listas de conjuros, estos conjuros se añaden a todas ellas.)

entries.caption: Witherbloom Spells
rows: 1st
{@spell Cure Wounds}, {@spell Inflict Wounds}
2nd
{@spell Lesser Restoration}, {@spell Wither and Bloom|SCC}
3rd
{@spell Revivify}, {@spell Vampiric Touch}
4th
{@spell Blight}, {@spell Death Ward}
5th
{@spell Antilife Shell}, {@spell Greater Restoration}

entries: Considera la posibilidad de personalizar el aspecto de tus hechizos cuando los lances. Tus hechizos de Witherbloom podrían requerir componentes materiales o un objeto de concentración procedente del entorno pantanoso de Witherbloom, y tus hechizos podrían adoptar una apariencia que evoque esos elementos naturales. Entre los efectos de tus hechizos podrían aparecer formas espectrales de animales o plantas del pantano.

entries.name: Building a Witherbloom Character
entries: Los druidas y los brujos constituyen la mayor parte del alumnado de Witherbloom. También hay algunos magos (sobre todo aquellos que estudian la {@class Wizard|PHB|School of Necromancy|Necromancy|PHB}) y clérigos (incluidos aquellos con los Dominios Divinos de {@class Cleric|PHB|Life|Life|PHB} o {@class Cleric|PHB|Nature|Nature|PHB}) que también encuentran su hogar en Witherbloom.
En Witherbloom también estudian varios guardabosques y bárbaros, y algunos pícaros aprenden a fabricar y utilizar venenos durante sus estudios en esta universidad.

entries.name: Suggested Characteristics
entries: Es igual de probable encontrar a los alumnos del Colegio Witherbloom recogiendo hierbas para preparar una tintura curativa que montando bestias pantanosas zombificadas por el pantano. La tabla de rasgos de personalidad de Witherbloom sugiere una variedad de rasgos que podrías adoptar para tu personaje.

entries.caption: Witherbloom Personality Traits
rows: I love brewing up a new recipe, even if some might be repulsed by my choice of ingredients. Or the final product. Or both.
My fashion sense is like my garden: withered, black, and weird.
I'm going to befriend every single monster in this swamp if it's the last thing I do.
Everything in this world dies eventually. The question is, what will you do with the time you have left?
I know we just met, but when you die, may I have your bones? For research.
Don't interrupt me; I'm brooding.

entries.name: Witherbloom Trinkets
entries: Al crear tu personaje, puedes tirar una vez en la tabla de {@item Witherbloom Trinket|SCC|Witherbloom Trinkets}, en lugar de en la tabla de {@item trinket|phb|Trinkets table} del {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, para elegir tu abalorio inicial.
